# **Definition and Acronyms**  {#definition-and-acronyms}

| Acronym | Definition |
| :---: | ----- |
| METPH | Private Hospital Examination and Treatment Management System |

# **I. Overall Requirements** {#i.-overall-requirements}

## **1\. Context Diagram** {#1.-context-diagram}

METPH (Private Hospital Examination and Treatment Management System) is a role-based information system that supports the outpatient examination and treatment process at a small private hospital. It covers the whole visit: patient reception, clinical examination, paraclinical services, conclusion and prescription, and payment.

![][image2]

## **2\. Main Business Flow** {#2.-main-business-flow}

### **2.1 Patient Reception and Routing (BF-01)** {#2.1-patient-reception-and-routing-(bf-01)}

***Trigger***: A patient arrives at the hospital and waits in line at the reception desk, or the Receptionist identifies them as a priority case (elderly or frail). 

***End condition***: The visit is linked to a new or existing patient profile and registered under the correct type: health insurance (verified through the simulated insurance portal) or self-paid. A patient whose insurance card is invalid is registered as self-paid. The patient is placed in the waiting list of the assigned clinic room, and an examination ticket (number, room, doctor, fee) is printed. If the examination fee is not exempt, the patient pays it at the Cashier before going to the room’s waiting area. 

 ![][image3]

### **2.2 Clinical Examination (BF-02)** {#2.2-clinical-examination-(bf-02)}

***Trigger***: The Doctor calls the next patient from the room’s waiting list. 

***End condition***: Vital signs and examination findings are recorded in the electronic medical record, and one of the following happens:

(a) Paraclinical orders are created and routed to the matching CLS rooms (continue to BF-03).

(b) No orders are needed (continue to BF-04).

(c) The patient is transferred to another clinic room and placed in its waiting list (BF-02 repeats in the new room).

(d) The patient does not respond when called and does not return; the visit is closed as Abandoned. 

 ![][image4]

### **2.3 Paraclinical Service (BF-03)** {#2.3-paraclinical-service-(bf-03)}

***Trigger***: Paraclinical orders are created in BF-02. The system creates one paraclinical receipt (Pending) for each order. After the Cashier confirms the payment (UC-71), the orders are released and each service is routed to the least busy active room that performs it (BR-28). Splitting the insurance amount and releasing the orders of insured visits right away (BR-26, BR-27) are not implemented yet. 

***End condition***: Either all ordered results are recorded and attached to the medical record and the patient returns to the original Doctor (continue to BF-04), or the patient does not return after being called and the visit is closed as Abandoned. 

 ![][image5]

### **2.4 Conclusion and Prescription (BF-04)** {#2.4-conclusion-and-prescription-(bf-04)}

***Trigger***: The Doctor recalls the patient once all paraclinical results are available, or right after BF-02 if nothing was ordered. 

***End condition***:The diagnosis and conclusion are saved to the medical record. A prescription is created if medication is needed (the hospital does not sell or dispense medication; the patient buys it outside). A follow-up appointment is created for chronic diseases (e.g. hypertension, diabetes). The conclusion and prescription are printed for the patient, and the medical record is closed and locked. The visit is marked Completed. All fees have already been settled in BF-01 and BF-03. 

 ![][image6]

 

### **2.5 System Administration and Reporting (BF-05)** {#2.5-system-administration-and-reporting-(bf-05)}

***Trigger***: The Admin needs to manage staff accounts, update departments and assign doctors, update service prices or activate/deactivate services, or wants to view statistics.

***End condition***: The change is saved and takes effect right away in the examination flows (for example, a new account can log in, or an activated service appears in the order list). Alternatively, a report is viewed or exported.

![][image7]

## **3\. Conceptual Data Model** {#3.-conceptual-data-model}

### **3.1 Entity Relationship Diagram** {#3.1-entity-relationship-diagram}

![][image8]

### 

### **3.2 Entity Descriptions** {#3.2-entity-descriptions}

**Entity: Department**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | A department or unit that performs medical examination and treatment activities and provides healthcare services. |
| Key business attributes | department\_name, department\_type, location, description, status, update\_at |
| Business identity | department\_name is unique. A Department can have many Accounts (an Account may not belong to any Department \- admin), provide many Services, and receive many Examination Registrations. |
| Status / lifecycle | None |

**Entity: Role**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | Defines a group of permissions that determines what an Account can do in the system (Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier, Admin). |
| Key business attributes | role\_name, description |
| Business identity | role\_name is unique. One Role can be assigned to many Accounts; each Account has exactly one Role. |
| Status / lifecycle | None |

**Entity: Account**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | A staff member’s login identity and profile in the system (Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier, Admin). |
| Key business attributes | user\_name, password\_hash, full\_name, academic\_title, phone, email, status, created\_at and update\_at |
| Business identity | user\_name is unique. An Account has exactly one Role and may work in at most one Department. |
| Status / lifecycle | Active ↔ Locked (a Locked Account cannot log in; historical records it created are kept) |

**Entity: Patient**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | A person who receives medical care at the hospital; holds personal and baseline medical information reused across visits. |
| Key business attributes | patient\_code, full\_name, birth\_date, gender, cccd , occupation, ethnicity, nationality, address, phone, guardian information (name, phone, relationship), medical\_history, allergies, created\_at |
| Business identity | Patient code is unique. CCCD should identify a person uniquely. One Patient can have many Examination Registrations over time. |
| Status / lifecycle | None (a persistent record created at first visit and updated on later visits) |

**Entity: Service**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | A billable medical service in the hospital’s price list (examination fee, lab test, imaging, procedure,...). |
| Key business attributes | service\_code, service\_name, service\_type, service\_group, location, price, insurance\_price, status, update\_at |
| Business identity | service\_code must be unique. Each Service is provided by at most one Department; the initial examination fee Service is shared and therefore does not belong to any Department. |
| Status / lifecycle | Active ↔ Inactive (an inactive Service cannot be selected for new registrations or orders; past records keep their original price) |

**Entity: ExaminationRegistration**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | A Patient’s registration for one visit to a specific Department, including the exam fee service, queue number and insurance information. It is the anchor of a whole visit. |
| Key business attributes | registration\_code, insurance\_card\_number, insurance\_benefit\_code, insurance\_expiry\_date, visit\_type, queue\_number, reason, registered\_at, status, cancel\_reason, transferred\_reason, transferred\_at.  |
| Business identity | registration\_code must be unique. Each Registration belongs to one Patient and one current Department, uses one shared examination-fee Service, and is received by one Account. It has at most one Medical Examination. |
| Status / lifecycle | WAITING \=\>IN\_PROGRESS \=\>COMPLETED; CANCELLED (cancelled before the examination starts); ABANDONED (patient leaves before the visit is completed). |

**Entity: MedicalExamination**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | The doctor’s examination record for one registration: vital signs, diagnosis and treatment decisions. |
| Key business attributes | symptoms, pulse, temperature, systolic\_bp, diastolic\_bp, respiratory\_rate, weight, height, spo2, final\_diagnosis, icd10\_code, treatment\_plan, advice, follow\_up\_date, started\_at and concluded\_at. |
| Business identity | Each Examination Registration can have at most one Medical Examination. Each Medical Examination is performed by exactly one doctor Account. |
| Status / lifecycle | Started (started\_at set) \=\>Concluded (concluded\_at set, terminal) |

**Entity: Prescription**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | The drug prescription issued by the doctor at the end of a Medical Examination. |
| Key business attributes | Creation time; list of prescribed drugs (via Prescription Detail) |
| Business identity | A Medical Examination has at most one Prescription, and a Prescription must contain at least one Prescription Detail. |
| Status / lifecycle | Created (terminal, no further changes once issued) |

**Entity: PrescriptionDetail**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | One drug line within a Prescription. |
| Key business attributes | drug\_name, quantity, unit, usage\_instruction |
| Business identity | Belongs to exactly one Prescription; each Prescription has one or more Details (one line per drug). |
| Status / lifecycle | None |

**Entity: ParaclinicalOrder**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | A request from the doctor for one or more paraclinical tests (lab, imaging, etc.) during a Medical Examination. |
| Key business attributes | Order\_code, order\_note, ordered\_time.  |
| Business identity | order\_code is unique. Belongs to one Medical Examination (which may have many Orders) and contains one or more Order Details. |
| Status / lifecycle | None |

**Entity: ParaclinicalOrderDetail**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | One requested test (a Service) within a Paraclinical Order, tracked through execution. |
| Key business attributes | status, completed\_at. |
| Business identity | Belongs to exactly one Paraclinical Order and refers to exactly one Service. It has at most one ParaclinicalResult. |
| Status / lifecycle | PENDING\_PAYMENT \=\>PAID \=\>IN\_PROGRESS  \=\>COMPLETED(terminal state); EXPIRED (terminal state, paid but not performed because status of ExaminationRegistration \= CANCELLED / ABANDONED  ). |

**Entity: ParaclinicalResult**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | The outcome of one performed test, shown to the doctor to support diagnosis. |
| Key business attributes | file\_url, result\_at, conclusion, note |
| Business identity | At most one ParaclinicalResult per Paraclinical Order Detail. |
| Status / lifecycle | Created when the test is completed. |

**Entity: Payment**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | An invoice that records what a Patient owes and pays for the exam fee or for a Paraclinical Order, split between insurance and the patient. |
| Key business attributes | invoice\_number, coverage\_rate, total\_amount, insurance\_total\_amount, patient\_total\_amount, payment\_method, status, paid\_at |
| Business identity | Invoice\_number is unique. Belongs to one Examination Registration or ParaclinicalOrder and contains one or more Payment Details. |
| Status / lifecycle | PENDING \=\>PAID (terminal); CANCELLED (terminal, transitions from PENDING when the examination session is closed before payment is made). |

**Entity: PaymentDetail**

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | One charged line within a Payment, recording the price of a Service at the time of billing. |
| Key business attributes | unit\_price, insurance\_amount, patient\_amount |
| Business identity | Belongs to exactly one Payment and refers to one Service; each Payment has one or more Details. |
| Status / lifecycle | None |

### **3.3 Data Business Rules** {#3.3-data-business-rules}

| Rule | Description | Enforced On |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Unique username | No two accounts may share the same username, regardless of role. | Account creation |
| Unique identification codes | Patient code, registration code, receipt code, receipt number and paraclinical order number must each be unique across the system (BR-53). Citizen ID and passport must each be unique when provided (BR-12).  | Patient creation, registration, order creation, payment creation |
| Records are never permanently deleted | Accounts are manually Locked and services are deactivated (status \= Inactive), not deleted. All historical examinations, orders and payments that reference them must remain accessible. | Account and service deactivation |
| Only active catalog data can be selected | Inactive services and Locked accounts cannot be selected when creating new registrations, orders or assignments. | Registration, order creation, staff assignment |
| Staff department assignment | Doctors and Technicians must belong to exactly one department. Admin, Receptionist and Cashier accounts have no department. | Account creation and update |
| Registration to clinical department only | A patient can only be registered to a department with type Clinical, and the selected examination service must be an Examination-type service. | Registration |
| Queue number per department per day | Queue numbers start from 1 each day and are assigned sequentially within each department. No two registrations of the same department on the same day may share a queue number. | Registration |
| Valid health insurance only | Insurance is applied only if the card number has 15 characters, the benefit code (3rd character) is between 1 and 5, and the expiry date is not earlier than the registration date. Otherwise the visit is treated as non-insured. | Registration and payment calculation |
| One examination per registration | Each registration has at most one medical examination, performed by a doctor of the registration’s department. | Examination start |
| Cancellation before examination only | A registration can only be cancelled while its status is Waiting and no payment has been made. A cancel reason is required. | Registration cancellation |
| Transfer must be recorded | When a doctor transfers a patient to another department, the source department, transfer reason and transfer time must all be recorded. The examination fee is not charged again for the transfer. | Patient transfer |
| Paraclinical order content | A paraclinical order must contain at least one service. Only Lab, Imaging and Functional services can be ordered, and the same service cannot appear twice in one order. | Order creation |
| One payment per order | When a paraclinical order is created, exactly one Pending payment is created for it with all prices calculated.  | Order creation |
| Unpaid services cannot be performed | Technicians can only accept and perform order items whose payment status is Paid, and only items whose service belongs to their own department. | Order item acceptance |
| One result per order item | Each order item has at most one result, which can only be entered by the performer. An order becomes Completed when all of its items are Completed. | Result entry |
| Price snapshot | Unit price, insurance amount, patient amount and coverage rate are stored at the time the payment is created. Later changes to service prices or insurance prices do not affect existing payments. | Payment creation |
| Payment calculation | for an insured examination fee, insurance amount \= insurance price × coverage rate returned by the insurance portal (UC-74), patient amount \= insurance price − insurance amount. Services without an insurance price, paraclinical services and self-paid visits are charged at the clinic price.  | Payment creation |
| Paid payments are permanent | Once a payment is Paid, its details, amounts and cashier cannot be edited or deleted by anyone. Only Pending payments can be cancelled. | Payment confirmation |
| Conclusion requires completed results | An examination can only be concluded after all of its paraclinical orders are Completed. The final diagnosis is require.  | Examination conclusion |
| One prescription per examination | Each examination has at most one prescription, which must contain at least one drug and can only be created by the examining doctor. | Prescription creation |
| Concluded examinations are permanent | After an examination is concluded, its diagnosis, results and prescription cannot be edited, so that the medical record remains an accurate history. | Examination conclusion |
| Medical data is access-controlled | Patient medical data and result files can only be viewed by authorized roles. Result files must never be accessible via a guessable or publicly shareable link; access is verified by the system on every download. | Medical record and result file access |

## 

## **4\. User Requirements** {#4.-user-requirements}

### **4.1 Actors** {#4.1-actors}

| \# | Actor | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Admin | Sets up and maintains the system. Manages staff accounts (creates accounts, assigns roles, locks/unlocks accounts, resets passwords), manages departments and assigns doctors to them, manages the service catalog (activates/deactivates services and updates prices), and views and exports statistics reports on patient visits, doctors, departments, paraclinical services and revenue. |
| 2 | Receptionist | Handles patient reception and routing. Searches for, creates and updates patient profiles; registers examinations by entering the reason for visit and initial symptoms; marks elderly, frail or disabled patients as priority; classifies the visit as health insurance (verifying the card through the simulated insurance portal) or self-paid; assigns the patient to a clinical department (clinic room) and its queue; prints the examination ticket; and cancels a registration whose exam fee has not been paid. The system creates the exam-fee payment, which the patient pays at the Cashier before the examination. |
| 3 | Doctor | Conducts the examination and concludes the visit. Views the waiting list of their department (patients whose exam fee is paid) and calls patients by queue number; records symptoms, vital signs, allergies and examination findings; transfers patients to another department if needed; orders and prints paraclinical (CLS) orders; reviews CLS results; records the final diagnosis (ICD-10) and conclusion; prescribes medication (printed for the patient, the hospital does not sell medication); creates follow-up appointments for chronic diseases; and concludes the examination, which completes the visit and locks the record. Also views the medical record history and the list of patients they have examined. Clinic nurses have no separate account and use the Doctor account. |
| 4 | Technician | Performs the paraclinical (CLS) services ordered by the Doctor (lab, imaging and functional tests) in their department. Views the list of paid services waiting in their department, calls patients, accepts and performs the services (only after the CLS payment is paid), records the results with conclusion and attached files so that they are sent to the examining Doctor, and prints the results. |
| 5 | Cashier | Collects examination and paraclinical fees (the hospital does not sell medication, so payments never include medication). Views the list of pending payments, which are created automatically: the exam-fee payment when a registration is created, and a CLS payment when the Doctor creates a paraclinical order; each payment is split into the insurance amount and the patient amount. Confirms the payment and records the payment method, after which the patient enters the department's waiting list (exam fee) or the services are sent to the paraclinical departments (CLS fee). Also prints invoices, cancels incorrect pending payments with a reason and views payment history. |

If present, a patient waiting for examination starts the examination and is assigned to the Doctor, while a patient waiting for conclusion proceeds to the conclusion step. If absent, the visit moves to the skipped list. |

| 56 | Conclude Examination | Examination Conclusion | Doctor concludes after reviewing all paraclinical results: final diagnosis (ICD-10 if available) and treatment plan. |
| 57 | Print Conclusion | Examination Conclusion | Doctor prints the examination conclusion for the patient. |
| 58 | Close Medical Record | Examination Conclusion | Doctor closes the visit after concluding and prescribing; marked Completed and no longer editable. |
| 59 | Prescribe Medication | Examination Conclusion | Doctor creates a prescription (drug, quantity, unit, usage instructions) |
| 60 | Print Prescription | Examination Conclusion | Doctor prints the prescription for the patient. |
| 61 | Create Follow-up Appointment | Examination Conclusion | Doctor sets a follow-up date and advice for the patient. |

| 68 | Print Paraclinical Result | Paraclinical Service | Technician prints the paraclinical result for the patient. |
| 69 | View Waiting Payment List | Payment | Cashier views pending payments auto-generated from exam registrations (fee) or paraclinical orders. |
| 70 | Search Payment | Payment | Cashier searches for a payment by receipt number, patient name or registration code. |
| 71 | Confirm Payment | Payment | Cashier confirms payment (method): exam fee puts the patient in the room queue; CLS order is assigned to the least busy room. |
| 72 | Print Payment Receipt | Payment | Cashier prints the payment receipt for the patient after the payment is confirmed. |
| 73 | View Payment History | Payment | Cashier views the history of payments that have been paid or cancelled. |
| 74 | Verify Health Insurance | Patient Reception | Receptionist enters the insurance number and verifies card validity (simulated insurance portal). |
| 77 | Update Clinic Facility Information  | Administration  | Admin declares and updates the clinic facility information printed on documents; the facility code is locked once a visit exists.  |

**Notes:**

Full: the actor can perform the action on all records. No: the actor cannot perform the action. Restricted: the actor can perform the action only within the scope below. Doctors have Full access to view and export the medical records of all patients (BR-35).

¹ Only the room the user is assigned to (BR-05, BR-19): the Doctor's examination room or the Technician's paraclinical room.

² Only the visit currently being served in the Doctor's assigned room and not yet Completed (BR-19, BR-32). Records of other visits are read-only.

³ Only paid (or fee-exempt) orders routed to the Technician's assigned room (BR-19, BR-26); results can only be recorded by the Technician who performed the service and cannot be edited after submission (BR-29).

⁴ Only the information needed for billing: patient administrative information, visit type, insurance coverage rate and the services billed.

⁵ Only the list of patients examined by the Doctor themselves (BR-39). This does not restrict medical record access (BR-35).

| 48 | Cashier Dashboard | Dashboard | Shows the number of pending payments and today’s collected amount |
| 49 | Payment Waiting List | Payment | Shows pending payments created from examinations and paraclinical orders |
| 50 | Detail and Confirm Payment | Payment | Shows payment lines with unit price, insurance amount and patient amount, and allows the cashier to select payment method and confirm the payment |
| 51 | Print Invoice | Payment | Prints the invoice after payment is confirmed |
| 52 | Payment History | Payment | Shows the list of collected payments with search by invoice number, patient and date |
| 53 | Detail Payment | Payment | Shows full details of a collected payment |

### 

### **5.2 External API Inventory** {#5.2-external-api-inventory}

| \# | API Name | Calling Path | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Cloudinary Upload API | Backend \=\>POST https\://api.cloudinary.com/v1\_1/{cloud\_name}/auto/upload | Uploads paraclinical result files (images, PDF) and returns a file URL stored in PARACLINICAL\_RESULT. Used on the Update Result screen. |

### **5.3 Background Job Inventory** {#5.3-background-job-inventory}

| \# | Job Name | Group | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Cancel unattended registrations | Scheduled | Daily at 23:30. Registrations still in Waiting status at the end of the day are set to ABANDONED. |
| 2 | Cancel expired pending payments | Scheduled | Daily at 23:45. Pending payments of cancelled registrations, or pending payments not paid by the end of the day, are set to Cancelled together with their paraclinical orders. |
| 3 | Reset daily queue counters | Scheduled | Daily at 00:00. Resets the queue number counter of every clinical department so that the first registration of the new day starts from 1\. |
| 4 | Aggregate daily statistics | Scheduled | Daily at 01:00. Calculates the previous day’s revenue, insurance amount, visit count, doctor performance and paraclinical service count, and stores them for the Admin statistics screens. |
| 5 | Back up database | Scheduled | Daily at 02:00. Creates a full database backup and keeps the latest 30 backups. |
| 6 | Prepare follow-up appointment list | Scheduled | Daily at 06:00. Builds the list of patients whose follow-up date is today, so receptionists can see them on the Receptionist Dashboard. |
| 7 | Unlock temporarily locked accounts | Scheduled | Every 15 minutes. Unlocks accounts that were locked after too many failed login attempts once the lock period has expired. |
| 8 | Notify doctor of completed results | Event-driven | Triggered when all items of a paraclinical order are completed. Sets the order to Completed, moves the registration to Pending Conclusion, and sends a real-time notification to the examining doctor. |
| 10 | Update waiting lists after payment | Event-driven | Triggered when a payment is confirmed. Sets the related paraclinical order to Paid and pushes its services to the waiting lists of the performing departments. |

# **II. Use Case Specifications** {#ii.-use-case-specifications}

## **1\. Authentication & Profile** {#1.-authentication-&-profile}

### **1.1 UC-01: Login** {#1.1-uc-01:-login}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a staff member, I want to sign in with my username and password so that I can use only the functions of my role (BR-02) and, for Doctors and Technicians, the patients and services of the room I am assigned to (BR-05, BR-19).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The user has an account created by the Admin (UC-07). The user is not signed in on this browser. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The user opens the system URL or a protected page. The system displays the “Đăng nhập” screen with “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu” (hidden, with the “Hiện mật khẩu” / “Ẩn mật khẩu” icon), the “Ghi nhớ phiên đăng nhập” checkbox, the “Quên mật khẩu?” link and the “Đăng nhập” button. The user enters the username and password and clicks “Đăng nhập” (or presses Enter). The system checks that both fields are filled in. The system finds the account by username. The username is not case-sensitive, and leading and trailing spaces are ignored.  The system checks that password sign-in for the account is not temporarily blocked after repeated failed attempts (Security: Account lockout, IV.2.3). The system checks the password (BR-01). The error message never says whether the username or the password is wrong. The system checks that the account is not Locked (BR-01).  The system resets the failed sign-in count of the account to 0, saves the last sign-in time, creates a new session and records the sign-in in the security audit log. The system checks whether the account must change its password (new account or password reset by the Admin).  The system opens the home screen of the user’s role (UI-02) and shows only the menu items allowed for the role (BR-02, Permission Matrix 4.4): 11.1. Admin: Admin Dashboard. 11.2. Receptionist: Receptionist Dashboard. 11.3. Doctor: Doctor Dashboard (waiting list of the doctor’s assigned room). 11.4. Technician: Technician Dashboard (paraclinical waiting list of the technician’s assigned room). 11.5. Cashier: Cashier Dashboard (waiting payment list).  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): The user already has a valid session 1.1. The system restores the session stored in the browser and skips the “Đăng nhập” screen.1.2. The use case continues at step 11\. AF-02 (at step 10): The password must be changed 2.1. The sign-in succeeds, but the resulting session is restricted. 2.2. Until the password is changed, the user may only change the password through UC-03, and log out through UC-02. Updating the profile and accessing other business functions are prohibited. 2.3. The backend rejects every other protected request, independently of the user’s normal role permissions. 2.4. The system shows MSG44 and opens the “Đổi mật khẩu” screen. 2.5. After the password is successfully changed, the system renews the session without the restriction and continues at step 11\.  AF-03 (at step 11): A Doctor or Technician has no active room assignment  3.1. The system determines whether the Doctor or Technician has an active room assignment. 3.2. If no active room assignment exists, the system opens the role’s home screen and shows MSG48. 3.3. Room-dependent waiting lists and work functions are unavailable or empty. 3.4. Other authorized functions that do not depend on a room remain available. 3.5. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): A field is empty 1.1. The “Đăng nhập” button remains disabled until both fields contain non-blank values. 1.2. If a request with an empty field still reaches the backend, the web client maps the validation response to MSG02. 1.3. Raw backend error messages are not displayed. 1.4. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-02 (at steps 5 or 7): The username does not exist or the password is wrong 2.1. The system shows MSG09 without saying which field is wrong.2.2. If the username exists, the system adds 1 to its failed sign-in count and records the failed attempt in the audit log.2.3. The system clears the “Mật khẩu” field.2.4. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 7): Fifth consecutive wrong password 3.1. The system records the fifth consecutive failed sign-in attempt in the security audit log. 3.2. The system blocks password sign-in for the account for 15 minutes and resets the failed sign-in count to 0\. 3.3. The system records the temporary block in the security audit log. 3.4. The system shows MSG11: “Bạn đã nhập sai quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau 15 phút.” 3.5. No authenticated session is created. 3.6. The block ends automatically after 15 minutes and does not change the account status to Locked. 3.7. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 6): Password sign-in is temporarily blocked 4.1. The system refuses the sign-in even if the entered password is correct. 4.2. The system shows MSG11: “Bạn đã nhập sai quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau 15 phút.” 4.3. The system records the failed sign-in attempt in the security audit log. 4.4. The failed sign-in count does not increase and the current block expiry time does not change. 4.5. No authenticated session is created. 4.6. The use case ends.  EF-05 (at step 8): The account is Locked 5.1. The system refuses the sign-in even if the entered password is correct. 5.2. The system shows MSG10: “Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.” 5.3. The system records the failed sign-in attempt in the security audit log. 5.4. No authenticated session is created and the account remains Locked. 5.5. Only the Admin can unlock the account through UC-10. 5.6. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 5–9): Server, system or network error  6.1. The web client maps the error to MSG80. 6.2. Raw backend messages, exception text and English infrastructure errors are not displayed. 6.3. No session is created. 6.4. The user remains on the “Đăng nhập” screen and may retry. 6.5. The use case returns to step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the user has a session, sees the home screen and menu of their role, and the sign-in is recorded in the audit log. The access token is valid for 15 minutes and is renewed automatically while the session is active. The session ends after 2 hours without activity, 12 hours after sign-in at the latest (Security: Session timeout, IV.2.3), or by Logout (UC-02). Failure: no session is created; failed attempts on existing accounts are counted and logged; password sign-in may be blocked for 15 minutes (EF-03).  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02; Permission Matrix 4.4. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG09, MSG10,MSG11,MSG13,MSG44, MSG48, MSG80 |  |  |

### **1.2 UC-02: Logout** {#1.2-uc-02:-logout}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----- | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a staff member, I want to sign out so that my session ends and nobody else can use my account on a shared workstation (for example at shift change).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The user is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The user opens the account menu in the header and clicks “Đăng xuất”. The web client sends a logout request containing the current refresh-token cookie. The system verifies that the request originates from the permitted clinic web application. If the refresh token identifies an active session, the system revokes that session. Other sessions belonging to the same account remain active. The system records the logout in the security audit log when an active session is successfully revoked. The system clears the refresh-token cookie. Whether the server request succeeds or fails, the web client clears its locally stored access token and authentication state. The system displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The session has already ended or expired 1.1. The system does not find an active session to revoke. 1.2. No new logout audit entry is created. 1.3. The system still clears the refresh-token cookie and returns a successful logout response. 1.4. The web client clears its authentication state and displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. AF-02 (after step 4): The system is open in another browser tab 2.1. Revoking the server session prevents the refresh token from being used again. 2.2. An access token already issued to another tab may remain usable until it expires. 2.3. When that tab attempts to refresh the session, the request is rejected and the user must sign in again. AF-03 (before step 1): Automatic session expiration 3.1. The session expires after its configured inactivity or absolute lifetime. 3.2. When the web client can no longer refresh the session, it clears its authentication state and displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. 3.3. The user signs in again through UC-01. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 3): The logout request does not originate from the permitted web application 1.1. The server rejects the request with Forbidden. 1.2. No server session is revoked. 1.3. The current web client still clears its local authentication state and displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. EF-02 (at step 2): The server cannot be reached 2.1. The web client still clears its local access token and authentication state. 2.2. The system displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. 2.3. The server session remains valid until it expires or is revoked later. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the current server session is revoked when it exists, the refresh-token cookie is cleared, and the current web client holds no authentication state. An audit entry is created only when an active server session is actually revoked. Server or network failure: the current web client clears its local authentication state and displays the Login screen, but the server session may remain valid until it expires or is revoked later. The current implementation does not check for unsaved form data and does not display an unsaved-data confirmation before logout.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-42. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12 |  |  |

### **1.3 UC-03: Change Password** {#1.3-uc-03:-change-password}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier  | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----- | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a staff member, I want to change my own password after entering my current password, so that my account stays secure (for example after the Admin has reset it). A forgotten password can only be reset by the Admin (UC-11, BR-03).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The user is signed in (UC-01) and the account is Active.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The user selects “Đổi mật khẩu” from the account menu in the header or from “Hồ sơ cá nhân”. The system displays “Mật khẩu hiện tại”\*, “Mật khẩu mới”\* and “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới”\* (hidden, with “Hiện” / “Ẩn” icons).2.1. Under “Mật khẩu mới”, a live counter shows the number of characters and UTF-8 bytes.2.2. The “Yêu cầu mật khẩu” panel shows in real time whether each rule is met: “Từ 8 đến 64 ký tự”, “Không quá 72 byte UTF-8”, “Khác mật khẩu hiện tại”, “Hai mật khẩu mới trùng khớp”. The user fills in the three fields and clicks “Đổi mật khẩu”. The web client checks that all three fields are filled in. The web client checks that “Mật khẩu mới” has 8 to 64 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (Security: Password protection, IV.2.3). The web client checks that “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới” matches “Mật khẩu mới”. The web client checks that “Mật khẩu mới” is different from “Mật khẩu hiện tại”. The web client sends the current password and the new password. “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới” is not sent to the backend. The system checks that the account is still Active. The system checks that password sign-in for the account is not temporarily blocked. The system checks that “Mật khẩu hiện tại” is correct (BR-03). The system repeats the password-policy check and checks that the new password differs from the current password. The system saves the new password in protected form, clears the must-change-password flag, resets the failed attempt count and clears any temporary sign-in block. The system ends all other sessions of this account. The current session stays active. The system records the change in the security audit log. The password itself is never logged. The web client shows MSG15, renews the session and opens the home screen of the user’s role. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (before step 1): Required change after account creation or password reset1.1. Right after sign-in (UC-01, AF-02), the system opens the “Đổi mật khẩu” screen and shows MSG44.1.2. The menu is disabled. The user can only change the password or log out (UC-02).1.3. The “Hủy” button is not shown.1.4. The backend rejects every other business request of this session.1.5. The use case continues at step 2\. After step 16, the renewed session no longer has the restriction. AF-02 (at step 3): The user clicks “Hủy”2.1. The system closes the “Đổi mật khẩu” screen and returns to the previous screen.2.2. Nothing is changed.2.3. This flow is not available in AF-01.2.4. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 1): The user has forgotten the current password3.1. The user cannot use this function and asks the Admin to reset the password (UC-11).3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): A field is empty1.1. The system shows MSG02 under each empty field: “Mật khẩu hiện tại là bắt buộc.”, “Mật khẩu mới là bắt buộc.”, “Mật khẩu xác nhận là bắt buộc.”1.2. No request is sent.1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 5 or 12): “Mật khẩu mới” breaks the password rule2.1. The system shows MSG41 in the form-level error area.2.2. The password is not changed.2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 6): The confirmation does not match3.1. The system shows MSG42 in the form-level error area.3.2. No request is sent.3.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 7 or 12): “Mật khẩu mới” equals “Mật khẩu hiện tại”4.1. The system shows “Mật khẩu mới phải khác mật khẩu hiện tại.” in the form-level error area.4.2. The password is not changed.4.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-05 (at step 11): “Mật khẩu hiện tại” is wrong5.1. The system shows MSG14 under “Mật khẩu hiện tại”.5.2. The system adds 1 to the failed attempt count. This is the same count used by sign-in (UC-01).5.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-06 (at step 11): Fifth consecutive wrong password6.1. The system blocks password sign-in for the account for 15 minutes and resets the failed attempt count to 0\.6.2. The system records the block in the security audit log and shows MSG14.6.3. The current session stays active.6.4. While the block lasts, every attempt is refused with MSG14, even with the correct “Mật khẩu hiện tại”. Sign-in from the “Đăng nhập” screen is also refused (UC-01, EF-04).6.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-07 (at step 9): The account was locked by the Admin during the session7.1. The system refuses the change.7.2. The system ends the session, shows MSG12 and opens the “Đăng nhập” screen.7.3. The use case ends. EF-08 (at steps 8–15): Server, network or system error8.1. The system shows MSG80.8.2. The old password stays valid.8.3. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: only the new password works, and the must-change-password flag is cleared. All other sessions of the account are ended. The current session stays active and is renewed without restriction. The change is recorded in the security audit log. Failure or cancellation: the password is not changed. Wrong current passwords are counted and may block password sign-in for 15 minutes (EF-06). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-03; Security: Password protection, Account lockout, Audit trail (IV.2.3).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG12, MSG14, MSG15, MSG41, MSG42, MSG44, MSG80.  |  |  |

### 

### **1.4 UC-04: Update Profile** {#1.4-uc-04:-update-profile}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a staff member, I want to view and update my own phone number and email in “Hồ sơ cá nhân” so that my contact information stays accurate. The phone number is required; email is optional. Only these two fields can be changed by the account owner (BR-04). Changes are recorded for Admin-only review; viewing change history is outside this use case. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The user is signed in (UC-01) with a valid session. The account is Active and the user is allowed to access their own profile.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The user opens “Hồ sơ cá nhân”. The system retrieves the signed-in account and displays the current profile. “Số điện thoại” and “Email” are editable. All other account, personal, work-assignment and security information is read-only. The user changes “Số điện thoại” and/or “Email”. The “Lưu thay đổi” button becomes enabled only when at least one editable value differs from the originally loaded value. The user clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The web client validates the submitted phone number and optional email. The system verifies the session, the Active account status and that the request modifies only the signed-in account’s editable contact fields. The system checks that the phone number and any non-empty email are not used by another account, including Locked accounts. Email comparison is case-insensitive. The system saves the changed contact values atomically. The system creates one account change-history record containing all fields that actually changed, their previous and new values, the signed-in account as the actor, and the change time.  The system returns the updated profile. The web client displays MSG03 with item \= “Hồ sơ”:  “Hồ sơ cập nhật thành công.” |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): Clear the optional Email 1.1. The user clears “Email”. 1.2. The system accepts the empty value. 1.3. The use case continues with validation and saving. AF-02 (at steps 4–6): Cancel editing 2.1. The user clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 2.2. The system leaves the profile screen and returns to the previous screen. 2.3. Unsaved values are discarded without a confirmation dialog. AF-03 (at step 5): No values have changed 3.1. The “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled. 3.2. No update request is sent. 3.3. No account change-history entry is created. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 7): “Số điện thoại” is missing 1.1. The system shows MSG02 under “Số điện thoại” and saves nothing.1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 7): Invalid “Số điện thoại” or “Email” format, or “Email” is too long 2.1. If Phone or Email has an invalid format, the system displays MSG05 under the corresponding field:      \- “Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng.”      \- “Email không đúng định dạng.” 2.2. If Email exceeds 100 characters, the system displays MSG08:      “Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 100 ký tự.” 2.3. The invalid field is marked as invalid. 2.4. No profile or change-history data is saved. 2.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 9): “Số điện thoại” or “Email” is already used by another account 3.1. If Phone is already used, the system displays MSG07:      “Số điện thoại đã tồn tại trong hệ thống.” 3.2. If Email is already used, the system displays MSG07:      “Email đã tồn tại trong hệ thống.” 3.3. The conflicting field is marked as invalid. 3.4. No profile or change-history data is saved. 3.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 8): Session expired or invalid 4.1. The system shows MSG12, rejects the update and opens Login; nothing is saved.4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at step 8): The account was locked/deactivated during the session 5.1. The system rejects the update and shows MSG12.5.2. No profile or history changes are committed.5.3. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 9–10): Concurrent duplicate or system/database error 6.1. The system detects a uniqueness conflict or a system/database error. 6.2. If a uniqueness conflict occurs, the system displays MSG07 under the conflicting field. The profile and change history remain unchanged, and the use case returns to step 3\. 6.3. If a system/database error occurs, the system displays MSG80:      “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.” 6.4. The profile and change history remain unchanged. 6.5. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the signed-in account contains the new phone number and optional email. One account change-history record is created for the update and contains every field that actually changed, together with its previous and new values. Cancelled: the user leaves the profile screen and no data is saved. Unchanged: the “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled; no update request or history entry is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-04, BR-42, BR-60, BR-61; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Own profile – Update phone and email). |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12,MSG80 |  |  |

## **2\. Account Management** {#2.-account-management}

### **2.1 UC-05: View Account List** {#2.1-uc-05:-view-account-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view all staff accounts, including Admin and Locked accounts, and search, filter and sort them so that I can quickly find an account to view or manage. Only Admin can access this list. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Quản lý tài khoản” in the menu. The system displays the “Quản lý tài khoản” screen with: 2.1. Search box “Tìm theo tên đăng nhập, họ tên, số điện thoại hoặc email...”. 2.2. Filters “Tất cả vai trò”, “Tất cả khoa”, “Tất cả trạng thái”, and the “Đặt lại” button. 2.3. Filter values use the Vietnamese labels Quản trị viên, Lễ tân, Bác sĩ, Kỹ thuật viên, Thu ngân; Hoạt động and Đã khóa. 2.4. The “Tạo tài khoản” button. 2.5. Table columns “Tên đăng nhập”, “Họ và tên”, “Khoa / Phòng”, “Vai trò”, “Liên hệ”, “Trạng thái” and “Đăng nhập cuối”. There is no separate “Thao tác” column. Each account row is clickable and opens its detail screen. Missing room assignments show “Chưa phân phòng”. 2.6. Paging with 10 rows per page by default, selectable page sizes 10, 20 and 50, and the total number of accounts. The default sort is creation time, newest first. The Admin enters a search keyword and/or selects filters.  After a short debounce, the system updates the list without reloading the page and returns to page 1\. Search matches username, full name, phone number or email, ignores letter case and Vietnamese accents, and combines search and filters using AND.  The Admin clicks or activates an account row. The system opens “Chi tiết tài khoản” (UC-06). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Sort the list 1.1. The Admin clicks the header “Tên đăng nhập”, “Họ và tên”, “Vai trò”, “Trạng thái” or “Đăng nhập cuối”.1.2. The system sorts the list in ascending order; a second click sorts it in descending order.1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 3): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin selects another page or changes the number of rows per page (10, 20, 50).2.2. The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search, filters and sort.2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-03 (at step 3): Clear search and filters 3.1. The Admin clicks “Đặt lại”. 3.2. The system clears the search keyword and resets Role, Department and Status to “Tất cả”. 3.3. The system restores the default sort: creation time, newest first. 3.4. The system returns to page 1 and reloads the account list. 3.5. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-04 (at step 2): Create a new account 4.1. The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản” (UC-07).4.2. The system opens the account creation form. The form excludes Admin from the selectable roles; existing Admin accounts remain visible in the account list.4.3. The use case continues in UC-07. AF-05 (at step 2): Return from another account screen 5.1. The Admin returns from UC-06 or UC-07. 5.2. When returning from UC-06, the system keeps the current search, filters, sort, page and page size. 5.3. After an account is successfully created in UC-07, the system reloads the account data and resets the list to page 1 while keeping the current search, filters and sort. 5.4. The use case continues at step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): No account matches 1.1. The system displays MSG01 in the account table:      “Không tìm thấy kết quả.” 1.2. The search box and selected filters remain unchanged. 1.3. The Admin remains on the account list and may change or reset the criteria. 1.4. No account data is changed. 1.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system refuses access and displays MSG13:      “Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.” 2.2. A direct request to the account-list or account-department API returns HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN. 2.3. No account information is disclosed. 2.4. The use case ends.  EF-03 (at steps 2–4): Session expired or system error 3.1. If the session is invalid or expired, the web client clears its authentication state, displays MSG12: “Phiên đăng nhập của bạn đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” and opens the Login screen. 3.2. If the account list or department filters cannot be retrieved because of a system error, the system displays MSG80:      “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.” 3.3. No account data is changed. 3.4. The Admin may retry the operation. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The accounts matching the criteria are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-110; Permission Matrix 4.4 (User account – View list: Admin only). |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.2 UC-06: View Account Detail** {#2.2-uc-06:-view-account-detail}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view detailed information, authentication activity and account change history for any staff account or my own seeded Admin account, so that I can review its status and manage it through authorized actions. The system has only one seeded Admin account; no additional Admin account can be created or assigned. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin clicks or activates an account row in the account list. The system retrieves the selected account and opens the “Chi tiết tài khoản” screen in read-only mode.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks or activates an account row in the account list.  The system retrieves the selected account and displays its details in read-only mode, including: Account Information: “Tên đăng nhập”, “Vai trò”, “Trạng thái”, “Ngày tạo”, “Người tạo”. Personal Information: “Họ và tên”, “Học hàm / học vị”, “Số giấy phép hành nghề”, “Mã liên thông bác sĩ” ,“Ngày sinh”, “Giới tính”, “Số điện thoại”, “Email”, “Địa chỉ”. Assignment Information: For Doctor and Technician accounts, the system displays “Khoa”, “Phòng” and assignment details. If no room is assigned, the system displays “Chưa được phân công”. For other roles, the system displays “Không áp dụng cho vai trò này”. Security Information: Last sign-in time, consecutive failed sign-in attempts, account lock status, temporary sign-in blocking information (if applicable), last password change time and whether a password change is required. Recent Activities: The system retrieves up to the 100 most recent recorded sign-in, sign-out and failed sign-in events. The events are displayed in pages of five records, including timestamp, action and IP address where available.  Account Change History: Account changes are displayed in pages of five records, including field label, old value, new value, changed by and changed at. Changes made through UC-04 and UC-08 are included when recorded. The Admin can navigate to older change records.  Passwords, password hashes, and initial or temporary passwords are never displayed. The details of Locked accounts remain accessible to authorized Admin users. The system displays the management actions permitted for the selected account, based on the current Admin's permissions, the selected account's role, status and applicable business rules: “Chỉnh sửa tài khoản”; “Đổi vai trò”; “Khóa tài khoản” or “Mở khóa tài khoản”; “Đặt lại mật khẩu”; “Quay lại”. Protected system Admin accounts and the currently signed-in Admin's own account are subject to the applicable management restrictions. Unavailable actions are hidden or disabled according to the UI specification. The Admin selects an available management action or clicks “Quay lại”. If a management action is selected, the system opens the corresponding use case. If “Quay lại” is selected, the system returns to the account list. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): Click “Quay lại” 1.1. The system returns to the account list preserving the previous search, filters, sort order, page and page size (UC-05, AF-05). 1.2. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 6): Perform an account action 2.1. The Admin selects an available account-management action. 2.2. The system opens UC-08, UC-09, UC-10, UC-11 as appropriate. 2.3. After a successful action, the web client updates the cached account detail and refreshes the account list. 2.4. The system returns to or remains on “Chi tiết tài khoản”, depending on the completed action. AF-03 (at steps 4–5): View the requester’s own Admin account 3.1. The Admin may view their own account detail, recent authentication activity and change history. 3.2. “Đổi vai trò”, “Khóa tài khoản” / “Mở khóa tài khoản”, “Đặt lại mật khẩu” and room-assignment actions are unavailable. 3.3. The Admin changes their own password through UC-03 and updates their own phone/email through UC-04. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The account does not exist 1.1. The system shows MSG39 and a button to return to the list. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system refuses access and shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (and opens the “Đăng nhập” screen) or MSG80. 3.2. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the selected account’s details, authentication activities and paginated change history are available to the Admin. Viewing a Locked account is allowed. Viewing the signed-in Admin’s own account is allowed. No account data is changed. Failure: account details are not displayed when access is denied, the account does not exist or the session is invalid. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-05, BR-42, BR-112; BR-49, BR-65, Permission Matrix 4.4. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.3 UC-07: Create Account** {#2.3-uc-07:-create-account}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to create a staff account with login information, exactly one non-Admin role and personal details, so that a new staff member can sign in. Admin cannot create another Admin account through this use case. Staff cannot register themselves. Clinic nurses have no separate account and work under the Doctor account (Actors 4.1). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản” on the account list. The system opens “Tạo tài khoản”. The form contains: “Tên đăng nhập”\*; “Vai trò”\*: Lễ tân, Bác sĩ, Kỹ thuật viên or Thu ngân; “Họ và tên”\*; “Học hàm / học vị”; “Số giấy phép hành nghề”; “Ngày sinh”; “Giới tính”; “Số điện thoại”\*; “Email”; “Địa chỉ”. The Admin role is not selectable. Account creation supports GENERATE and MANUAL password modes, and both modes are available on the web form. 4.1 In GENERATE mode, the system generates a temporary password and the staff member must change it after the first successful sign-in. 4.2 In MANUAL mode, the Admin enters the initial password and the staff member is not required to change it after the first successful sign-in. The Admin completes the form and clicks “Tạo tài khoản”. The web client validates the required fields and field formats. “Học hàm / học vị” and “Số giấy phép hành nghề” are required for Bác sĩ and Kỹ thuật viên.  The web client sends the account information, the selected password mode and a newly generated submission ID. 7.1.For GENERATE mode, initialPassword is empty. 7.2For MANUAL mode, the request includes the password entered by the Admin in initialPassword. The system validates the request and checks the uniqueness of username, phone number, any non-empty email and any non-empty practice-license number across all accounts, including Locked accounts. In GENERATE mode, the backend generates a 12-character temporary password. In MANUAL mode, the system validates initialPassword against the policy of 8–64 Unicode characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. The password confirmation must match. In either mode, only the secure password hash is stored. An invalid or mismatched manual password is rejected without creating the account. The system creates an Active account with the selected non-Admin role and no room assignment. In GENERATE mode, passwordChangeRequired \= Yes. In MANUAL mode, passwordChangeRequired \= No. The system records the account creation in the audit log without recording the plaintext password or its hash. The system returns the new account ID and the generated or manually supplied initial password once. In GENERATE mode, the password is returned as a temporary password and passwordChangeRequired \= Yes. In MANUAL mode, the password is returned as the official initial password and passwordChangeRequired \= No. The web client retrieves the created account detail. The system displays “Đã tạo tài khoản” and the “Sao chép” button. In GENERATE mode, the password label is “Mật khẩu tạm thời” and the system states that the staff member must change it at first sign-in. In MANUAL mode, the password label is “Mật khẩu chính thức” and the system states that the staff member is not required to change it at first sign-in. The Admin selects “Xem chi tiết”, “Tạo tài khoản khác” or “Về danh sách”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 14): Create another account 1.1. The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản khác”. 1.2. The system clears the result and opens a new empty creation form. AF-02 (at step 14): View the created account 1\. The Admin clicks “Xem chi tiết”. 2\. The system opens UC-06 for the created account. AF-03 (at step 14): Return to the account list 3.1. The Admin clicks “Về danh sách”. 3.2. The system returns to UC-05. AF-04 (at step 4): Cancel account creation 4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 4.2. The system immediately returns to the previous screen. 4.3. No account is created. 4.4. The current implementation does not show an unsaved-data confirmation. AF-05 (after step 9): Doctor or Technician account 5.1. The account is created without a room assignment. 5.2. The success result displays:    “Tài khoản chưa được phân công phòng. Phân công phòng làm việc ở chức năng Khoa / Phòng.” 5.3. Room assignment is completed separately. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Required field empty, invalid format or value too long 1.1. The web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese validation message under each invalid field. 1.2. It also displays “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.” 1.3. The request is not sent until client-side errors are corrected. 1.4. In MANUAL mode, an invalid password displays MSG41, and a mismatched confirmation displays MSG42 in the form's common error area.  1.5. No account is created. EF-02 (at step 7): Username, phone number, non-empty email or non-empty practice-license number already exists 2.1. The system rejects the request with Conflict. 2.2. The web client displays the corresponding duplicate-field error. 2.3. No account is created. EF-03 (at step 9): Concurrent uniqueness conflict 3.1. A database uniqueness constraint detects a conflict during account creation. 3.2. The transaction is rolled back. 3.3. The web client displays the corresponding duplicate-data error. 3.4. No account is created. EF-04 (at steps 6–9): Unauthorized requester, expired session or system error 4.1. The system rejects a non-Admin requester or an expired session. 4.2. For a network or system error, the web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 4.3. No account is created. EF-05 (at step 5): The practice-license number is missing5.1. The selected role is Doctor or Technician.5.2. “Số giấy phép hành nghề” is empty.5.3. The system shows MSG02 under “Số giấy phép hành nghề”.5.4. No account is created.5.5. The use case returns to the account-creation form. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: a new Active account exists with exactly one non-Admin role. Doctor/Technician accounts may be unassigned to a room and cannot perform room-dependent work until assigned (UC-15). In GENERATE mode, the user can sign in with the temporary password and must change it before continuing. In MANUAL mode, the user can sign in with the Admin-entered password and is not required to change it.. The creation is audited without recording the password. Failure / Cancelled: no account is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05, BR-42, BR-49, BR-57, BR-58, BR-59, BR-60, BR-61, BR-62, BR-63, BR-64, BR-138. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG41, MSG42, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.4 UC-08: Update Account Information** {#2.4-uc-08:-update-account-information}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the personal and contact information of another non-Admin staff account so that the account displays the latest staff information. The seeded Admin account and the requester’s own account cannot be updated through UC-08. Locked non-Admin accounts may be updated without being unlocked. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in and viewing another staff account in UC-06. The target must not be the Admin's own account; Locked staff accounts may be updated without being unlocked. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Chỉnh sửa tài khoản” on another non-Admin staff account. The system opens “Cập nhật thông tin tài khoản”. The screen displays the account’s current information.                   The editable fields are: “Họ và tên”; “Học hàm / học vị”; “Số giấy phép hành nghề”; “Mã liên thông bác sĩ” (displayed and editable only for Doctor accounts; optional).  “Ngày sinh”; “Giới tính”; “Số điện thoại”; “Email”; “Địa chỉ”.                “Tên đăng nhập” and “Trạng thái” are displayed as disabled fields.The current role is displayed but cannot be changed on this screen. The Admin changes one or more editable values. The “Lưu thay đổi” button becomes enabled only after an editable value differs from the originally loaded value. The Admin clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The web client validates the form. The system verifies Admin authorization, rejects the seeded Admin account and self-administration, and checks the submitted account version. The system validates all editable fields, including “Số giấy phép hành nghề” and “Mã liên thông bác sĩ”.  The system checks the uniqueness of the phone number, any non-empty email and any non-empty practice-license number and any non-empty Mã liên thông bác sĩ  across all accounts, including Locked accounts. The system atomically saves all changed editable fields while preserving the username, role and account status. For every stored field whose value actually changes, the system records a separate account change-history entry containing the field, old value, new value, Admin and change time. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client updates its cached account detail, refreshes the account list and returns to the previous screen. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 6–8): Restore the form 1.1. The Admin clicks “Khôi phục”. 1.2. The system restores all editable fields to the values originally loaded. 1.3. The “Lưu thay đổi” and “Khôi phục” buttons become disabled. AF-02 (at steps 6–8): Cancel editing 2.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 2.2. The system returns to the previous screen immediately. 2.3. Unsaved changes are discarded without an unsaved-data confirmation. AF-03 (at step 7): No values have changed 3.1. The “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled. 3.2. No update request is sent. 3.3. No change-history entry is created.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 9): Invalid field value 1.1. The web client displays the Vietnamese validation message under the invalid field. 1.2. It also displays “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.” 1.3. No update request is sent until the client-side errors are corrected. EF-02 (at step 12): A unique account field already exists  2.1. The system detects that the submitted phone number, non-empty email or non-empty practice-license number or non-empty Mã liên thông bác sĩ belongs to another account. 2.2. The system shows MSG07 under each conflicting field. 2.3. No account or change-history data is changed. 2.4. The use case returns to step 6\.  EF-03 (at step 10): Protected account or self-update 3.1. The system rejects updating an account having the ADMIN role. 3.2. The web client displays “Không thể thực hiện thao tác này trên tài khoản Quản trị viên.” 3.3. A direct self-update request is also rejected. 3.4. No account or history change is committed. EF-04 (at step 10): Concurrent modification 4.1. The account version no longer matches the loaded version. 4.2. The system rejects the update with Conflict. 4.3. The web client displays “Tài khoản vừa được thay đổi bởi thao tác khác. Vui lòng tải lại trang rồi thử lại.” 4.4. No account or history change is committed. EF-05 (at steps 10–15): Unauthorized requester, expired session, network failure or system error 5.1. The system rejects an unauthorized requester or expired session. 5.2. The web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 5.3. No account or history change is committed. EF-06 (at step 10): Mã liên thông bác sĩ submitted for a non-Doctor account 6.1. The system rejects the request because only a Doctor account holds a Mã liên thông bác sĩ. 6.2. No account or history change is committed.  |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Success: all submitted editable personal and contact fields, including “Số giấy phép hành nghề” and, for a Doctor, “Mã liên thông bác sĩ”, contain their new values. Username, role and account status remain unchanged. A separate account change-history entry exists for each stored field whose value actually changed. Cancelled: no update request is sent and no change-history entry is created. Unchanged: the “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled; no update request is sent and no change-history entry is created. Failure: no account or change-history data is partially committed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-42, BR-49, BR-59, BR-60, BR-61, BR-62, BR-64, BR-65, BR-112, BR-119; Permission Matrix 4.4. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG45, MSG46, MSG75, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.5 UC-09: Assign Role** {#2.5-uc-09:-assign-role}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----- | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to change a staff account’s role among Receptionist, Doctor, Technician and Cashier so that it matches the staff member’s work. Each account has exactly one role (BR-02). When the new role is Doctor or Technician, the Admin also enters the academic title and practice-license number in the same step, so that every Doctor or Technician account always has them (I1-D47). The sole Admin account is seeded at system initialization; UC-09 cannot assign the Admin role or change the seeded Admin’s role.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and is viewing the target staff account in UC-06. The target account is a non-Admin staff account other than the Admin’s own account.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Đổi vai trò” on the account detail (UC-06). The system opens “Phân quyền tài khoản” and shows the account summary, the current role with its permissions, and the selectable roles “Lễ tân”, “Bác sĩ”, “Kỹ thuật viên” and “Thu ngân”. “Quản trị viên” is not selectable. The Admin selects a new role. The system previews the permissions of the selected role. “Áp dụng vai trò” stays disabled until the selected role differs from the current role. If the current role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên and the account has a room, the screen warns that the current room assignment will be removed. If the selected role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, the screen shows the section “Thông tin chuyên môn” with the required fields “Học hàm / học vị” (at most 50 characters) and “Số giấy phép hành nghề” (5–50 letters, digits, “/” or “-”, unique). Both are prefilled with the account’s current values. The screen also reminds the Admin to assign a room after the role change. For Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, the Admin enters or confirms the academic title and practice-license number. The Admin clicks “Áp dụng vai trò”. The web client checks the professional fields and calls the role-change check with newRole, expectedRole and, for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, academicTitle and practiceLicenseNo. The system verifies that: the account and the new role are non-Admin; the account is not the Admin’s own; the role has actually changed; the stored role still matches expectedRole; for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, both professional fields are present and valid, and no other account uses the practice-license number. The system counts the visits In Examination and the paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account and returns the counts. If there is no work in progress, the web client opens “Xác nhận đổi vai trò” (MSG06). It shows the username, old role, new role, the possible room removal and the warning that all active sessions will be signed out. The Admin clicks “Đổi vai trò”. The system repeats the checks of steps 8 and 9\. In one transaction the system: changes the role; for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, saves the academic title and practice-license number; removes the active room assignment when the previous role was Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên; keeps the Active/Locked status; revokes all sessions of the account. The system records the change in the account history (the role, plus the academic title and practice-license number when they changed) and records the security audit event. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client displays “Đã đổi vai trò của \[username\] thành \[new role\]” and opens the updated account detail (UC-06). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 3–6): Cancel the role-selection page1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”.1.2. The system returns to UC-06.1.3. Nothing is changed. AF-02 (at step 11): Cancel the confirmation2.1. The Admin closes “Xác nhận đổi vai trò”.2.2. The system returns to the role-selection page with the selected role and entered values kept.2.3. Nothing is changed. AF-03 (at step 4): The new role is Lễ tân or Thu ngân3.1. The section “Thông tin chuyên môn” is not shown, and the request carries no professional fields.3.2. The stored academic title and practice-license number are kept unchanged.3.3. The use case continues at step 6\. AF-04 (after step 16): The new role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên4.1. The web client reminds the Admin to assign a room through UC-15 from the account detail.4.2. Until an active room is assigned, the staff member’s room-dependent waiting lists and work functions are unavailable (MSG48).4.3. The use case ends. AF-05 (at step 13): The account is Locked5.1. The role change is allowed and the account stays Locked.5.2. It cannot sign in until unlocked through UC-10.5.3. The use case continues at step 14\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 1 or 8): The Admin targets their own account1.1. “Đổi vai trò” is not shown on the Admin’s own account.1.2. A direct API request is rejected with MSG45.1.3. Nothing is changed.1.4. The use case ends. EF-02 (at steps 1 or 8): The seeded Admin account or the Admin role is targeted2.1. The system rejects the request and shows MSG46.2.2. Nothing is changed.2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at steps 7, 8 or 12): Missing or invalid professional information for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên3.1. If “Học hàm / học vị” or “Số giấy phép hành nghề” is empty, the system shows MSG02 under the field.3.2. If “Học hàm / học vị” is longer than 50 characters, the system shows MSG08 under the field.3.3. If “Số giấy phép hành nghề” does not have 5–50 letters, digits, “/” or “-”, the system shows MSG05 under the field.3.4. If another account already uses the practice-license number, the system shows MSG07 under the field.3.5. Nothing is changed, and the use case returns to step 5\. EF-04 (at step 8): The selected role is the same as the current role4.1. The interface prevents this by keeping “Áp dụng vai trò” disabled.4.2. A direct API request is rejected; nothing is updated or audited.4.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-05 (at steps 9 or 12): The staff member has work in progress5.1. At step 9 the web client does not open the confirmation and displays: “Không thể đổi vai trò: còn \[visits\] lượt khám và \[orders\] chỉ định đang xử lý.”5.2. If work started between steps 9 and 12, the system rejects the change and shows MSG47.5.3. Nothing is changed.5.4. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 8 or 12): Concurrent change6.1. The stored role no longer matches expectedRole, or another account took the practice-license number between steps 8 and 12\.6.2. The system rejects the request without changing anything and shows MSG75 (or MSG07 for the practice-license number).6.3. The use case ends. EF-07 (at any step): Session expired or system error7.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80.7.2. No partial update is committed.7.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the account has the selected non-Admin role; a Doctor or Technician account has the academic title and practice-license number entered in this use case; any room assignment of a previous Doctor/Technician role is removed; the account status is preserved; all account sessions are revoked; the change is recorded in the account history and the security audit. Failure or cancellation: role, professional information, room assignment, status and sessions remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-05, BR-19.  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG06, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG45, MSG46, MSG47, MSG48, MSG75, MSG80.  |  |  |

### **2.6 UC-10: Lock/Unlock Account** {#2.6-uc-10:-lock/unlock-account}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to manually Lock or Unlock a non-Admin staff account to control access without deleting its records (BR-01). Manual account status Locked is distinct from the 15-minute temporary password sign-in block in UC-01; UC-10 does not clear that temporary block. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and viewing a non-Admin staff account in UC-06. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Khóa tài khoản” on an Active non-Admin account. Before opening the lock dialog, the web client requests the number of visits In Examination and paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the target account. The system opens “Khóa tài khoản \[username\]”. The dialog displays:    “Vui lòng cung cấp lý do khóa tài khoản này (tối đa 500 ký tự).” The Admin enters the required “Lý do khóa” (5–500 characters after trimming, BR-97) and clicks “Khóa tài khoản”.  The web client trims the reason and sends at most 500 characters together with expectedStatus and expectedVersion. The system verifies Admin authorization, validates the trimmed reason length (5–500 characters), rejects the seeded Admin account and self-administration (BR-112), checks the expected account version and status (BR-119), and re-checks that the account has no visit In Examination and no paraclinical order detail In Progress (BR-113).  The system changes the account status from ACTIVE to LOCKED and records the reason, lock time and locking Admin. The system revokes all sessions of the target account. The system records the LOCK account change and ACCOUNT\_LOCKED security audit. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client displays “Đã khóa tài khoản \[username\]” and reloads UC-06 with the updated account detail.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Unlock a Locked account 1.1. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa tài khoản”. 1.2. The system opens “Mở khóa tài khoản” and displays MSG06: “Bạn có chắc chắn muốn mở khóa tài khoản \[username\] không?”  1.3. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa”. 1.4.
