The web client sends expectedStatus and expectedVersion. 1.5. The system verifies Admin authorization, protected-account restrictions, version and current LOCKED status. 1.6. The system changes the status to ACTIVE and clears lockReason, lockedAt and lockedByAccountId. 1.7. The system preserves the account’s role, room assignment, must-change-password flag and independent temporary password-login block. 1.8. The system does not create a new login session. 1.9. The system records the UNLOCK account change and ACCOUNT\_UNLOCKED security audit. 1.10. The system returns the updated account detail. 1.11**.** The web client displays “Đã mở khóa tài khoản \[username\]” and reloads UC-06 with the updated account detail.  AF-02 (at steps 3–5 or AF-01 1.2–1.3): The Admin closes the Lock or Unlock dialog.  2.1. The Admin closes the confirmation dialog. 2.2. The account status remains unchanged. 2.3. No account-change or security-audit success entry is created. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 7): The staff member has work in progress  1.1. The preliminary web-client check (step 2), or the server re-check (step 7), finds one or more visits In Examination or paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account. 1.2. The system displays MSG47: “{full\_name} đang có lượt khám hoặc dịch vụ đang thực hiện. Vui lòng hoàn tất các công việc này trước.” 1.3. At step 2, the “Khóa tài khoản” dialog is not opened. At step 7, the lock command is rejected. 1.4–1.6. Same as the original. EF-02 (at step 5 or 7): Invalid lock reason  2.1. The trimmed reason is empty, or shorter than 5 characters. 2.2. The web client displays under “Lý do khóa”: – MSG31 “Vui lòng nhập lý do.” when the reason is empty; – MSG95 “Lý do phải có từ 5 đến 500 ký tự.” when the reason is too short. 2.3. No API request is sent. A direct API request with an invalid reason is rejected at step 7, and the account status and audit data remain unchanged. 2.4. The use case returns to step 5\.  EF-03 (at steps 1 or 7): Protected account or own account 3.1. Lock/Unlock of an account having the ADMIN role is rejected with MSG46: “Không thể thực hiện thao tác này đối với tài khoản Admin.” 3.2. Self-administration is rejected with MSG45: “Bạn không thể khóa tài khoản của chính mình.” (for Unlock, “mở khóa”). 3.3. No account status or audit data is changed. EF-04 (at step 7): Stale version, invalid status or concurrent modification 4.1. The target version or status differs from expectedVersion or expectedStatus, or an optimistic-locking conflict occurs while saving. 4.2. The system rejects the request with Conflict. 4.3. The web client displays MSG75: “Tài khoản vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.”  4.4. No account-status or audit change is committed. EF-05 (at steps 7–11): Unauthorized requester, expired session, network failure or system error 5.1. An unauthorized requester is rejected with MSG13 “Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.” 5.2. An expired session displays MSG12 “Phiên đăng nhập của bạn đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” and opens the Login screen. 5.3. A network failure displays MSG96 “Không kết nối được máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.” 5.4. A system error displays MSG80 “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.” 5.5. The account status and audit data remain unchanged. 5.6. The use case ends.  |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Lock success: the account is Locked and all its active sessions are revoked. The lock reason, lock time and locking Admin are recorded. Role, room assignment, work data and historical records remain unchanged. Unlock success: the account is Active and its manual lock information is cleared. Unlocking does not create a login session. The independent temporary password-login block, role, room assignment and password-change requirement remain unchanged. Failure or cancellation: account status, sessions and audit data remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05, BR-97, BR-112, BR-113, BR-119, BR-127  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG10, MSG12, MSG13, MSG31, MSG45, MSG46, MSG47, MSG75, MSG80.  |  |  |

### **2.7 UC-11: Reset Password** {#2.7-uc-11:-reset-password}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Admin may reset a non-Admin staff member’s forgotten password using one of two methods. “Hệ thống tự sinh” generates a one-time temporary password that the staff member must change after the next successful sign-in. “Admin nhập thủ công” sets a permanent password agreed with the staff member and does not require another password change. Resetting the seeded Admin account through UC-11 is not allowed. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and is viewing a non-Admin staff account in UC-06. The staff member has asked for a reset (in person or by phone). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Đặt lại mật khẩu” on the account detail (UC-06). The system opens “Đặt lại mật khẩu” and the Admin selects “Hệ thống tự sinh” (default) or “Admin nhập thủ công”. For manual mode, the Admin enters “Mật khẩu chính thức” and “Xác nhận mật khẩu”. The Admin clicks “Đặt lại mật khẩu”. For manual mode, the web client checks that the password has 8–64 characters, is at most 72 UTF-8 bytes and matches its confirmation. If the client-side checks pass, the system shows a confirmation (MSG06) with the target’s full name and username. The Admin confirms the reset. The web client sends the selected mode, the manual password (manual mode only) and the account version. The password confirmation is not sent to the backend. The system checks that the target is not the Admin’s own account and is not the seeded Admin account. The system checks that the account version has not changed. For generated mode, the backend generates a 12-character password that meets the same password policy. For manual mode, the backend checks the password policy again. The system replaces the previous password with a protected hash of the new password. For generated mode, the system sets must-change-password to Yes. For manual mode, it sets must-change-password to No. In both modes, the system clears the failed sign-in count and the temporary password-login block. The system revokes all active sessions of the target account. The account’s status, role, room assignment and personal information remain unchanged. The system records the reset in the security audit log. It does not record the plaintext password or its hash. For generated mode, the system displays the generated password exactly once, with “Sao chép”, “In” and “Đóng”, and states that the staff member must change it at the next sign-in. For manual mode, the system displays the manually entered permanent password exactly once, with “Sao chép”, “In” and “Đóng”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 2–7): The Admin cancels1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or closes the confirmation.1.2. The password is not changed.1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 14): Password login is temporarily blocked after failed attempts2.1. The system clears the 15-minute temporary password-login block and the failure counter (UC-01) without changing the account status.2.2. The use case continues at step 15\. AF-03 (at step 16): The account is Locked by the Admin3.1. The password is reset, but the account remains Locked.3.2. The user cannot sign in until the Admin unlocks the account through UC-10.3.3. The use case continues at step 17\. AF-04 (at steps 18–19): The Admin closes the result without copying or printing4.1. The displayed password cannot be viewed again.4.2. If the password was not delivered, the Admin must start another password reset.4.3. A new reset replaces the password created by the previous reset.4.4. This alternative flow applies to both generated and manual modes.4.5. The use case ends. |  |  |
|  **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 1 or 9): The target is the Admin’s own account1.1. “Đặt lại mật khẩu” is not shown on the Admin’s own account.1.2. A direct self-reset request is rejected with MSG45.1.3. The Admin changes their own password through UC-03.1.4. No password, session or account data is changed.1.5. The use case ends. EF-02 (at steps 1 or 9): The target is the seeded Admin account2.1. The system rejects the request and shows MSG46.2.2. No password, session or account data is changed.2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 5 or 11): The manual password violates the password policy3.1. The web client shows MSG41 in the form-level error area.3.2. No password reset is saved.3.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 5): The password confirmation does not match4.1. The web client shows MSG42 in the form-level error area.4.2. No password reset is saved.4.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-05 (at step 10): The account version is stale5.1. The system detects that the target account has changed since the reset began.5.2. The system rejects the reset and shows MSG75.5.3. No new password is issued and no account data is changed.5.4. The Admin must reload UC-06 before trying again.5.5. The use case ends. EF-06 (at any step): Unauthorized requester, expired session or system error6.1. A non-Admin requester is rejected with MSG13.6.2. An expired session shows MSG12 and opens the “Đăng nhập” screen.6.3. A system error shows MSG80.6.4. No password, session or account data is changed.6.5. The use case ends. |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Generated-mode success: the previous password is invalid, all prior sessions are revoked, the generated password is displayed exactly once, and the staff member must change it after the next successful sign-in. Manual-mode success: the previous password is invalid, all prior sessions are revoked, the manually entered password becomes the account’s permanent password and is displayed exactly once, and no further password change is required. In both modes, the failed sign-in count and the temporary password-login block are cleared, and a Locked account remains Locked until it is unlocked through UC-10. Role, room assignment and personal information remain unchanged. Failure or cancellation: the password, the password-change requirement, the sessions and all other account data remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-03; Security: Password protection, Account lockout, Audit trail (IV.2.3).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG12, MSG13, MSG41, MSG42, MSG45, MSG46, MSG75, MSG80.  |  |  |

## **3\. Department Management** {#3.-department-management}

### **3.1 UC-12: View Department List** {#3.1-uc-12:-view-department-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the list of clinical and paraclinical departments, so that I can check their rooms. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects "Khoa / Phòng" in the menu. The system opens "Quản lý khoa/phòng"; the "Phòng chức năng" tab is selected by default, and the Admin selects the "Chuyên khoa" tab for this use case. The system displays the "Chuyên khoa" table with: "Mã khoa", "Tên chuyên khoa", "Loại khoa", "Phòng trực thuộc"(số phòng), "Trạng thái" and "Thao tác". Available actions are "Xem chi tiết", "Chỉnh sửa", "Đang hoạt động/Ngừng hoạt động" . The list is sorted by “Mã khoa” by default and is paginated.  The Admin searches by "Mã khoa" or "Tên chuyên khoa", and/or filters by "Loại khoa" ("Tất cả loại khoa", "Lâm sàng", "Cận lâm sàng") and "Trạng thái" ("Tất cả trạng thái", "Đang hoạt động", "Ngừng hoạt động").  The system updates the list. Search is case- and accent-insensitive. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Clear the search and filters 1.1. The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”. 1.2. The system removes all search and filter conditions and shows the full list in the default order. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin selects another page, or the number of rows per page (5, 10, 15, 20). 2.2. The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search and filters. 2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 4): No department to show 1.1. There is no department in the system, or no department matches the search and filters. 1.2. If there is no department in the system, the system shows MSG92. If no department matches the search and filters, the system shows MSG01. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The departments are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02; Permission Matrix 4.4 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |

### **3.2 UC-13: View Department Detail** {#3.2-uc-13:-view-department-detail}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the details of a department and its rooms, so that I can decide whether to update the department or add rooms. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the department list (UC-12). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks the eye icon (tooltip “Xem chi tiết”) in the “Thao tác” column of a department. The system displays the department information: "Mã khoa", "Tên chuyên khoa", "Loại khoa", "Mô tả" and "Trạng thái". The system displays the rooms belonging to the department, including "Mã phòng", "Tên phòng", "Mô tả", "Vị trí" and "Trạng thái". If the department has no rooms, the system displays MSG92.  The system displays the "Chỉnh sửa" button (UC-14) and the "Đóng" button. The Admin clicks "Đóng" to close the detail popup and return to the department list (UC-12). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | None |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at any step): Session expired or system error 1.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The department details are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | None |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG80  |  |  |

### **3.3 UC-14: Update Department** {#3.3-uc-14:-update-department}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update a department's name, description and status, and update its type when permitted, so that department information remains accurate and up to date throughout the system. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the department list (UC-12) or viewing the department (UC-13). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | Admin clicks the pencil icon (“Chỉnh sửa”) in UC-12 or the “Chỉnh sửa” button in UC-13. The system displays the department update form with the current information: Mã khoa (read-only), Tên chuyên khoa\*, Loại khoa\* (Lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng), Mô tả, Trạng thái\* (Đang hoạt động / Ngừng hoạt động). The system checks whether the department has ever had a room. If it has never had a room, the “Loại khoa” field is editable. Otherwise, this field is read-only (BR-114). Admin updates one or more editable fields and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”.  The system validates the input according to BR-67, BR-68, BR-69 and BR-70: “Mã khoa” remains unchanged; “Tên khoa” is required, contains 2–100 characters and must be unique; “Loại khoa” must be Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. “Mô tả” is optional and must not exceed 500 characters. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed. If the Admin changes “Trạng thái” from “Đang hoạt động” to “Ngừng hoạt động”, the system checks whether all active rooms can be deactivated according to BR-07 and whether deactivating services exclusively provided by the department violates BR-116. If all conditions are satisfied, the system displays a confirmation dialog listing the affected rooms and services to be deactivated. The Admin confirms the deactivation. The system saves the department changes and deactivates the affected rooms and exclusively provided services.  The system displays MSG03 and opens the department details screen in UC-13.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”. If there are unsaved changes, the system displays . 1.2. If the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”, the system discards all unsaved changes and returns to the previous screen. If the Admin selects “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa”, the system keeps the update form open at Step 4\. 1.3. The use case ends if the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”. AF-02 (at step 3): Save without changing any value 2.1. The Admin clicks “Lưu thay đổi” without changing any value. 2.2. The system returns to the previous screen without saving. 2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Required field empty or too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG08 at the field. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-02 (at step 5): Duplicate name 2.1. The system shows MSG07 at “Tên khoa”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-03 (at step 6): Department deactivation conditions not met 3.1. If any active room cannot be deactivated according to BR-07 or deactivating an affected examination service violates BR-116, the system displays an appropriate warning and keeps all original statuses unchanged. 3.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: The department information is updated. If the department is deactivated, its eligible rooms and exclusively provided services are also deactivated. Failure or cancelled: No changes are saved. The department, room, and service statuses remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-07, BR-67, BR-68, BR-69, BR-70, BR-114, BR-116 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG38, MSG80  |  |  |

## **4\. Room Management** {#4.-room-management}

### **4.1 UC-15: Assign Staff to Room** {#4.1-uc-15:-assign-staff-to-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to assign doctors to a clinical room and technicians to a paraclinical room, or remove them, so that staff members are assigned to the appropriate rooms before their shifts are scheduled.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is viewing a room in the room list (UC-16) or an account (UC-06). Active Doctor or Technician accounts exist (UC-07). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Phân công nhân viên” on an active room. The system displays the screen with information about room and two lists: Staff currently assigned to the room.Active staff with the role matching the room type (Doctor for a clinical room, Technician for a paraclinical room), with their current room. Staff with a shift from today onwards or with work in progress are disabled in both lists (BR-55, BR-113). A search box is provided above the second list. If a list has no data, the system shows MSG92 in that list. The Admin selects one or more staff from the second list and clicks “Thêm”.  The system shows MSG06 listing the staff who will be moved from their current room. The Admin confirms. The system saves the assignment: one room per staff member, and the department becomes the room’s department (BR-05). The system displays MSG03 and reloads the room. Moved staff see the new room’s lists after their next screen refresh (BR-19). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Remove a staff member from the room 1.1. The Admin clicks “Gỡ khỏi phòng” on a staff member in the first list. 1.2. The system displays MSG06; the Admin confirms. 1.3. The system removes the staff member from the room. The staff member then has no room and sees MSG48 after the next screen refresh. 1.4. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-02 (at step 5): The change leaves a room without any doctor 2.1. The confirmation dialog also warns that the room cannot receive patients at reception until a doctor is assigned and scheduled again. 2.2. The use case continues at step 5\. AF-03 (at step 1): Started from an account 3.1. In UC-06, for a Doctor or Technician account, the Admin clicks “Phân công phòng”. 3.2. The system shows the active rooms of the matching type, grouped by department; the Admin selects one room. 3.3. The use case continues at step 4 with that account as the selected staff. AF-04 (at step 6): The Admin cancels 4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” in the confirmation dialog. Nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case returns to step 2\. AF-05 (at step 2): Search 5.1. The Admin types a keyword in the search box (BR-110). 5.2. The system filters the list of available staff by full name or practice licence number as the keyword is entered. 5.3. If nothing matches, the system shows MSG01.  5.4. The use case continues at step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at any step): Session expired or system error 1.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: The staff are assigned to (or removed from) the room and belong to its department. They only see and handle patients and services of their room (BR-19). A clinical room receives patients at reception only when it has a doctor scheduled for that day (BR-96, shifts in UC-86). Failure or cancelled: No assignment is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05, BR-19, BR-55, BR-96, BR-110, BR-113 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG03, MSG06, MSG12, MSG48, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |

### **4.2 UC-16: View Room List** {#4.2-uc-16:-view-room-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the list of rooms grouped by department, with their type, location and status, so that I can manage rooms and staff assignments. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Khoa / Phòng” in the menu; the system opens “Quản lý khoa/phòng” with the “Phòng chức năng” tab selected. The system displays the rooms with the columns “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng”, “Khoa”,“Loại phòng” (Lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng), “Vị trí”, “Trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động / Ngừng hoạt động) and “Thao tác” (“Xem chi tiết”, “Chỉnh sửa”, “Đang hoạt động” / “Ngừng hoạt động”). “Phân công nhân viên” is enabled only for active rooms. The list is sorted by department and “Mã phòng” and is paginated.  The Admin enters a keyword to search by “Mã phòng” or “Tên phòng” (BR-110), and/or filters by “Khoa”, “Loại phòng” and “Trạng thái”. The system updates the list. Search is case- and accent-insensitive. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Clear the search and filters 1.1. The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”. 1.2. The system removes all conditions and shows the full list in the default order. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin selects another page or the number of rows per page. 2.2. The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search and filters. 2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 4): No room to show 1.1. There is no room in the system, or no room matches the search and filters. 1.2. If there is no room in the system, the system shows MSG92. If no room matches the search and filters, the system shows MSG01. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error). 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The rooms are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-110 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |

### **4.3 UC-17: Create Room** {#4.3-uc-17:-create-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to create a clinical room or a paraclinical room in a department, so that patients can be registered to the room or paraclinical services can be routed to it. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the room list (UC-16). At least one active department exists. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Thêm phòng”. The system shows the form: “Loại phòng”, “Khoa”, “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng”, “Vị trí”\* and, for a paraclinical room, “Nhóm dịch vụ”\*. “Khoa” is disabled until a room type is selected; it then lists the active departments of the corresponding type (clinical departments for “Lâm sàng”, paraclinical departments for “Cận lâm sàng”) (BR-114). For a paraclinical room, “Nhóm dịch vụ”\*, which is disabled until a department is selected and then lists the service groups of that department.  The Admin fills in the form and clicks “Lưu”. The system validates the input: “Loại phòng”, “Khoa”, “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng” and “Vị trí” are required. “Mã phòng” has 2–20 characters of uppercase letters, digits or hyphens (BR-71). “Tên phòng” has 2–100 characters (BR-72). “Vị trí” has 2–255 characters (BR-73). For a paraclinical room, “Nhóm dịch vụ” is selected from the service groups of the selected department (BR-74). The system checks that “Mã phòng” is not used by any room, including inactive rooms (BR-06, BR-71). The system displays MSG04 and shows the new room in the room list (UC-16).  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Admin changes the room type or the department 1.1. If the Admin changes “Loại phòng”, the system clears “Khoa” and the selected group, reloads the “Khoa” list for the new type, and shows or hides “Nhóm dịch vụ” (shown only for “Cận lâm sàng”). 1.2. If the Admin changes “Khoa”, the system reloads the “Nhóm dịch vụ” list for that department and clears the selected group. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\.  AF-02 (at step 3): The Admin cancels 2.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”. If any field is filled in, the system displays MSG38. 2.2. If the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”, the system discards the data and returns to the previous screen. If the Admin selects “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa”, the form stays open at step 3\. 2.3. The use case ends if the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): Required field empty, wrong format or too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02, MSG05 or MSG08 under each wrong field. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 5): The room code already exists 2.1. The system shows MSG07 under “Mã phòng”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); no room is created. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: A new room with status “Đang hoạt động” exists in the selected department. An examination room can receive patients at reception once a doctor is assigned to it (UC-15) and scheduled for the day (BR-96). A paraclinical room can receive released services of its service group (BR-28). Failure or cancelled: no room is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-06, BR-28, BR-71, BR-72, BR-73, BR-74, BR-96, BR-114 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG38, MSG80 |  |  |

### **4.4 UC-18: Update Room** {#4.4-uc-18:-update-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the information of a room (name, location and status), so that examination tickets and paraclinical order slips show the correct place for patients to go. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the room list (UC-16). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks the pencil icon (tooltip “Chỉnh sửa”) of a room. The system displays the update form with the current information: “Mã phòng”, “Loại phòng”, “Khoa” and, for a paraclinical room, “Nhóm dịch vụ” are read-only; “Tên phòng”\*, “Vị trí”\* and “Trạng thái”\* are editable. The Admin updates one or more editable fields. The Admin clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The system validates the input (BR-72, BR-73); “Mã phòng”, “Loại phòng”, “Khoa” and “Nhóm dịch vụ” remain unchanged (BR-71, BR-115). If “Trạng thái” is changed from “Đang hoạt động” to “Ngừng hoạt động”, the system checks that the room can be deactivated (BR-07). The system displays MSG06. The Admin confirms. The system saves the room changes. The system displays MSG03 and reloads the room list (UC-16). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”; if there are unsaved changes, the system displays MSG38. 1.2. If the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”, the system discards all changes and returns to the room list. If the Admin selects “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa”, the use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 4): No value was changed 2.1. The system returns to the room list without saving. 2.2. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 6): The status is not changed to “Ngừng hoạt động” 3.1. The system skips steps 6–8. 3.2. The use case continues at step 9\.  AF-04 (at step 8): The Admin does not confirm the deactivation 4.1. The system closes the dialog; nothing is saved. 4.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): A required field is empty or an input is too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG08 at the field. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-02 (at step 5): The room name already exists 2.1. The system shows MSG07 at “Tên phòng”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-03 (at step 6): The room still has patients or services waiting or in progress 3.1. The system shows MSG55; the room is not deactivated. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 6): The room still has staff scheduled for upcoming days 4.1. The system shows MSG79; the room is not deactivated. 4.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-05 (at step 6): The room is the only active room of a service group that still has active services 5.1. The system shows MSG93; the room is not deactivated. 5.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-06 (at step 6): The room is the only active examination room 6.1. The system shows MSG94; the room is not deactivated. 6.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-07 (at any step): Session expired or system error 7.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; nothing is saved. 7.2. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the room is updated. A deactivated room no longer receives registrations, transfers or service assignments (BR-07). Failure or cancel: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-07, BR-71, BR-72, BR-73, BR-115 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG06, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG38, MSG55, MSG79, MSG80, MSG93, MSG94 |  |  |

### **4.5 UC-19: Activate/Deactivate Room** {#4.5-uc-19:-activate/deactivate-room}

UC-19: Activate/Deactivate Room – Merged into UC-18 (Update Room), which already covers updating room information, including its status (Active/Inactive).

## **5\. Service & Price Management** {#5.-service-&-price-management}

### **5.1 UC-20: View Service and Price List** {#5.1-uc-20:-view-service-and-price-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the catalog of examination and paraclinical services, so that I can check and maintain the prices used for billing. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Dịch vụ” in the sidebar. The system displays a table: Mã dịch vụ, Tên dịch vụ, Loại (Khám bệnh, Xét nghiệm, Chẩn đoán hình ảnh, Thăm dò chức năng), Nhóm dịch vụ, Giá viện phí, Giá BHYT, Trạng thái.  “Giá” are shown in VND. If there is no health insurance price, Giá BHYT displays “Không áp dụng”. The list is sorted by “Mã dịch vụ” by default and is paginated.  The Admin searches by “Mã dịch vụ” or “Tên dịch vụ”, or filters by “Loại”, “Nhóm dịch vụ” and “Trạng thái”.  The system updates the list according to the search and filters.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Clear the search and filters 1.1.The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”. 1.2.The system removes all search and filter conditions and shows the full list in the default order. 1.3.The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or page size 2.1.The Admin selects another page, or selects the number of rows per page (10, 20, 50). 2.2.The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search, filters and sort order. 2.3.The use case returns to step 3\. AF-03 (at step 4): No service matches the search and filters 3.1. The system shows MSG01 in the list. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The services are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-08; Permission Matrix 4.4 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

The selected service is no longer in the system, for example because it was opened from an old link. 2.2. The system shows MSG39. 2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error). Nothing is changed. 3.2. The use case ends.  |  |  |

### **5.3 UC-22: Create Service** {#5.3-uc-22:-create-service}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to create a new paraclinical service with its prices and, for a laboratory service, its test indicators, so that doctors can order it right away. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the service list (UC-20). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Thêm dịch vụ”. The system shows the “Thêm dịch vụ” form. The Admin selects the service type: "Xét nghiệm", "Chẩn đoán hình ảnh" or "Thăm dò chức năng" (BR-137). The system shows "Nhóm dịch vụ" with the active groups of that type; for a laboratory service, it also shows "Chỉ số xét nghiệm" (BR-132, BR-135). The Admin selects the service group; the system fills in “Khoa thực hiện” from the group. The Admin enters the service information and prices, checks “Không thuộc BHYT” if the service is not covered by insurance, and selects the indicators and their display order for a laboratory service. The Admin clicks “Lưu”. The system checks the input and that the selected service group has at least one active room (BR-76, BR-77, BR-78, BR-117, BR-132, BR-135). The system creates the service as active and attaches the selected indicators in the set order; these indicators cannot be changed later (BR-132). The system shows MSG04 and opens the list service (UC-20). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4 or 5): Change the service type  1.1. The Admin selects another type; the system clears the group, department and indicators, and shows or hides “Chỉ số xét nghiệm” by the new type. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-02 (at step 5): Change the service group  2.1. The Admin selects another group; the system updates “Khoa thực hiện” from the new group.  2.2. The use case returns to step 5\. AF-03 (at step 5): Remove a selected indicator  3.1. The Admin clicks “Gỡ”; the system removes the indicator and renumbers the display order.  3.2. The use case returns to step 5\. AF-04 (at step 3, 4 or 5): Cancel  4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”; if any field has been entered, the system shows MSG38.  4.2. If the Admin selects “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa”, the use case returns to the step where the Admin was.  4.3. If the Admin confirms, nothing is created, the system returns to the service list and the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 7): A required field is empty, an input is too long or too short, or a laboratory service has no indicator 2.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG05, MSG08. 2.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-03 (at step 7): The service code or name already exists 3.1. The system shows MSG07. 3.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-04 (at step 7): Invalid price 4.1. The system shows MSG32. 4.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-05 (at step 7): The service group has no active room 5.1. The system shows MSG73. 5.2. The use case returns to step 4\.  EF-06 (at any step): Session expired or system error 6.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; nothing is created. 6.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the new paraclinical service exists, is active and appears in the order list (BR-10, BR-117). A laboratory service has its indicators, which cannot be changed. Failure or cancel: no service is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-08, BR-10, BR-46, BR-76, BR-77, BR-78,  BR-132, BR-135, BR-137 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG32, MSG38, MSG73, MSG80 |  |  |

### **5.5 UC-24: Update Price** {#5.5-uc-24:-update-price}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the clinic price or the insurance price of a service, so that new orders and receipts use the current prices while existing ones keep the prices at the time they were created (BR-09). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is viewing the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |

The system shows MSG06 with the old and new prices and a note that the new prices apply only to orders and receipts created from now on (BR-09). The Admin confirms. The system saves the prices. The system closes the popup, shows MSG03 and reloads the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Cancel 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or closes the popup; if anything was changed, the system shows MSG38. 1.2. If the Admin confirms, nothing is saved and the system closes the popup. AF-02 (at step 4): No price was changed 2.1. "Lưu" stays disabled until a price or the "Không thuộc BHYT" checkbox is changed. 2.2. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 7): The Admin does not confirm 3.1. The prices are not changed. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): A price is empty or invalid 1.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG32. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; the prices are not changed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: new orders and receipts use the new prices; existing orders and receipts keep their stored prices (BR-09). A service marked “Không thuộc BHYT” is charged at the clinic price in new receipts (BR-27). Failure / Cancelled: the prices are not changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-08, BR-09, BR-27, BR-78 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG06, MSG12, MSG32, MSG38, MSG80 |  |  |

### **5.6 UC-25: Activate/Deactivate Service** {#5.6-uc-25:-activate/deactivate-service}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to deactivate a paraclinical service that the hospital no longer provides, or activate it again, so that it is hidden from or shown again in the order list. Doctors can only order active services (BR-10). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is viewing the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Ngừng hoạt động” on an active service. The system checks that the service is not the examination service (BR-116, BR-137). The system checks that the service has no unfinished orders, that is, orders that have no result, are not cancelled and are not abandoned (BR-10). The system shows MSG06. The Admin confirms. The system sets the service to inactive. The system shows MSG03 and reloads the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Activate an inactive service 1.1. The Admin clicks “Kích hoạt”. 1.2. The system checks that the service group has at least one active room (BR-117). 1.3. The system shows MSG06. 1.4. The Admin confirms. 1.5. The system sets the service to active; the service appears in the order list at its current prices. 1.6. The system shows MSG03 and reloads the service detail (UC-21). 1.7. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 5 or 1.4): The Admin cancels 2.1. The system closes MSG06; the status is not changed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The service is the examination service 1.1. The system shows MSG52; the service is not deactivated. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 3): The service has unfinished orders 2.1. The system shows MSG55; the service is not deactivated. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 1.2): The service group has no active room 3.1. The system shows MSG73; the service is not activated. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; the status is not changed. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Deactivate: the service is inactive and hidden from the order list; existing orders, receipts and results that use it are not changed. Activate: the service is active and can be ordered again at its current prices. Failure or cancel: the status is not changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-09, BR-10, BR-116, BR-117, BR-137 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG03, MSG06, MSG12, MSG52, MSG55, MSG73, MSG80 |  |  |

## **6\. Statistics & Reporting** {#6.-statistics-&-reporting}

### **6.1 UC-26: View Statistic Report** {#6.1-uc-26:-view-statistic-report}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to see an overview dashboard of the hospital’s activity, so that I can follow today’s operation and the main figures of a period. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens “Tổng quan” (home screen after sign-in, or the “Thống kê” menu). The system shows today’s live figures: visits registered today; waiting, skipped, being examined and waiting-for-conclusion visits per examination room; pending receipts; services waiting per paraclinical room. The system shows the figures of the selected period (default: this month): number of visits, completed and abandoned visits, revenue (total, insurance amount, patient amount – BR-38) and number of paraclinical services performed. Periods without data show 0 and the charts show MSG01. The system shows charts: visits per day, revenue per day, and visits per department and room. Clicking a card or chart opens the matching report (UC-27 to UC-32). The Admin changes the period (“Hôm nay”, “Tuần này”, “Tháng này”, “Năm nay”, “Tùy chọn”). The system recalculates the figures and charts. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | None |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Invalid custom period 1.1. The system shows MSG53 if “Từ ngày” is later than “Đến ngày”, or MSG54 if the period is longer than 12 months. 1.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG99. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The dashboard is shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-37, BR-38; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Statistics report – View) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG53, MSG54, MSG99 |  |  |
