## **7\. Patient Profile Management** {#7.-patient-profile-management}

### **7.1 UC-35: Search Patient** {#7.1-uc-35:-search-patient}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to search for a patient by citizen ID (first), passport, patient code, phone, name or health insurance card number, so that a returning patient is reused instead of getting a duplicate profile. First-time and returning patients follow the same process; the only difference is whether a new profile is created (BR-12).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in (UC-01). The patient (or guardian) is at the reception counter, or is a priority patient brought directly to the Receptionist (BR-14). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist opens "Quản lý & Tiếp đón bệnh nhân". The system shows the search form: "Tìm theo" (CCCD selected by default; Hộ chiếu, Mã bệnh nhân, Số điện thoại, Họ tên, Số thẻ BHYT) and "Từ khóa". Below the form the system shows "Danh sách bệnh nhân" with up to 50 patient profiles (no search applied), and the buttons "Làm mới" and "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới". The Receptionist selects the search type, enters the keyword and clicks "Tìm kiếm". The system removes leading and trailing spaces and validates the keyword by type: CCCD exactly 12 digits; Hộ chiếu 1 to 15 letters or digits; Số điện thoại exactly 10 digits; Họ tên 2 to 100 characters; Số thẻ BHYT exactly 15 letters or digits; Mã bệnh nhân not empty. The server repeats the check. The system searches the patient profiles. CCCD, passport, patient code, phone and insurance card number must match exactly (passport, patient code and card number ignore case); the insurance card number is searched among the cards used in the patient's previous visits. Name search matches part of the name and ignores case and Vietnamese accents. The system shows "Kết quả tìm kiếm" with at most 50 results: Mã BN, Họ và tên, Ngày sinh, Giới tính, CCCD / Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại, Lần khám gần nhất, Lượt khám đang mở (status, registration code, room) and Thao tác ("Đăng ký khám", "Xem hồ sơ", "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ"). The button "Xóa tìm kiếm" appears next to "Tìm kiếm". The Receptionist clicks "Xem hồ sơ" on a patient. The system opens View Patient Information (UC-36). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The patient has no citizen ID (e.g. a child or a foreigner) or does not bring it 1.1. The Receptionist selects another search type (Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại, Họ tên, Mã bệnh nhân or Số thẻ BHYT) and enters the keyword. 1.2. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow. AF-02 (at step 6): Several patients match (e.g. same name or same phone) 2.1. The system lists all of them; the Receptionist confirms with the date of birth, phone or identification number shown in the list. 2.2. Continue at step 7 of the Normal Flow. AF-03 (at step 6): Exactly one patient matches a search by CCCD, Hộ chiếu or Mã bệnh nhân 3.1. The system opens UC-36 directly, without showing the result list (each identification number belongs to exactly one profile – BR-12). 3.2. The use case ends. AF-04 (at step 6): More than 50 patients match 4.1. The system shows the first 50 patients and MSG101: "Có hơn 50 bệnh nhân phù hợp. Hệ thống chỉ hiển thị 50 kết quả đầu tiên, vui lòng nhập từ khóa cụ thể hơn." 4.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. AF-05 (at step 6): The Receptionist clears the search 5.1. The Receptionist clicks "Xóa tìm kiếm". 5.2. The system clears the keyword and shows "Danh sách bệnh nhân" again (up to 50 profiles). 5.3. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. AF-06 (at step 6): The Receptionist uses another action of the result row 6.1. "Đăng ký khám" opens Register Examination (UC-40) for that patient. 6.2. "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ" opens Update Patient Information (UC-38) for that patient. 6.3. The use case ends. AF-07 (at step 2 or 6): The Receptionist clicks "Làm mới" 7.1. The system repeats the last search (or reloads the unfiltered list). 7.2. Continue at step 6 of the Normal Flow. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): Empty keyword or wrong format 1.1. The system shows MSG02 ("Vui lòng nhập từ khóa tìm kiếm.") or MSG05 ("Định dạng từ khóa không hợp lệ.") under "Từ khóa" and does not search. 1.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. EF-02 (at step 6): No patient matches 2.1. The system shows MSG01 ("Không tìm thấy kết quả.") and the button "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới", which opens UC-37. The keyword is pre-filled in the form when the search type was CCCD, Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại or Họ tên; nothing is pre-filled for Mã bệnh nhân and Số thẻ BHYT. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not allowed to search patients 3.1. The system shows MSG13. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 5): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 above the list; the list is not changed. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patient is identified, or the Receptionist continues with UC-37. No data is changed.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-14, BR-17, BR-83, BR-91, BR-110; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Patient profile – Search)  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG02, MSG05, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80, MSG100 |  |  |

### **7.2 UC-36: View Patient Information** {#7.2-uc-36:-view-patient-information}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to view a patient's administrative information and visit history, so that I can confirm the patient's identity, update the profile and register a new visit.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in and has found the patient (UC-35) or has just created the profile (UC-37).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist clicks "Xem hồ sơ" in the search results (UC-35), or the system opens the profile directly (UC-35 AF-03, UC-37 step 9, UC-38 step 8). The system shows "Thông tin hành chính": Mã bệnh nhân, Họ và tên, Ngày sinh (age), Giới tính, CCCD / Hộ chiếu (the citizen ID, or the passport when there is no citizen ID), Số điện thoại, Địa chỉ (address, ward, province), Nghề nghiệp, Dân tộc, Quốc tịch ("Việt Nam" when no foreign nationality is recorded), Thẻ BHYT gần nhất (card of the latest visit that used one), Người giám hộ (name, relationship, phone). Empty values are shown as "—". When the patient has drug allergies, they are shown read-only in a red label "Dị ứng thuốc: …" (they are recorded by the Doctor – BR-23). The system shows "Lịch sử khám", newest first: Mã lượt khám, Thời gian, Phòng, Bác sĩ, Đối tượng, Trạng thái. Clinical details (findings, results, diagnosis, prescription) are not shown (BR-120). The system records the view in the audit log (BR-42). The system shows the actions "Cập nhật thông tin" (UC-38) and "Đăng ký khám" (UC-40), and "Tải lại" on the visit history. The Receptionist selects an action. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): No previous visit 1.1. The system shows "Chưa có lịch sử khám." 1.2. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow. AF-02 (at step 3): The patient has an active visit (not Completed, Cancelled or Abandoned) 2.1. The system shows the box "Lượt khám đang mở" with the registration code, status, room and examination fee status ("Chờ thanh toán", "Đã thanh toán", "Miễn phí", "Đã hủy", or "Chưa có phiếu thu"), disables "Đăng ký khám" (BR-17, tooltip "Bệnh nhân đang có lượt khám chưa kết thúc") and shows the action "In lại phiếu khám". 2.2. If the Receptionist clicks "In lại phiếu khám", the system shows the ticket on the same screen (UC-41 AF-02) and returns to the patient information when the Receptionist finishes. 2.3. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow. AF-03 (at step 3): The patient has a follow-up appointment today 3.1. The system shows "Có lịch tái khám hôm nay" with the date, the doctor and the suggested room (when recorded), so that the Receptionist registers the follow-up visit. A failure to load the appointment does not block the screen. 3.2. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow. AF-04 (at step 5): The Receptionist clicks "Tải lại" 4.1. The system loads the patient information and visit history again (the view is recorded again). 4.2. Continue at step 2 of the Normal Flow. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The patient does not exist 1.1. The system shows MSG39 ("Không tìm thấy hồ sơ bệnh nhân được yêu cầu.") and the button "Về danh sách bệnh nhân". 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not allowed to view patient profiles 2.1. The system shows MSG13 and the button "Về danh sách bệnh nhân". 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 and the button "Về danh sách bệnh nhân". 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patient information is shown. No patient data is changed; the view is recorded in the audit log (BR-42). Clinical details are only shown to the Doctor (UC-52).  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-17, BR-23, BR-42, BR-120; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Patient profile – View administrative information)  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG80  |  |  |

### **7.3 UC-37: Create New Patient Profile** {#7.3-uc-37:-create-new-patient-profile}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to create a profile for a first-time patient, so that all their visits are linked to one record. A citizen ID or passport is optional (children, people without documents); when entered, each number maps to exactly one profile, so the system blocks duplicates by these numbers (BR-12). A profile can be created without an identification number and completed later (UC-38). The Receptionist only enters administrative information; medical history and allergies are recorded by the Doctor (BR-23).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in. The Receptionist is on "Quản lý & Tiếp đón bệnh nhân" (UC-35). Normally Search Patient found no profile for the patient; the system does not enforce this. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist clicks "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới" (in the page header, or under MSG01 after an unsuccessful search). The system shows the form "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới" in three groups. When it was opened from an unsuccessful search, the keyword is pre-filled (CCCD, Số hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại or Họ và tên). Thông tin cá nhân: Họ và tên\*, Ngày sinh\*, Giới tính\* (Nam – default, Nữ, Chưa xác định), CCCD, Số hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại (required from 18 years old), Dân tộc\* and Mã dân tộc\* (default Kinh, 01), Nhóm máu, Yếu tố Rh. Thông tin hành chính: Nghề nghiệp and Mã nghề nghiệp, Nơi làm việc, Ngoại kiều and Mã ngoại kiều (empty means Vietnamese), Xã/phường and Mã xã/phường, Tỉnh/thành phố and Mã tỉnh/thành, Địa chỉ\*. Thông tin người thân: Họ tên người thân and Quan hệ (both required under 18 years old; Quan hệ is selected from a list), Số điện thoại người thân, Địa chỉ người thân. The Receptionist enters the data from the patient's documents and clicks "Lưu hồ sơ". The system checks the required fields, which depend on the age calculated from the date of birth. The required marks of Số điện thoại, Họ tên người thân and Quan hệ change as soon as the date of birth is entered. The system checks the formats and lengths (BR-82 to BR-92): CCCD exactly 12 digits; passport 1 to 15 letters or digits; phone and relative's phone exactly 10 digits; date of birth not in the future and not more than 120 years ago; full name at most 100 characters; address, ward, province, workplace and relative's address at most 1,024 characters each; occupation at most 100; ethnicity at most 50; foreign nationality and relative's name at most 255; relationship at most 50\. Leading and trailing spaces are removed. The server repeats steps 4 and 5\. The system checks for possible duplicates: profiles with the same full name (ignoring case) and date of birth. The system checks that no profile has the same citizen ID or passport (BR-12; the passport ignores case). The system creates the profile with a unique patient code (BR-53) and records the creation in the audit log (BR-42). The system shows MSG04 ("Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân thành công.") and opens View Patient Information (UC-36), from which the Receptionist continues with Register Examination (UC-40). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): Possible duplicate found 1.1. The system shows the dialog "Có thể trùng hồ sơ" with MSG102 ("Đã tồn tại N bệnh nhân có cùng họ tên và ngày sinh. Vui lòng chọn một hồ sơ hoặc tạo hồ sơ mới.") and up to 10 matching profiles (patient code, full name, phone). 1.2. If the Receptionist clicks "Chọn hồ sơ này" on one of them, no profile is created, and UC-36 opens for that patient. 1.3. If the Receptionist clicks "Vẫn tạo hồ sơ mới", the flow continues at step 7 of the Normal Flow. 1.4. If the Receptionist clicks "Quay lại chỉnh sửa", the dialog closes and the form keeps the entered data. The flow returns to step 3 of the Normal Flow. AF-02 (at step 3): The Receptionist clicks "Hủy" or "Quay lại" 2.1. If any field was changed (pre-filled values do not count), the system shows the dialog "Hủy tạo hồ sơ" with MSG38; "Loại bỏ" discards the data and returns to the patient list, "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa" returns to the form. If nothing was changed, the system returns to the patient list without asking. 2.2. No profile is created. 2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 4–5): Required field empty, wrong format or too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02 ("Trường này là bắt buộc."), MSG05 ("Định dạng không hợp lệ.") or MSG08 ("Vượt quá độ dài tối đa cho phép.") under each wrong field, and "Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường được đánh dấu." above the buttons. 1.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. EF-02 (at step 7): The citizen ID or passport already exists 2.1. The system shows MSG19 ("Bệnh nhân có số CCCD/hộ chiếu này đã tồn tại ( – ).") under the field and above the buttons, with the button "Mở hồ sơ", which opens UC-36 of that patient. No profile is created. The message disappears when the Receptionist changes the CCCD or passport. 2.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. If the Receptionist opens the existing profile, the use case ends. EF-03 (at step 8): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; no profile is created and the form keeps the entered data. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: a new profile exists with a unique patient code (and a unique citizen ID or passport if provided); its creation is in the audit log. A profile without an identification number can be completed later in UC-38. Failure / Cancelled: no profile is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-23, BR-42, BR-46, BR-53, BR-82, BR-83, BR-84, BR-85, BR-86, BR-87, BR-88, BR-89, BR-90, BR-91, BR-92  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG19, MSG38, MSG80, MSG101 |  |  |

### **7.4 UC-38: Update Patient Information** {#7.4-uc-38:-update-patient-information}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to update a patient's administrative information when it changes (phone, address, relative, …), so that the profile stays correct for later visits. The Receptionist cannot change medical history or allergies (BR-23). The Receptionist can also add a missing citizen ID or passport (BR-12).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in and is viewing the patient in UC-36, or sees the patient in the list of UC-35.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist clicks "Cập nhật thông tin" in UC-36, or "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ" on a row of UC-35. The system shows "Cập nhật thông tin bệnh nhân": the form of UC-37 with the current data and the note "Chỉ cập nhật thông tin hành chính. Tiền sử và dị ứng do bác sĩ cập nhật khi khám."; Mã bệnh nhân is read-only and medical history and allergies are not in the form (BR-23). The Receptionist changes the data and clicks "Lưu thay đổi". The system checks the required fields, formats and lengths (as in UC-37, steps 4–5). The system checks that the profile was not changed by another user since it was opened (BR-119). If a citizen ID or passport is entered, the system checks that it is not used by another patient (BR-12). The system saves the changes and records them in the audit log (patient code and each changed field with its old and new value, Receptionist, time – BR-42). The system shows MSG03 ("Cập nhật hồ sơ bệnh nhân thành công.") and opens UC-36 with the new data. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Receptionist clicks "Hủy" or "Quay lại" 1.1. If something was changed, the system shows the dialog "Hủy cập nhật hồ sơ" with MSG38; "Loại bỏ" returns to UC-36 and nothing is saved, "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa" returns to the form. If nothing was changed, the system returns to UC-36 without asking. 1.2. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 3): The Receptionist clicks "Lưu thay đổi" without changing any value 2.1. The system returns to UC-36 without saving and without an audit entry. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): Required field empty, wrong format or too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02, MSG05 or MSG08 under each wrong field, and "Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường được đánh dấu." above the buttons. 1.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. EF-02 (at step 6): The citizen ID or passport belongs to another patient 2.1. The system shows MSG19 with the patient code and name of that profile and the button "Mở hồ sơ"; nothing is saved. 2.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. EF-03 (at step 5): The profile was changed by another user after it was opened 3.1. The system shows MSG75 ("Hồ sơ vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại trang để xem dữ liệu mới."); nothing is saved. The form stays open with the Receptionist's data; the Receptionist reloads the page to get the new data. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 2): The patient does not exist 4.1. The system shows MSG39 instead of the form. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at step 2 or 7): Session expired or system error 5.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; nothing is saved. 5.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the profile holds the new administrative data; each changed field is in the audit log with its old and new value. Visits already created keep the insurance data recorded at registration. Failure / Cancelled: nothing is changed.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-23, BR-42, BR-46, BR-82 to BR-92, BR-119  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG19, MSG38, MSG39, MSG75, MSG80  |  |  |

### **7.5 UC-39: Update Medical History and Allergies** {#7.5-uc-39:-update-medical-history-and-allergies}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to update the patient's medical history and drug allergies during the examination, so that they are kept in the patient profile and warned about in later visits. Drug allergy is a separate field of the patient profile and is only updated by the Doctor during the examination (BR-23).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in and is examining the patient: the visit is In Examination or Waiting for Conclusion, in the room the Doctor is assigned to, and its medical record is not closed (UC-47).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | On the clinical examination screen, the system shows the panel "Tiền sử & dị ứng thuốc". The system shows the current data of the patient profile, read-only: "Dị ứng thuốc" (red labels "Dị ứng: ()"; "Chưa ghi nhận dị ứng thuốc" when empty), "Tiền sử" (each entry with its group; "Chưa ghi nhận tiền sử" when empty) and "Cập nhật lần cuối" (time, Doctor) when data exists. The Doctor clicks "Cập nhật". The system shows the editable lists: Tiền sử (group: Bệnh mạn tính, Phẫu thuật, Tiền sử gia đình, Khác; content) and Dị ứng thuốc (Thuốc / nhóm thuốc\*, Biểu hiện, Mức độ: Nhẹ, Trung bình, Nặng). The Doctor adds, changes or removes entries and clicks "Lưu". The system checks the data: each history entry has content of at most 255 characters and all history entries together at most 2,000 characters; each allergy has a drug or drug group of at most 255 characters; the reaction has at most 255 characters; at most 50 history entries and 50 allergies. The server repeats the check. The system checks that the data was not changed by another Doctor since it was loaded (BR-119). The system replaces the patient's medical history and allergies with the new lists, links them to the medical record of the current visit and records the change in the audit log (old and new values, visit, Doctor, time). The system shows MSG03 ("Tiền sử và dị ứng cập nhật thành công.") and updates the red allergy labels at the top of the examination screen. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): The patient reports no allergy 1.1. The Doctor ticks "Không có tiền sử dị ứng thuốc"; the allergy list is hidden and not saved. 1.2. The system saves this statement with the time and the Doctor, and shows the green label "Không có tiền sử dị ứng thuốc" instead of red labels. The statement is not shown as an allergy in UC-36. 1.3. Continue at step 6 of the Normal Flow. AF-02 (at step 5): The Doctor clicks "Hủy" 2.1. If something was changed, the system shows MSG38; "Loại bỏ" discards the changes, "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa" returns to the lists. If nothing was changed, the panel returns to the read-only view without asking. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 6): Empty content, text too long or allergy without a drug 1.1. The system shows MSG02 ("Nội dung tiền sử là bắt buộc." / "Thuốc hoặc nhóm thuốc là bắt buộc.") or MSG08 ("Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 255 ký tự." / "… 2000 ký tự.") at the entry. 1.2. Return to step 5 of the Normal Flow. EF-02 (at step 2): The visit is not being examined in the Doctor's room 2.1. The panel is read-only (no "Cập nhật") and the system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2 or 8): The medical record of the visit is closed 3.1. The panel is read-only and the system shows MSG68 ("Hồ sơ bệnh án đã đóng và không thể chỉnh sửa."). 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 7): The data was changed by another Doctor 4.1. The system shows MSG75 ("Tiền sử và dị ứng vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.") with "Tải lại"; nothing is saved. "Tải lại" loads the new data and drops the unsaved changes. 4.2. Return to step 2 of the Normal Flow. EF-05 (at step 2): The data cannot be loaded 5.1. The system shows "Không thể tải tiền sử và dị ứng. Vui lòng thử lại." with "Thử lại". 5.2. Return to step 2 of the Normal Flow. EF-06 (at step 8): Session expired or system error 6.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG99 ("Không thể lưu tiền sử và dị ứng do lỗi hệ thống. Vui lòng thử lại sau."); nothing is saved and the entered data stays in the panel. 6.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the patient's medical history and allergies are updated and shown at later steps of the visit (prescription) and in later visits. Failure / Cancelled: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-23, BR-32; Security: Audit trail (IV.2.3) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG68, MSG75, MSG99  |  |  |

## **8\. Patient Reception** {#8.-patient-reception}

### **8.1 UC-40: Register Examination** {#8.1-uc-40:-register-examination}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | Simulated health insurance portal (through UC-74) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to register a new visit for a patient, so that the patient is routed to the right examination room and gets a queue number. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in (UC-01). The Receptionist is viewing the patient list or the patient profile (UC-36). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist clicks “Đăng ký khám”. The system checks that the patient has no active visit (BR-17). The system opens the “Đăng ký khám” screen with the patient code, full name, date of birth, gender and identification number; “Loại tiếp nhận” is “Khám bệnh” (BR-94). If the patient belongs to a priority group, the Receptionist ticks “Ưu tiên” and selects “Lý do ưu tiên” (BR-14, BR-94). The Receptionist selects the visit type “BHYT” or “Dịch vụ” (self-paid) (BR-11). For “BHYT”, the Receptionist enters “Số thẻ BHYT/ Số thẻ BHXH” and clicks “Xác minh”. The system verifies the card (UC-74) and shows MSG16 with the card validity and coverage rate (BR-13, BR-50). The Receptionist enters the reason for visit (BR-95) and selects the referral source (BR-129). The system shows the active examination rooms that have a doctor on duty in the current shift, with department, location, doctor on duty and the number of patients the doctor still has to examine (today’s visits of the room that have a queue number and have not ended) (UC-42). The Receptionist selects the “Phòng khám”. The Receptionist clicks “Tiếp tục”. The system shows the confirmation screen: patient, priority, visit type (card number and coverage rate for BHYT), reception type, examination room, doctor, reason for visit, and the examination fee (BR-27). For a BHYT visit, the card must have been verified at step 6\. The Receptionist checks the summary with the patient and clicks “Xác nhận đăng ký”. The system creates the visit with a unique registration code (BR-53), the room, the registration time, the visit type, priority information, insurance card information (if any), the reception type and the reason for visit. A BHYT visit gets the next queue number of the room for the day (BR-18), becomes “Chờ khám” and joins the examination waiting list immediately (BR-15). A Dịch vụ visit becomes “Chờ thanh toán” without a queue number; it gets its number when the Cashier confirms the examination fee (UC-71). The system creates the examination fee receipt with status “Chờ thu” (BR-09, BR-15, BR-27). The system shows MSG21. For a BHYT visit the message includes the queue number and the examination ticket can be printed (UC-41). For a Dịch vụ visit the message has no queue number and the Receptionist can print the payment guide slip (BR-16). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): Dịch vụ visit 1.1. The Receptionist selects “Dịch vụ”; no insurance card is entered. 1.2. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-02 (at step 6): The insurance card is not valid 2.1. The card is not found, not valid or expired. The system shows MSG17. 2.2. The system switches the visit type to “Dịch vụ” and discards the card data. The Receptionist informs the patient (BR-13). 2.3. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-03 (at step 6): The card does not belong to the patient 3.1. The card data does not match the patient. The system shows MSG18 and keeps the visit type “BHYT”. 3.2. If the Receptionist corrects the card number, the use case returns to step 6\. 3.3. If the Receptionist selects “Dịch vụ”, the use case continues at step 7\. AF-04 (at step 6): The insurance portal does not answer 4.1. The system shows MSG20 (UC-74). 4.2. If the Receptionist retries, the use case returns to step 6\. 4.3. If the Receptionist selects “Dịch vụ”, the use case continues at step 7\. AF-05 (at step 3): The patient has a follow-up appointment that is due (BR-34, BR-124) 5.1. The system shows the card “Lịch hẹn tái khám” with the appointment date, the doctor who made it and the suggested room (BR-34, BR-120), and two choices: “Đến tái khám” and “Khám vấn đề khác”. 5.2. If the Receptionist selects “Đến tái khám”, the system links the appointment to this registration, sets Loại tiếp nhận to “Tái khám”, preselects the suggested room (which can still be changed) and sets Nơi giới thiệu to “Tự đến” without allowing a change. The Receptionist can select “Bỏ gắn” to undo the link. 5.3. If the Receptionist selects “Khám vấn đề khác”, the visit is registered as “Khám bệnh” and the appointment is not changed. 5.4. The use case continues at step 4\. When the visit is created with the link, the appointment becomes “Đã đến khám” (BR-121). AF-06 (at step 3): The follow-up appointment is on a later date 6.1. The system shows only “Có lịch hẹn tái khám ngày …”, without “Đến tái khám”. 6.2. The visit is registered as “Khám bệnh”; the appointment stays “Đã hẹn” (BR-34). 6.3. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-07 (at step 10): Go back 7.1. The Receptionist clicks “Quay lại”; the entered data is kept. 7.2. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-08 (at step 11): The patient does not agree with the fee 8.1. The examination fee is the same for every room (BR-137); only the visit type changes the amount the patient pays (BR-27). 8.2. If the patient has a valid insurance card and the Receptionist changes the visit type to “BHYT”, the use case returns to step 6\. 8.3. If the Receptionist clicks “Hủy”, nothing is created and the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 12): The patient already has an active visit 1.1. The system shows MSG22; nothing is created (BR-17). 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 6 or 10): A required field is empty or has a wrong format 2.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG05 in the field. 2.2. The use case returns to the step of that field. EF-03 (at step 8 or 12): No suitable room 3.1. No active examination room has a doctor on duty in the current shift, or the selected room has just become unavailable. The system shows MSG53 for the selected room, or MSG102 when no examination room can receive patients (BR-07, BR-96). 3.2. If another room is available, the use case returns to step 9; otherwise it ends. EF-04 (at steps 12–14): Session expired or system error 4.1. Nothing is created. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-1).      The use case ends. 4.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80 on the confirmation screen; the confirmation stays open with the entered data and the use case returns to step 11\. EF-05 (at step 1 or 2): The patient does not exist 5.1. The patient cannot be found (for example, the link points to a patient that does not exist). The system shows that the patient is not found and offers “Về danh sách bệnh nhân”; no registration form is shown and nothing is created. 5.2. The use case ends. EF-06 (at step 1): The user is not allowed to register an examination 6.1. The signed-in user does not have the Receptionist role (BR-02). The system shows MSG13; no registration form is shown and nothing is created. 6.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the visit and its examination fee receipt are created. A BHYT visit has a queue number, is in the waiting list and its ticket can be printed (UC-41). A Dịch vụ visit has a payment guide slip; it gets its queue number when the Cashier confirms the fee, and the Cashier prints its examination ticket (UC-71, BR-16). A linked follow-up appointment is “Đã đến khám”. A Dịch vụ visit not paid by the end of the day becomes 'Đã hủy' and its receipt 'Đã hủy' (BR-22). Failure or cancel: nothing is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-07, BR-09, BR-11, BR-13, BR-14, BR-15, BR-16, BR-17, BR-18, BR-22, BR-27, BR-34, BR-50, BR-53, BR-94, BR-95, BR-96, BR-120, BR-121, BR-124,  BR-129, BR-137 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG13, MSG16, MSG17, MSG18, MSG20, MSG21, MSG22, MSG53, MSG80, MSG102 |  |  |

### **8.2 UC-41: Print Examination Ticket** {#8.2-uc-41:-print-examination-ticket}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | Cashier (AF-02) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to print the slip of a newly registered visit, so that the patient knows where to go next: a BHYT patient gets the examination ticket with the queue number and goes to the waiting area; a Dịch vụ patient gets the payment guide slip and goes to the cashier counter first (BR-15, BR-16). Included in UC-40 (step 14). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The visit has been created (UC-40). The health facility information is configured (UC-77). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | After the visit is created, the system shows "Đăng ký khám thành công" with the registration code and status of the visit, a guidance line for the Receptionist and the preview of the slip. For a BHYT visit, the preview is "Phiếu khám bệnh" (PF-01): facility name, registration code, queue number (large), priority mark with its reason (BR-14), patient full name, patient code, year of birth and gender, examination room name and location, doctor(s) of the room ("Chưa phân công" when there is none), visit type with the coverage rate, registration time and "Mời đến khu chờ – thanh toán sau khi có kết luận" (BR-15). For a Dịch vụ visit, the preview is "Phiếu hướng dẫn thanh toán": facility name, registration code, patient, examination room and location, the examination fee to pay and a note that the patient pays at the cashier counter and receives the queue number there. It has no queue number and is not an examination ticket (BR-16). The Receptionist clicks "In phiếu khám" (BHYT visit) or "In phiếu hướng dẫn thanh toán" (Dịch vụ visit). The system records the print in the audit log (BR-42) and opens the browser print dialog with the slip only. When the slip of this visit has been printed before, the printed slip carries the mark "IN LẠI". The Receptionist hands the slip to the patient and clicks "Về danh sách bệnh nhân". |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reprint from the patient profile  1.1. On the patient profile (UC-36), the Receptionist clicks "In lại phiếu khám" on the patient's active visit.  1.2. The system shows the slip of the visit as it is now: if the patient was transferred (UC-48), the current room and queue number; if the examination fee of a Dịch vụ visit has been paid, the examination ticket with the queue number and "Đã thanh toán phí khám – mời đến khu chờ"; otherwise the slip of step 2 or 3\.  1.3. The use case continues at step 4\. After printing, the system returns to UC-36 and the use case ends. AF-02 (after the examination fee is paid): The Cashier prints the examination ticket  2.1. After confirming the examination fee (UC-71), the Cashier opens "Phiếu số thứ tự" of the visit and clicks "In phiếu số thứ tự".  2.2. The system records the print in the audit log and opens the browser print dialog with the examination ticket, which shows the queue number and "Đã thanh toán phí khám – mời đến khu chờ" (BR-16).  2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The slip cannot be loaded 1.1. The system shows the reason and "Tải lại phiếu"; the print button stays disabled. The visit is kept. Reasons: "Chưa cấu hình thông tin cơ sở khám bệnh. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.", "Không tìm thấy hồ sơ bệnh nhân của lượt khám.", "Không tìm thấy phòng khám của lượt khám.", "Không tìm thấy lượt khám hoặc phiếu thu phí khám.", "Bạn không có quyền xem phiếu khám." 1.2. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-02 (at AF-01, step 1.1): The visit is closed 2.1. "In lại phiếu khám" is not shown for a visit that is Hoàn thành, Đã hủy or Bỏ khám. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at AF-02, step 2.1): The examination fee is not paid yet 3.1. The system shows "Lượt khám chưa có số thứ tự vì phí khám chưa được thanh toán." or "Chỉ in được phiếu số thứ tự sau khi đã thanh toán phí khám."; nothing is printed. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 4 or 5): Session expired or system error 4.1. Nothing is printed; the visit is kept. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 4.3. If the server cannot be reached, the system shows MSG96; if a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. "Tải lại phiếu" is shown and the use case returns to step 1\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | A BHYT patient holds the examination ticket with the queue number and waits at the room. A Dịch vụ patient holds the payment guide slip, pays at the cashier counter and receives the examination ticket from the Cashier (AF-02, UC-71). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-14, BR-15, BR-16, BR-42 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG80, MSG96 |  |  |

### **8.3 UC-42: View Room Queue Status** {#8.3-uc-42:-view-room-queue-status}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to see, for each active examination room grouped by department, the assigned doctors and today's number of patients at each step, so that I can assign new patients to a suitable room with a reasonable waiting time. Used at step 8 of UC-40 and on the Receptionist menu (Tình trạng hàng đợi phòng khám).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Receptionist is signed in (UC-01).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist selects "Hàng đợi phòng khám" in the menu. The system shows "Tình trạng hàng đợi phòng khám": every Active examination room grouped by department (department name A–Z, then room code), with room name, room code, location, assigned doctors (academic title \+ full name of the active Doctor accounts currently assigned to the room – BR-05), and today's counts: Chờ thanh toán, Chờ khám, Đang khám, Chờ CLS, Chờ kết luận, Bỏ lượt. A skipped visit is counted only as Bỏ lượt. A count of 0 is shown greyed. The system shows the totals "Phòng khám tiếp nhận được" (rooms with an assigned doctor), "Tổng bệnh nhân chờ khám" and "Đang khám", and marks the room with the most waiting patients as "Đông nhất" (every room with that number when several are equal; no mark when no room has a waiting patient). The system refreshes the counts automatically every 10 seconds (UI-04) and shows "Tự động cập nhật mỗi 10 giây · Cập nhật lần cuối: "; the Receptionist can also click "Tải lại". The Receptionist clicks a room name. The system shows the room's waiting list (Room Detail) with the room code, location, department and doctors: STT (queue number), patient name and code, Ưu tiên, Giờ đăng ký, Trạng thái (a skipped visit shows "Bỏ lượt"), ordered by priority first, then queue number. The list holds today's visits that are Chờ khám, Đang khám, Chờ CLS or Chờ kết luận; visits waiting for payment are not in this list. It is refreshed together with the counts. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): A room has no assigned doctor 1.1. The system shows the room greyed out with "Chưa có bác sĩ". It is not counted in "Phòng khám tiếp nhận được" and is not marked "Đông nhất". Its waiting list can still be opened. 1.2. Continue at step 3 of the Normal Flow. AF-02 (at step 6): Back to the overview 2.1. The Receptionist clicks "Quay lại". 2.2. Return to step 2 of the Normal Flow. AF-03 (at step 2): A room has no department 3.1. The system shows the room under "Chưa thuộc khoa", after the departments. 3.2. Continue at step 3 of the Normal Flow. AF-04 (at step 6): The room has no patient in the queue 4.1. The system shows "Phòng chưa có bệnh nhân trong hàng đợi." 4.2. Continue at step 6 of the Normal Flow. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): No room can receive patients (no active examination room, or none has an assigned doctor) 1.1. The system shows MSG102 ("Hiện không có phòng khám nào có thể tiếp nhận bệnh nhân. Vui lòng báo quản trị viên.") above the list; the rooms without a doctor, if any, are still listed greyed out. When there is no active examination room at all, the list shows "Chưa có phòng khám đang hoạt động". 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2 or 6): The user is not allowed to view the queue 2.1. The system shows "Bạn không có quyền xem tình trạng hàng đợi phòng khám." (MSG13). 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2, 4 or 6): System error 3.1. The system shows "Không thể tải tình trạng hàng đợi do lỗi hệ thống. Vui lòng thử lại sau." (server error) or "Không thể tải tình trạng hàng đợi. Vui lòng thử lại." (other failures, including no connection). When counts were loaded before, they stay on screen with "Số liệu bên dưới là lần cập nhật lúc ."; otherwise the list shows "Chưa tải được dữ liệu". 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The queue status of the rooms is shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05, BR-07, BR-18, BR-96; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Waiting list / Queue – View)  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG80, MSG102  |  |  |

### **8.4 UC-74: Verify Health Insurance** {#8.4-uc-74:-verify-health-insurance}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | Simulated Health Insurance Portal (BHXH) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | Là lễ tân, tôi muốn hệ thống tra cứu thẻ BHYT của bệnh nhân qua cổng BHYT mô phỏng, để chỉ áp dụng bảo hiểm cho thẻ hợp lệ với đúng mức hưởng. Nếu thẻ không hợp lệ, lượt khám được đăng ký dạng tự trả và tôi thông báo cho bệnh nhân (BR-13). Cổng là dịch vụ mô phỏng, không kết nối thật với cổng quốc gia (SW-01). Mở rộng UC-40 (bước 6). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | Đăng ký khám (UC-40) đang thực hiện, đã chọn BHYT và đã nhập mã thẻ (10 chữ số hoặc 15 ký tự). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | Hệ thống kiểm tra định dạng mã thẻ (BR-50): đúng 10 chữ số, hoặc đúng 15 ký tự gồm 2 chữ in hoa và 13 chữ số. Hệ thống xác định mã BHXH 10 số: thẻ 10 số thì lấy nguyên; thẻ 15 ký tự thì lấy 10 ký tự cuối. Hệ thống gửi mã BHXH sang cổng mô phỏng. Cổng tra cứu theo mã BHXH và trả về: mã kết quả, trạng thái thẻ, họ tên, ngày sinh (kèm loại ngày sinh), giới tính, số thẻ đang lưu, hiệu lực từ ngày, hiệu lực đến ngày, nơi đăng ký KCB ban đầu (mã 5 số và tên), mức hưởng (%). Hệ thống kiểm tra cổng trả kết quả thành công và thẻ đang hoạt động. Hệ thống đối chiếu họ tên và ngày sinh cổng trả về với hồ sơ bệnh nhân: Họ tên: không phân biệt chữ hoa, chữ thường, bỏ khoảng trắng thừa. Ngày sinh: loại đầy đủ thì so cả ngày-tháng-năm; loại chỉ có tháng-năm thì so tháng và năm; loại chỉ có năm thì so năm. Hệ thống kiểm tra thẻ có hiệu lực tại ngày đăng ký (hiệu lực từ ≤ hôm nay ≤ hiệu lực đến). Hệ thống lấy mức hưởng do cổng trả về để tính các khoản thu của lượt khám (BR-27). Hệ thống hiển thị MSG16 kèm ngày hết hạn và mức hưởng, đồng thời lưu vào lượt khám: mã thẻ đã nhập, mã BHXH, hiệu lực từ/đến, nơi đăng ký KCB ban đầu và mức hưởng. Tiếp tục ở UC-40 bước 7\. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | None |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (tại bước 1): Sai định dạng 1.1 Hệ thống hiển thị MSG05 dưới ô mã thẻ. 1.2 Quay lại UC-40 bước 6\. EF-02 (tại bước 5 hoặc 7): Không tìm thấy thẻ, thẻ không hoạt động (hết hạn, bị thu hồi) hoặc chưa đến ngày hiệu lực 2.1 Hệ thống hiển thị MSG17. Loại lượt khám chuyển sang Tự trả và lễ tân thông báo cho bệnh nhân (BR-13). 2.2 Tiếp tục ở UC-40 bước 7 (UC-40, AF-02). EF-03 (tại bước 6): Họ tên hoặc ngày sinh không khớp 3.1 Hệ thống hiển thị MSG18 kèm dữ liệu cổng trả về. 3.2 Lễ tân kiểm tra thẻ với bệnh nhân và chọn một trong ba cách: sửa mã thẻ (quay lại UC-40 bước 6), sửa hồ sơ bệnh nhân (UC-38), hoặc chuyển sang Tự trả (UC-40, AF-02). EF-04 (tại bước 3): Cổng không trả lời trong 10 giây 4.1 Hệ thống hiển thị MSG20 với hai nút Thử lại và Tự trả. 4.2 Thử lại để quay lại bước 3; Tự trả theo (UC-40, AF-02). |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Thành công: lượt khám đang đăng ký giữ mã thẻ, mã BHXH, hiệu lực từ/đến, nơi đăng ký KCB ban đầu và mức hưởng, dùng để tách mọi khoản thu của lượt khám thành phần BHYT chi trả và phần bệnh nhân trả (BR-27). Thất bại: không áp dụng bảo hiểm; lượt khám là Tự trả. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-11, BR-13, BR-27, BR-50; Data rules: Valid health insurance only, Payment calculation (I.3.3); SW-01, CI-03 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG05, MSG16, MSG17, MSG18, MSG20 |  |  |

### **8.4 UC-75: Reassign waiting patients**

## **9\. Clinical Examination** {#9.-clinical-examination}

### **9.1 UC-43: View Patient Waiting List** {#9.1-uc-43:-view-patient-waiting-list}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor views, searches and filters today’s visits of their assigned examination room on the “Quản lý khám bệnh” screen. The screen has three tabs: “Danh sách bệnh nhân”, “Chờ kết luận” and “Vắng mặt”. This use case covers the “Danh sách bệnh nhân” tab, which lists the visits waiting for examination, in examination, or waiting for paraclinical services. From this tab the Doctor can call a waiting patient (“Bắt đầu” or “Vắng mặt”, UC-44) or open a visit already started (UC-47). The other tabs belong to UC-54 and UC-45.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account, has role Doctor and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room (BR-05, BR-19).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens “Quản lý khám bệnh”. The system identifies the Doctor’s assigned examination room and checks whether the Doctor is on duty there now (BR-55). The system loads today’s visits of that room (date in Asia/Ho\_Chi\_Minh) in the statuses waiting, in examination, waiting for paraclinical services and waiting for conclusion, including skipped visits. The system shows a header with: the current room; the Doctor in charge; “Tổng số bệnh nhân chờ” (the number of waiting visits); the auto-refresh information and the last refresh time. The system shows the tabs with their counts and opens “Danh sách bệnh nhân”. This tab lists the visits that are not skipped and are waiting for examination, in examination, or waiting for paraclinical services. Self-paid visits appear only after the examination fee is paid (BR-15). The system shows the columns: STT, Họ tên, Mã BN, Loại khám, Thời gian đăng ký, Ghi chú, Trạng thái, Thao tác. a. The queue number of a priority patient is shown in red. b. “Ghi chú” shows “Ưu tiên: {reason}” and “Chuyển từ: {room}”, one per line. c. “Trạng thái” shows “Đang chờ”, “Đang khám” or “Chờ CLS”. The system sorts the list: a. Visits in examination first. b. Waiting visits next (BR-14, BR-18): priority patients, by queue number; then transferred patients, by transfer time, then by queue number; then regular patients, by queue number. c. Visits waiting for paraclinical services last, by queue number. d. The first waiting patient is highlighted. The Doctor may search, filter and change pages. a. Search by patient name, patient code or insurance-card number. The search ignores case and accents, and the keyword is at most 100 characters (BR-110). b. Filter by priority (“Ưu tiên”, “Thường”) or visit type (“BHYT”, “Dịch vụ”). “Xóa bộ lọc” clears the search and the filters. c. Choose a page size of 10, 20 or 50 rows (default 10). d. Changing the search, a filter or the page size returns to the first page. The system shows the actions in the “Thao tác” column: a. Waiting visit: “Bắt đầu” goes to UC-44 with the START action; “Vắng mặt” goes to UC-44 with the SKIP action. Both buttons are enabled only while the Doctor is on duty (AF-04) and no other call is being processed. b. Visit in examination or waiting for paraclinical services: no button. Clicking the row opens the examination (UC-47); it is read-only while the patient is away for paraclinical services. The system refreshes the list automatically every 10 seconds, and also when the Doctor clicks the refresh control (UI-04). a. It updates the visits, the tab counts and the last refresh time. b. The tab counts do not depend on the current search and filters. c. The current tab, page, search and filters are kept. End: the use case ends when the Doctor leaves the screen, switches to another tab, goes to UC-44 or opens UC-47. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): No visits in the tab1.1. The system shows an empty list with MSG92 and the hint “Danh sách hiển thị lượt khám BHYT và lượt khám dịch vụ đã thanh toán.”1.2. Automatic refreshing continues and picks up new visits. AF-02 (at step 5): The Doctor selects another tab2.1. “Chờ kết luận” continues in UC-54.2.2. “Vắng mặt” continues in UC-45. AF-03 (at step 8): No result matches the search or the filters3.1. The system shows an empty list with MSG01 and the hint “Hãy sửa điều kiện tìm kiếm, bộ lọc hoặc chọn “Xóa bộ lọc”.” The criteria are kept.3.2. The Doctor changes the criteria or selects “Xóa bộ lọc”. AF-04 (at step 2): The Doctor is outside a valid duty shift4.1. The Doctor is not scheduled in the assigned room for the current shift, or the current time is outside that shift’s configured hours.4.2. The system shows MSG48 above the list.4.3. Viewing, searching, filtering, paging and automatic refreshing remain available.4.4. “Bắt đầu” and “Vắng mặt” are disabled, with the tooltip “Ngoài ca trực”.4.5. If a call request is still sent, the system refuses it with DOCTOR\_OFF\_DUTY, shows MSG48 and keeps the visit unchanged. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): No valid room assignment1.1. The Doctor has no assignment to an active examination room.1.2. The system returns ROOM\_ASSIGNMENT\_REQUIRED, shows MSG99 and does not load the visits of any other room. EF-02 (at step 2): The account is not an active Doctor2.1. The system refuses with MSG13. EF-03 (at step 3 or 10): Loading error3.1. The system shows MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached.3.2. The system keeps the last list that loaded successfully, if any, and lets the Doctor retry.3.3. If the first load fails, no empty-list message is shown. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired4.1. The system shows MSG12 and returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the Doctor sees today’s visits of the assigned examination room, with the correct ordering, filters, counts, paging and actions. Failure: viewing, searching, filtering, paging, retrying and automatic refreshing never change a visit. A refused call leaves the visit unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-14, BR-15, BR-18, BR-19, BR-21, BR-24, BR-55, BR-110  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG48, MSG80, MSG92, MSG96, MSG99  |  |  |

### **9.2 UC-44: Handle Patient Call** {#9.2-uc-44:-handle-patient-call}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor calls a waiting patient from “Danh sách bệnh nhân” (UC-43) with “Bắt đầu” or “Vắng mặt”, without a confirmation dialog. “Bắt đầu” starts the examination, assigns the visit to the Doctor and opens the Clinical Examination screen (UC-47). “Vắng mặt” moves the visit to the skipped list (UC-45).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room and is on duty there now (BR-05, BR-19, BR-55). The visit belongs to that room, is waiting and is not skipped.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The patient is present and the Doctor clicks “Bắt đầu”. While the request runs, the buttons are disabled and show “Đang xử lý…”. The system checks the Doctor: an active Doctor account, an active examination room, and on duty in that room now. The system loads the latest visit and checks that it belongs to that room, is waiting and is not skipped. In one transaction (BR-119), the system: assigns the visit to the Doctor; sets it to “Đang khám” and records the start time (BR-20); writes the START action to the audit log (BR-42). The system opens the Clinical Examination screen (UC-47).  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Patient absent 1.1. The Doctor clicks “Vắng mặt”, and the system runs the checks of steps 2–3. 1.2. In one transaction, the system marks the visit as skipped (it stays waiting), records the skip time and writes the SKIP action to the audit log (BR-21). 1.3. The system shows MSG54 and refreshes UC-43. The visit moves to “Vắng mặt” (UC-45).  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Account, room or shift not valid1.1. Not an active Doctor: MSG13. No active examination room assigned: MSG99. Off duty: MSG48.1.2. Nothing is saved, and UC-43 is refreshed. EF-02 (at step 3): Visit of another room2.1. MSG13. EF-03 (at step 3): Visit not found3.1. MSG80, and UC-43 is refreshed. EF-04 (at step 3 or 4): Already called or changed meanwhile4.1. The visit is no longer waiting, is already skipped, or another request updated it first: MSG23, and UC-43 is refreshed. Nothing is saved. EF-05 (at step 4 or AF-01 1.2): Save error5.1. The transaction is rolled back. The system shows MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached. The Doctor may retry. EF-06: Session expired6.1. MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: “Bắt đầu” sets the visit to “Đang khám” and assigns it to the Doctor. “Vắng mặt” marks it skipped with the skip time and keeps it waiting. Both are recorded in the audit log. Failure: nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-21, BR-42, BR-55, BR-119  |  |  |

### **9.3 UC-45: View Skipped Patient List** {#9.3-uc-45:-view-skipped-patient-list}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor views and searches today’s skipped visits of their assigned examination room in the “Vắng mặt” tab. A visit is skipped when the patient is absent when called for examination (UC-44) or for the conclusion (UC-54). Skipped paraclinical services are not included.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room (BR-05, BR-19).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | On “Quản lý khám bệnh” (UC-43), the Doctor selects the “Vắng mặt” tab. The system lists today’s skipped visits of the room, ordered by skip time (earliest first), then by queue number (BR-21). The columns are as in UC-43. “Trạng thái” shows the interrupted stage: “Vắng mặt · Chờ khám” or “Vắng mặt · Chờ kết luận”. The Doctor may: search by name, patient code or insurance-card number (BR-110); filter by priority, visit type or interrupted stage; choose 10, 20 or 50 rows per page. Any change returns to page 1; “Xóa bộ lọc” clears the search and filters. Each visit that can be accepted again has “Tiếp nhận lại”, which goes to UC-46. It is enabled only while the Doctor is on duty. The list refreshes every 10 seconds; counts ignore the search and filters, and the page and filters are kept. |  |  |

AF-02 (at step 4): No matching result2.1. MSG01. The criteria are kept until the Doctor changes them or selects “Xóa bộ lọc”. AF-03 (at step 5): Outside the duty shift3.1. MSG48 is shown above the list and “Tiếp nhận lại” is disabled. Viewing still works. A request sent anyway is refused by UC-46 with MSG48. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01: Not an active Doctor, or no active examination room1.1. Not an active Doctor: MSG13. No active examination room: MSG99. No data of another room is shown. EF-02 (at step 2 or 6): Loading error2.1. MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached. The last list is kept and the Doctor can retry. EF-03: Session expired3.1. MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success and failure: no visit is changed, and no data of another room is shown.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-21, BR-22, BR-55, BR-110  |  |  |

### **9.4 UC-46: Accept Skipped Patient**  {#9.4-uc-46:-accept-skipped-patient}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | When a skipped patient returns, the Doctor accepts the visit from the “Vắng mặt” tab (UC-45) with “Tiếp nhận lại”, without a confirmation dialog. Work resumes at the stage that was interrupted: the examination (UC-47) or the conclusion (UC-56).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room and is on duty there now (BR-05, BR-19, BR-55). The visit is in “Vắng mặt”. A visit skipped at “Chờ kết luận” must already have an assigned Doctor. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The patient returns and the Doctor clicks “Tiếp nhận lại”. While the request runs, the button is disabled and shows “Đang xử lý…”. The system checks the Doctor as in UC-44 step 2\. The system loads the latest visit and checks that it belongs to the room, is skipped, and is at “Chờ khám” or “Chờ kết luận”. In one transaction (BR-119), the system: clears the skipped flag and the skip time; for a visit at “Chờ khám”: assigns it to the Doctor, sets it to “Đang khám” and records the start time (BR-20); for a visit at “Chờ kết luận”: keeps that status and the assigned Doctor; writes the ACCEPT\_SKIPPED action, with the interrupted stage and the new status, to the audit log (BR-42). The system opens UC-47 for a visit at “Chờ khám”, or the conclusion step (UC-56) for a visit at “Chờ kết luận”.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): The patient has not returned 1.1. The Doctor does nothing; the visit stays in “Vắng mặt” until the end of the day (BR-22).   |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Account, room or shift not valid1.1. Not an active Doctor: MSG13. No active examination room: MSG99. Off duty: MSG48. Nothing is saved. EF-02 (at step 3): Visit of another room2.1. MSG13. EF-03 (at step 3): Visit not found3.1. MSG80, and the list is refreshed. EF-04 (at step 3 or 4): No longer skipped, or changed meanwhile4.1. The visit is no longer skipped, was closed by the end-of-day job (BR-22), or another request updated it first: MSG23, and the list is refreshed. Nothing is saved. EF-05 (at step 4): Save error5.1. The transaction is rolled back. The system shows MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached. The visit stays skipped. EF-06: Session expired6.1. MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the visit leaves “Vắng mặt”. A visit at “Chờ khám” becomes “Đang khám” and is assigned to the Doctor; a visit at “Chờ kết luận” keeps its status and Doctor. The action is in the audit log. Failure: nothing is saved, and no visit is accepted twice. |  |  |
