## **16.Medicine Catalog**

###  **16.1 UC-81 View Medicine Catalog**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view, search and filter the medicine catalog so that I can look up and manage the medicines used for prescriptions. Only Admin can access the catalog.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Danh mục thuốc” in the menu. The system displays the “Danh mục thuốc” screen with:2.1. The search box “Tìm theo tên, hoạt chất, hàm lượng, mã thuốc, số đăng ký...”.2.2. The filters “Tất cả đường dùng” (fixed list), “Tất cả đơn vị” (units currently in the catalog), “Tất cả nhóm” (Thông thường, Gây nghiện, Hướng thần, Tiền chất), “Tất cả trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động, Ngừng hoạt động), and the “Xóa bộ lọc” button.2.3. The “Thêm thuốc” button.2.4. Table columns “Mã thuốc”, “Tên thuốc”, “Hoạt chất”, “Hàm lượng”, “Đơn vị”, “Đường dùng”, “Nhóm kiểm soát” and “Trạng thái”. Each row is clickable and opens the medicine detail.2.5. Paging with 10 rows per page by default, selectable page sizes 10, 20 and 50, and the total number of medicines. The list is sorted by medicine name. The Admin enters a keyword and/or selects filters. After a short debounce, the system updates the list and returns to page 1\.4.1. The search matches medicine name, active ingredient, strength, medicine code or registration number, and ignores letter case and Vietnamese accents.4.2. Search and filters are combined using AND. The Admin clicks a medicine row. The system displays the medicine detail.6.1. It shows every list field, plus the registration number, the medicine code in the insurance catalog, the creation time and the last update time.6.2. From the detail, the Admin may edit the medicine (UC-83) or activate/deactivate it (UC-84), or return to the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The catalog has no medicine1.1. The system displays an empty list and MSG92.1.2. The Admin may click “Thêm thuốc” (UC-82). AF-02 (at step 4): No medicine matches2.1. The system displays an empty list and MSG01, keeping the keyword and filters.2.2. The Admin may change the criteria or click “Xóa bộ lọc”. AF-03 (at step 3): Clear search and filters3.1. The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”.3.2. The system clears the keyword, resets every filter to “Tất cả”, returns to page 1 and reloads the list. AF-04 (at step 2): Change page or page size4.1. The Admin selects another page or page size (10, 20, 50).4.2. The system keeps the current keyword and filters; changing the page size returns to page 1\. AF-05 (at step 2): Add a medicine5.1. The Admin clicks “Thêm thuốc”; the use case continues in UC-82. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses access and displays MSG13.1.2. A direct request to the medicine API returns HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN; no medicine data is disclosed. EF-02 (at step 6): The medicine does not exist2.1. The system displays MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy thuốc.”) and a button back to the catalog. EF-03 (at steps 2–6): Session expired or system error3.1. If the session has expired, the system displays MSG12 and opens the Login screen.3.2. If the catalog or the detail cannot be loaded, the system displays MSG80; the Admin may retry. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The medicines matching the criteria, or the selected medicine, are shown. No data is changed.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG80, MSG92  |  |  |

### **16.2 UC-82 Create Medicine**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to add a medicine to the catalog so that Doctors can select it when prescribing. The clinic neither sells nor dispenses medicines, so the catalog has no price or stock (BR-33).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01), is not required to change the password, and is on the medicine catalog (UC-81).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Thêm thuốc”. The system opens the “Thêm thuốc” form with the fields:2.1. “Mã thuốc”, “Số đăng ký”, “Tên thuốc”, “Hoạt chất”, “Hàm lượng”, “Đơn vị tính”, “Đường dùng”, “Nhóm kiểm soát” (required) and “Mã thuốc theo danh mục BHYT” (optional, marked “Không bắt buộc”).2.2. “Đường dùng” is chosen from the fixed route list; “Nhóm kiểm soát” from Thông thường, Gây nghiện, Hướng thần, Tiền chất.2.3. “Đơn vị tính” is free text with suggestions of the units already in the catalog. The Admin enters the data and clicks “Thêm thuốc”.3.1. “Mã thuốc” is the clinic’s internal code set by the Admin and is converted to upper case as it is typed. The system validates the data (BR-79):4.1. Required fields are present.4.2. “Mã thuốc”: at most 50 characters, only upper-case letters, digits and hyphens.4.3. “Số đăng ký”: at most 20 characters; “Tên thuốc”: 2–255; “Hoạt chất”: 2–500; “Hàm lượng”: at most 255; “Đơn vị tính”: at most 50; “Mã thuốc theo danh mục BHYT”: at most 255\.4.4. “Đường dùng” belongs to the fixed route list.4.5. “Mã thuốc” and “Số đăng ký” do not already exist in the catalog (BR-51).4.6. Leading and trailing spaces are removed and repeated spaces are collapsed; an empty optional field is saved as empty. The system saves the medicine with status “Đang hoạt động” and records the creation in the audit log. The system closes the form, shows MSG04 (“Tạo thành công thuốc {mã thuốc}.”) and reloads the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): A required field is empty1.1. The system shows MSG02 under that field; nothing is saved. AF-02 (at step 4): Wrong format or length2.1. “Mã thuốc” with a character other than upper-case letters, digits and hyphens, or “Tên thuốc”/”Hoạt chất” shorter than 2 characters: MSG05 under the field.2.2. A field longer than its maximum: MSG08 under the field. AF-03 (at step 4): Duplicate code or registration number3.1. The system shows MSG07 under “Mã thuốc” or “Số đăng ký”; the entered data is kept.3.2. This also applies when another Admin saved the same value at the same time. AF-04 (at step 4): Route not in the list4.1. The system shows MSG40 under “Đường dùng”. AF-05 (at step 3): Cancel5.1. If no data was entered, the form closes.5.2. If data was entered, the system shows MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. “Loại bỏ” closes the form without saving and returns to the catalog. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses the action and shows MSG13; nothing is saved. EF-02 (at steps 4–5): Session expired or system error2.1. If the session has expired, the system shows MSG12 and opens the Login screen.2.2. If the medicine cannot be saved, the system shows MSG80 and keeps the entered data so the Admin can retry; nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the new medicine is in the catalog with status “Đang hoạt động” and the creation is recorded in the audit log. A “Thông thường” medicine can be selected when prescribing (UC-59); “Gây nghiện”, “Hướng thần” and “Tiền chất” medicines are stored but cannot be prescribed on an ordinary prescription. Failure: no medicine is created.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33, BR-51, BR-79; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG40, MSG80  |  |  |

### 

### **16.3 UC-83 Update Medicine**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the information of a medicine in the catalog so that prescriptions use correct data. Prescriptions already created keep the medicine data stored when they were written.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The medicine exists in the catalog.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens a medicine from the catalog (UC-81) and clicks “Sửa thông tin”. The system opens the “Sửa thông tin thuốc” form with the current values.2.1. “Mã thuốc” is shown read-only with the note “Mã thuốc không thay đổi được”.2.2. The other fields are the same as in UC-82; both active and inactive medicines can be edited. The Admin changes the fields and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”.3.1. “Lưu thay đổi” is enabled only after a value has changed. The system validates the data as in UC-82 step 4 (BR-79).4.1. “Số đăng ký” must not belong to another medicine (BR-51).4.2. If the data has been changed by another user since the form was opened, the flow continues at AF-04. The system saves the new values and records the update in the audit log, with the old and new value of each changed field. The system closes the form, shows MSG03 (“Thông tin thuốc {mã thuốc} cập nhật thành công.”) and refreshes the detail and the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): Invalid data1.1. Empty required field: MSG02. Wrong format, or “Tên thuốc”/”Hoạt chất” shorter than 2 characters: MSG05. Too long: MSG08. Route not in the list: MSG40.1.2. The message is shown under the field and nothing is saved. AF-02 (at step 4): Duplicate registration number2.1. The system shows MSG07 under “Số đăng ký”, including when another Admin saved the same number at the same time. AF-03 (at step 3): Cancel3.1. If nothing was changed, the form closes.3.2. If something was changed, the system shows MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. “Loại bỏ” closes the form without saving. AF-04 (at step 4): The medicine was changed by another user4.1. The system shows MSG75 (“Thuốc vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.”) and nothing is saved.4.2. The system reloads the medicine detail and keeps the form open so the Admin can edit again. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses the action and shows MSG13. EF-02 (at step 4): The medicine no longer exists2.1. The system shows MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy thuốc.”) and nothing is saved. EF-03 (at steps 4–5): Session expired or system error3.1. If the session has expired, the system shows MSG12 and opens the Login screen.3.2. If the medicine cannot be saved, the system shows MSG80, keeps the entered data and lets the Admin retry; nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the new values apply to prescriptions written afterwards; existing prescriptions are unchanged; the update is recorded in the audit log. If “Nhóm kiểm soát” changes away from “Thông thường”, the medicine can no longer be prescribed from that moment. **TBD:** how unsent prescriptions that contain the medicine are blocked, and the message used, is decided with UC-59/UC-90. Failure: the medicine keeps its previous values.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33, BR-51, BR-79; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG39, MSG40, MSG75, MSG80  |  |  |

### 

### **16.4 UC-84 Activate/Deactivate Medicine**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to deactivate a medicine so that Doctors can no longer prescribe it, or reactivate a deactivated one. A medicine is never deleted, because existing prescriptions still refer to it.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The medicine exists in the catalog.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens the detail of an active medicine (UC-81) and clicks “Ngừng sử dụng”. The system shows the dialog “Ngừng sử dụng thuốc” with MSG06 (“Bạn có chắc chắn muốn ngừng sử dụng thuốc “{tên thuốc}” không?”). The Admin confirms with “Ngừng sử dụng”. The system changes the status to “Ngừng hoạt động” and records the change in the audit log (old and new status). The system shows MSG03 (“Trạng thái thuốc {mã thuốc} cập nhật thành công.”) and refreshes the detail and the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reactivate a medicine1.1. The Admin opens the detail of an inactive medicine and clicks “Kích hoạt”.1.2. The system shows the dialog “Kích hoạt thuốc” with MSG06 (“Bạn có chắc chắn muốn kích hoạt thuốc “{tên thuốc}” không?”).1.3. The Admin confirms with “Kích hoạt”; the use case continues at step 4 with status “Đang hoạt động”. AF-02 (at step 3): Cancel2.1. The Admin closes the dialog; the status is unchanged. AF-03 (at step 4): The medicine was changed by another user3.1. The system shows MSG75 (“Thuốc vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.”) and nothing is saved.3.2. The system reloads the medicine detail. AF-04 (at step 4): The medicine already has the requested status4.1. Nothing is saved and nothing is recorded; the system shows the current status. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses the action and shows MSG13. EF-02 (at step 4): The medicine no longer exists2.1. The system shows MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy thuốc.”) and nothing is saved. EF-03 (at step 4): Session expired or system error3.1. If the session has expired, the system shows MSG12 and opens the Login screen.3.2. If the status cannot be saved, the system shows MSG80 on the detail screen; the status is unchanged and the Admin may retry. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the medicine has the new status and the change is recorded in the audit log. An inactive medicine stays visible in the catalog (filter “Ngừng hoạt động”) and does not change prescriptions already sent.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG03, MSG06, MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG75, MSG80  |  |  |

## **17.e-Prescription**

### **17.1 UC-90 Submit e-Prescription**

### 

| Primary Actors | Doctor  | Secondary Actors | National prescription system (simulated)  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to sign the prescription and send it to the national prescription system before confirming the conclusion, so that it is valid under TT 26/2025 and the patient can buy the medicine with its code. Every send is stored, whatever its result.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is the Doctor of the visit and is on duty in its room (BR-19, BR-55), and the medical record is Open. The prescription is “Chưa gửi”, “Bị từ chối” or “Chưa nhận được phản hồi”. The conclusion is saved with exactly one main diagnosis (UC-56, BR-31).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | On the “Đơn thuốc” tab, the Doctor clicks “Ký và gửi đơn”. The system shows: a preview of the prescription with the watermark “BẢN NHÁP – KHÔNG CÓ GIÁ TRỊ”; the diagnoses and the follow-up date that will be sent; the reminder “Sau khi gửi thành công, đơn thuốc và chẩn đoán không sửa được nữa.” The Doctor enters the signing PIN and clicks “Xác nhận ký và gửi”.3.1. The button is enabled only after 6 digits are entered, and shows “Đang gửi…” while sending. The system checks the following in one transaction. Any failure continues at AF-04 or EF-01 → EF-03. the Doctor, the visit and that the prescription has not changed since the dialog opened (BR-47, BR-119); the PIN (BR-139, BR-140); the link codes (BR-48, BR-49, BR-65, BR-66); the lines (BR-33, BR-79, BR-107); the child data (BR-141). The system copies the conclusion’s diagnoses and the follow-up date onto the prescription (BR-47). It builds the message (BR-54, BR-82), signs it (BR-139), writes the audit row (BR-42) and records a new attempt (BR-47). The system sends the prescription to the national prescription system (BR-45), and the national system accepts it. The system records the attempt as accepted and locks the prescription and the conclusion’s diagnoses (BR-47). The system shows MSG84 (“Đã gửi đơn thuốc {prescription\_code} thành công.”) with “In đơn thuốc” (UC-60) and “Xác nhận kết luận” (UC-58). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): Rejected1.1. The attempt is recorded as rejected with the error list; the prescription becomes “Bị từ chối” and stays editable.1.2. The system shows MSG85, the error list and “Sửa đơn” (UC-92). AF-02 (at step 6): No answer within 10 seconds2.1. The attempt is recorded as “Không phản hồi”; the prescription becomes “Chưa nhận được phản hồi” and can no longer be edited.2.2. The system shows MSG86 and “Gửi lại”. “Gửi lại” restarts at step 2 with a new attempt and a new signature. AF-03 (at step 2–3): Cancel3.1. “Hủy” closes the dialog; nothing is signed or sent. AF-04 (at step 4): Wrong PIN4.1. The system shows MSG107 and clears the PIN field; the Doctor retries at step 3\. The fifth wrong PIN in a row continues at EF-02. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): Data not ready to send. Nothing is sent; the message is shown under the item concerned.1.1. Missing link code: MSG87. Conclusion not saved: MSG105.1.2. Invalid line: MSG40 (medicine inactive), MSG103 (not “Thông thường”), MSG106 (over 30 days), MSG89 (same medicine twice), MSG02 / MSG05 / MSG08 (fields). The Doctor corrects the prescription (UC-59 or UC-92).1.3. Child under 72 months without a weight or an accompanying person: MSG104. The Doctor records the weight (UC-47) or asks the Receptionist to add the relative. EF-02 (at step 1 or 4): PIN blocked or not set2.1. Blocked: MSG11. Not set: MSG108. Nothing is sent. EF-03 (at step 1 or 4): Not allowed, or changed meanwhile3.1. Already accepted: the button is hidden; a direct request gets MSG88.3.2. Prescription or visit changed by another request, or a send is already running: MSG75, and the tab reloads.3.3. Not the Doctor of the visit: MSG13. Record closed: MSG68. Off duty: MSG48. Not assigned to a room: MSG99. EF-04: Session expired or system error4.1. Session expired: MSG12 and the Login screen. Server unreachable: MSG96. Other errors: MSG80.4.2. A failure before step 6 records nothing; after step 6 the attempt keeps its recorded result. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: one accepted attempt and one signature are recorded. The prescription and the conclusion’s diagnoses are locked. The visit can be concluded and the prescription printed. Rejected or no answer: one attempt and one signature are recorded. Nothing is locked, and the conclusion stays blocked (BR-32). Failure before sending: nothing changes. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-31, BR-32, BR-33, BR-42, BR-45, BR-47, BR-48, BR-49, BR-52, BR-54, BR-55, BR-65, BR-66, BR-79, BR-82, BR-107, BR-119, BR-120, BR-123, BR-139, BR-140, BR-141  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG08, MSG11, MSG12, MSG13, MSG40, MSG48, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80, MSG84, MSG85, MSG86, MSG87, MSG88, MSG89, MSG96, MSG99, MSG103, MSG104, MSG105, MSG106, MSG107, MSG108 |  |  |

### **17.2 UC-91 View Prescription Submission Result**

### 

| Primary Actors | Doctor  | Secondary Actors | National prescription system (simulated)  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to see whether the prescription was accepted and, if not, the errors returned, together with every past attempt, so that I know whether to print and conclude, correct, or resend. Viewing changes nothing.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The visit has a prescription.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the “Đơn thuốc” tab of the visit (also shown at the end of UC-90), or the prescription in the medical record (UC-52, BR-35). The system shows the prescription code, its status and the matching actions (BR-47):2.1. “Chưa gửi”: “Ký và gửi đơn”.2.2. “Chưa nhận được phản hồi”: MSG86 and “Gửi lại”.2.3. “Bị từ chối”: MSG85, the latest error list, “Sửa đơn” and “Gửi lại”.2.4. “Đã được chấp nhận”: the accepted time and “In đơn thuốc”; the prescription is read-only. The Doctor clicks “Kết quả gửi”. The system lists every attempt, newest first: attempt number, sent time, sender, result (“Chấp nhận”, “Bị từ chối”, “Không phản hồi”), response time and, for a rejection, the error list. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): Resend or correct1.1. “Gửi lại” starts UC-90; “Sửa đơn” starts UC-92. AF-02 (at step 4): Never sent2.1. The list shows MSG92 (“Chưa có dữ liệu để hiển thị.”). AF-03 (at step 1): Closed record, or not the Doctor of the visit3.1. Everything is read-only; no send, resend or correct action is shown. AF-04 (at step 2): The Doctor tries to confirm the conclusion first4.1. UC-58 refuses with MSG67 and a link to this tab (BR-32). |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): No access1.1. Receptionist, Cashier, Technician or Admin: MSG13 (BR-120). EF-02 (at step 1): Prescription not found2.1. MSG39. EF-03: Session expired or system error3.1. Session expired: MSG12 and the Login screen. Server unreachable: MSG96. Other errors: MSG80 and “Tải lại”. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success and failure: nothing changes.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-32, BR-35, BR-42, BR-47, BR-120  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG67, MSG80, MSG85, MSG86, MSG92, MSG96  |  |  |

## 

### **17.3 UC-92 Correct and Resubmit Prescription**

### 

| Primary Actors | Doctor  | Secondary Actors | National prescription system (simulated)  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to correct a rejected prescription following its error list and send it again, so that it is accepted and I can conclude the visit. The prescription code does not change (BR-52).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is the Doctor of the visit and is on duty in its room (BR-19, BR-55), and the medical record is Open. The prescription is “Bị từ chối”.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | From UC-91 or the “Đơn thuốc” tab, the Doctor clicks “Sửa đơn”. The system opens the UC-59 form with the current lines, “Lưu ý” and “Lời dặn”. The prescription code is read-only, and the latest error list stays above the form. The Doctor changes the prescription and clicks “Lưu đơn thuốc”.3.1. The button is enabled only after a change, and shows “Đang lưu…” while saving. The system validates as in UC-59 (BR-33, BR-79, BR-107) and checks that the prescription has not been changed meanwhile (BR-119). The system saves with the same code (BR-52), writes the audit row (BR-42) and shows MSG03 (“Đơn thuốc cập nhật thành công.”). The status stays “Bị từ chối” until the next send. The Doctor clicks “Ký và gửi đơn”. UC-90 runs from step 2 as the next attempt and ends as UC-90 steps 7–8. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The error concerns the conclusion or a link code1.1. The Doctor corrects the diagnoses in UC-56 (not locked yet, BR-31) or asks the Admin to fix the link code (prescriber link code in UC-08, facility link code in UC-77). The Doctor then continues at step 6 without changing the prescription.  AF-02 (at step 4): Drug allergy match2.1. The system shows MSG26 with the medicine (BR-23). “Đổi thuốc” returns to step 3; “Vẫn kê đơn” continues at step 5, and the confirmation is recorded in the audit log. AF-03 (at step 4): Invalid data3.1. MSG02, MSG05, MSG08, MSG40, MSG89, MSG103 or MSG106 is shown under the field, as in UC-90 EF-01. Nothing is saved. AF-04 (at step 3): Cancel4.1. No change: the form closes. Changes: MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. AF-05 (at step 6): Rejected again, or no answer5.1. Rejected again: as UC-90 AF-01, then back to step 1\. No answer: as UC-90 AF-02, and only “Gửi lại” is available. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): Not rejected1.1. Accepted: “Sửa đơn” is hidden; a direct request gets MSG88. No answer yet: only “Gửi lại” is available. EF-02 (at step 1 or 4): Not allowed, or changed meanwhile2.1. MSG13, MSG68, MSG48 or MSG99, as in UC-90 EF-03.2.2. Prescription changed by another request: MSG75. The prescription reloads and the form stays open. EF-03 (at step 6): Sending fails3.1. The exception flows of UC-90 apply; the correction stays saved. EF-04: Session expired or system error4.1. Session expired: MSG12 and the Login screen. Server unreachable: MSG96. Save fails: MSG80, and the entered data is kept for a retry. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the correction is saved with the same code and recorded in the audit log. The new attempt is accepted, and everything is locked as in UC-90. Rejected again or no answer: the correction stays saved and one more attempt is recorded. Failure: the prescription is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-23, BR-31, BR-32, BR-33, BR-42, BR-47, BR-52, BR-55, BR-79, BR-107, BR-119, BR-120, BR-139  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG26, MSG38, MSG40, MSG48, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80, MSG85, MSG88, MSG89, MSG96, MSG99, MSG103, MSG106  |  |  |

# **III. Functional Requirements** {#iii.-functional-requirements}

## **1\. Authentication & Profile** {#1.-authentication-&-profile-1}

### **1.1: Login** {#1.1:-login}

![][image15]

This screen allows staff to: 

* Log in to the system to perform assigned tasks.. 

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Tên đăng nhập | Tên đăng nhập của nhân viên trong hệ thống. Không phân biệt chữ hoa/thường; khoảng trắng đầu/cuối được tự động loại bỏ. Bắt buộc nhập. Tối đa 100 ký tự.  |
| Mật khẩu | Mật khẩu tương ứng với tài khoản. Hiển thị dưới dạng ký tự ẩn; có nút "Hiện/Ẩn" để chuyển đổi. Bắt buộc nhập. Tối đa 200 ký tự.  |

### **1.2: Change Password** {#1.2:-change-password}

![][image16]

This screen allows staff to: 

* Change their own account password to protect account security. 

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Mật khẩu hiện tại | The staff member's current password. Used to verify identity before allowing the change. Input is masked; a Show/Hide toggle is available. Required. |
| Mật khẩu mới | The desired new password. Must be 8–64 Unicode characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, and must differ from the current password. A live character/byte counter is displayed. Input is masked; a Show/Hide toggle is available. Required. |
| Nhập lại mật khẩu mới | Re-entry of the new password for confirmation. Must match the New Password field exactly. Validated on the client side only. Input is masked; a Show/Hide toggle is available. Required. |

### **1.3: Update Profile** {#1.3:-update-profile}

![][image17]

This screen allows staff to:

* View their account information and update their own contact details (phone number and email).

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Họ và tên | Staff member's full name. Read-only; contact an administrator to update. |
| Tên đăng nhập | The account username. Read-only; cannot be changed. |
| Giới tính | Staff member's gender. Read-only; contact an administrator to update. |
| Ngày sinh | Staff member's date of birth. Read-only; contact an administrator to update. |
| Số điện thoại | Staff member's contact phone number. Editable by the staff member. |
| Email | Staff member's contact email address. Editable by the staff member. |
| Học hàm / học vị | Academic title or degree (e.g., ThS, BS). Read-only; contact an administrator to update. |
| Số giấy phép hành nghề | Professional practice license number. Read-only; contact an administrator to update. |
| Địa chỉ | Staff member's residential address. Read-only; contact an administrator to update. |
| Vai trò | The role assigned to the staff account (e.g., Admin, Doctor, Receptionist, Cashier). Read-only. |
| Trạng thái | Current account status (e.g., Active / Inactive). Read-only. |
| Ngày tạo tài khoản | The date the account was created in the system. Read-only. |
| Đăng nhập gần nhất | Timestamp of the most recent successful login. Read-only. |
| Mật khẩu | Displays the date of the last password change, or "Chưa đổi lần nào" if never changed. Clicking **Đổi mật khẩu** navigates to the Change Password screen (1.2). |

## **2\. Account Management** {#2.-account-management-1}

### **2.1: View Account List** {#2.1:-view-account-list}

![][image18]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* View the full list of staff accounts in the system.  
* Search and filter accounts by keyword, role, department, and status.  
* Navigate to an account's detail page by clicking on a row.

**Filter / Search Fields** 

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Tìm kiếm | Free-text search box. Matches against username, full name, phone number, or email. Results update automatically with a short debounce delay. |
| Vai trò | Dropdown filter. Options: Tất cả / Admin / Doctor / Receptionist / Cashier / Technician. |
| Khoa / Phòng | Dropdown filter. Lists all active departments. Filters accounts assigned to the selected department. |
| Trạng thái | Dropdown filter. Options: Tất cả / Đang hoạt động / Bị khóa. |

**Table Columns** 

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| STT | Sequential row number within the current page. |
| Tên đăng nhập | The account's unique username. Sortable. |
| Họ và tên | Staff member's full name, displayed with avatar initials and academic title if available. Sortable. |
| Vai trò | The role assigned to the account (e.g., Admin, Doctor, Receptionist). Sortable. |
| Khoa / Phòng | The department and examination/lab room the account is assigned to. Displays "—" if not assigned. |
| Email | Staff member's email address. |
| Số điện thoại | Staff member's contact phone number. |
| Đăng nhập cuối | Date and time of the most recent successful login. Displays "Chưa đăng nhập" if the account has never logged in. Sortable. |
| Trạng thái | Current account status badge: **Đang hoạt động** or **Bị khóa**. An additional **Chờ đổi mật khẩu** badge is shown when the account has a temporary password that has not yet been changed. Sortable. |

**Other Controls** 

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Xóa bộ lọc | Resets all filters and search to their default state. |
| Tạo tài khoản | Navigates to the Create Account screen (2.2). |
| Số dòng / trang | Dropdown to select how many rows are shown per page. |
| Phân trang | Pagination controls to navigate between pages. Displays current range and total count (e.g., "Hiển thị 1–5 / 5 tài khoản"). |

### **2.2: View Account Detail** {#2.2:-view-account-detail}

![][image19]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* View full information, account status, and access permissions of a staff account.  
* Access management actions: edit, change role, assign room, reset password, lock/unlock account.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Mã tài khoản | Unique system-generated account ID (UUID). Read-only. |
| Họ và tên | Staff member's full name. |
| Học hàm / học vị | Academic title or degree (e.g., ThS, BS). Displays "—" if not set. |
| Số giấy phép hành nghề | Professional practice license number. Displays "—" if not set. |
| Tên đăng nhập | The account's unique username. |
| Ngày sinh | Date of birth with calculated age in parentheses. Displays "—" if not set. |
| Giới tính | Gender (Nam / Nữ / Khác). Displays "—" if not set. |
| Số điện thoại | Contact phone number. Displays "—" if not set. |
| Email | Contact email address. Displays "—" if not set. |
| Địa chỉ | Residential address. Displays "—" if not set. |
| Phòng làm việc | The examination or lab room assigned to the account. Displays "Chưa được phân công" if unassigned; "Không áp dụng cho vai trò này" for roles that do not require a room. |
| Vai trò | The role assigned to the account (e.g., Admin, Doctor, Receptionist, Cashier, Technician). |
| Phân hệ truy cập | List of system modules the role has access to. |
| Đổi mật khẩu lần cuối | Date of the last password change and how many days ago. Displays "Chưa đổi" if never changed. |
| Yêu cầu đổi mật khẩu | Whether the account must change its password on next login (Có / Không). |
| Đăng nhập sai liên tiếp | Number of consecutive failed login attempts since the last successful login. |
| Chặn đăng nhập đến | Datetime until which login is temporarily blocked after 5 consecutive failures. Displays "Không bị chặn" if not currently blocked. |
| Trạng thái khóa | Whether the account is administratively locked (Đang khóa / Không khóa). |
| Lượt khám đang xử lý | Number of active patient visits currently assigned to this account. |
| Chỉ định CLS đang xử lý | Number of active paraclinical orders currently assigned to this account. |
| Tóm tắt quyền hạn | List of individual permission actions granted to the account's role. |
| Lịch sử đăng nhập | Chronological log of login events (successful login, logout, failed login, throttled), including timestamp and IP address. Paginated (5 per page). |
| Lịch sử thay đổi tài khoản | Audit trail of administrative changes (e.g., role change, profile update, password reset), showing actor, timestamp, and before/after field values. Paginated (5 per page). |

### **2.3: Create Account** {#2.3:-create-account}

![][image20]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* Create a new staff account and assign an initial role and password.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Họ và tên | Staff member's full name. Required. |
| Tên đăng nhập | Unique username for the account. Must be 4–30 characters; only lowercase letters (a–z), digits (0–9), dots, and underscores are allowed. Automatically converted to lowercase. Required. |
| Giới tính | Staff member's gender (Nam / Nữ / Khác). Optional. |
| Ngày sinh | Staff member's date of birth. Optional. |
| Số điện thoại | Contact phone number. Must be exactly 10 digits starting with 0\. Required. |
| Email | Contact email address. Must be unique across all accounts including locked ones. Optional. |
| Học hàm / học vị | Academic title or degree (e.g., BSCKI, ThS.BS). Optional for most roles; required for Doctor and Technician. |
| Số giấy phép hành nghề | Professional practice license number. Required for Doctor and Technician roles; optional for others. |
| Địa chỉ | Residential address. Maximum 255 characters. Optional. |
| Vai trò | The role to assign to the account. Options: Doctor, Receptionist, Cashier, Technician. Admin role cannot be assigned via this form. Required. |
| Phân hệ được truy cập | Read-only display of the system modules accessible by the selected role. Updates automatically when the role changes. |
| Mật khẩu *(chế độ Hệ thống tự sinh)* | The system generates a random 12-character temporary password. The account is required to change it on first login. |
| Mật khẩu *(chế độ Admin nhập thủ công)* | Admin sets an official password directly. Must be 8–64 Unicode characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. The account is not required to change it on first login. |
| Xác nhận mật khẩu | Re-entry of the manually entered password. Must match exactly. Visible only when "Admin nhập thủ công" mode is selected. |
| Trạng thái ban đầu | Fixed as **Hoạt động** (Active). All newly created accounts are active by default. Read-only. |
| Lần đăng nhập đầu | Displays whether the account must change its password on first login, based on the selected password mode. Read-only. |

### **2.4: Update Account Information** {#2.4:-update-account-information}

![][image21]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* Edit a staff account's personal and contact information.  
* Lock or unlock the account directly from the edit form.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Tên đăng nhập | The account's username. Read-only; cannot be changed via this form. |
| Trạng thái | Current account status (Đang hoạt động / Bị khóa). Read-only; change via the Lock/Unlock control on the right panel. |
| Họ và tên | Staff member's full name. Required. |
| Giới tính | Staff member's gender (Nam / Nữ / Khác). Optional. |
| Ngày sinh | Staff member's date of birth. Optional. |
| Số điện thoại | Contact phone number. Must be exactly 10 digits starting with 0\. Required. |
| Email | Contact email address. Must be unique across all accounts. Optional. |
| Học hàm / học vị | Academic title or degree (e.g., BSCKI, ThS.BS). Optional. |
| Số giấy phép hành nghề | Professional practice license number. Required for Doctor and Technician roles; optional for others. |
| Địa chỉ | Residential address. Maximum 255 characters. Optional. |

### **2.5: Assign Role** {#2.5:-assign-role}

![][image22]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* Change the role assigned to a staff account and preview the permissions that come with the new role before applying.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Vai trò hiện tại | The role currently assigned to the account. Read-only; displayed in the account summary panel. |
| Ngày tạo | The date the account was created. Read-only. |
| Đăng nhập gần nhất | Timestamp of the most recent successful login. Displays “Chưa đăng nhập” if never logged in. Read-only. |
| Quyền thao tác | Number of action-level permissions granted by the current role. Read-only. |
| Phân hệ | Number of system modules accessible by the current role. Read-only. |
| Chọn vai trò mới | Radio button selection for the new role. Available options: Doctor, Receptionist, Technician, Cashier. The Admin role cannot be assigned. Each option displays the role name and its accessible modules. Required. |
| Quyền được cấp | Read-only preview of the permissions (modules and actions) granted by the selected role. Updates automatically when the role selection changes. |
| Học hàm / học vị | Shown in “Thông tin chuyên môn” only when the selected role is Doctor or Technician. Text, at most 50 characters, prefilled with the account’s current value. Required (I1-D47). |
| Số giấy phép hành nghề | Shown in “Thông tin chuyên môn” only when the selected role is Doctor or Technician. 5–50 letters, digits, “/” or “-”; unique across accounts; prefilled with the account’s current value. Required (I1-D47). |

### **2.6: Lock/Unlock Account** {#2.6:-lock/unlock-account}

![][image23]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* Lock a staff account to immediately block login access and sign out all active sessions.  
* Unlock a previously locked account to restore login access.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Lý do khóa | The reason for locking the account. Required when locking. Free-text input, maximum 500 characters. A live character counter is displayed. Examples: *Nghỉ việc, chuyển công tác, vi phạm quy định*. Not required when unlocking. |

### **2.7: Reset Password** {#2.7:-reset-password}

![][image24]

This screen allows the administrator to:

* Reset a staff account’s password with a temporary password generated by the system. The user must change it at their next login.  
* Reset a staff account’s password by entering an agreed official password manually. The user does not have to change it at their next login.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Phương thức tạo mật khẩu | How the new password is created. Single choice between two options: *Hệ thống tự sinh* (default) or *Admin nhập thủ công*. Required. |
| Hệ thống tự sinh | The system generates a 12-character temporary password. The user must change it at their next login. No input is needed. |
| Admin nhập thủ công | The administrator enters an agreed official password. The user does not have to change it at their next login. When this option is selected, the *Mật khẩu chính thức* and *Xác nhận mật khẩu* fields are displayed. |
| Mật khẩu chính thức | The new official password. Required when *Admin nhập thủ công* is selected. Masked input with a show/hide (eye) button. Must be 8–64 characters and no more than 72 bytes. Not required when *Hệ thống tự sinh* is selected. |
| Xác nhận mật khẩu | Re-entry of the official password. Required when *Admin nhập thủ công* is selected. Masked input with a show/hide (eye) button. Must match *Mật khẩu chính thức* exactly, otherwise the message “Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp.” is shown. Not required when *Hệ thống tự sinh* is selected. |
| Hủy | Cancels the reset and returns to the account detail screen. No change is saved. |
| Đặt lại mật khẩu | Checks the input, then shows a confirmation dialog with the target’s full name and username. Once the administrator confirms, the password is reset. The button shows *Đang xử lý…* while the request is running. |
| Mật khẩu mới (result) | Shown after a successful reset. The new password is displayed only once, with *Sao chép* (copy), *In* (print), and *Về chi tiết* (back to detail) buttons. |

## **3\. Department Management** {#3.-department-management-1}

### **3.1: View Department List** {#3.1:-view-department-list}

![][image25]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* View the list of clinical and paraclinical departments, search and filter them, and open a department's detail or edit screen.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tìm kiếm | Text input, optional, at most 100 characters. Searches by department code or department name; not case- or accent-sensitive. The list updates when the Admin searches. |
| Loại khoa (filter) | Drop-down list filter, default "Tất cả loại khoa". Options: Lâm sàng, Cận lâm sàng. |
| Trạng thái | Drop-down list filter, default "Tất cả trạng thái". Options: Đang hoạt động, Ngừng hoạt động. |
| Xóa bộ lọc | Button. Removes the search keyword and all filters and shows the full list in the default order. |
| Mã khoa | Table column, read-only. Unique department code (uppercase letters and digits). The list is sorted by this column by default. |
| Tên chuyên khoa | Table column, read-only. Name of the department. |
| Loại khoa (column) | Table column, read-only. Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. |
| Phòng trực thuộc | Table column, read-only. Number of rooms that belong to the department. |
| Trạng thái (column) | Table column, read-only. Đang hoạt động or Ngừng hoạt động. |
| Xem chi tiết (icon mắt) | Icon button (eye) in the "Thao tác" column. Opens the detail of the department |
| Chỉnh sửa (icon bút) | Icon button (pencil) in the "Thao tác" column. Opens the department edit form. |
| Ngừng hoạt động / Kích hoạt (icon nguồn) | Icon button (power) in the "Thao tác" column. Switches the department between Đang hoạt động and Ngừng hoạt động. The tooltip shows the action that will be applied. |
| Số dòng mỗi trang | Drop-down list. Options: 5, 10, 15, 20\. Changing it keeps the current search and filters. |
| Phân trang | Page navigation under the table. Selecting another page keeps the current search and filters. |
| Thông báo không có dữ liệu | Message area shown instead of the table rows when there is no department in the system (MSG92: "Chưa có dữ liệu để hiển thị.") or no department matches the search and filters (MSG01: "Không tìm thấy kết quả."). |

### **3.2: View Department Detail** {#3.2:-view-department-detail}

![][image26]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* View the details of a selected department and its rooms.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Khoa: Mã khoa \- Tên khoa  | Read-only text field. Displays the unique code of the selected department and the name of the department. |
| Loại khoa | Read-only text field. Displays the department type: Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. |
| Mô tả  | Read-only text area. Displays the department description. |
| Trạng thái | Read-only text area. Displays the department description. |
| Mã phòng | Table column, read-only. Displays the unique code of each room belonging to the department. |
| Tên phòng | Table column, read-only. Displays the name of each room belonging to the department. |
| Mô tả (phòng) | Table column, read-only. Displays the room description. |
| Vị trí | Table column, read-only. Displays the room's location. |
| Trạng thái (phòng) | Table column, read-only. Displays the room status: Đang hoạt động or Ngừng hoạt động. |
| Thông báo không có phòng | Empty-state message displayed instead of the room table when the selected department has no rooms (MSG92: "Chưa có dữ liệu để hiển thị."). |
| Đóng | Closes the department detail popup and returns to the department list. |
| Chỉnh sửa | Button. Navigates to the department edit screen. |

### **3.3: Update Department** {#3.3:-update-department}

![][image27]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* Edit the selected department's name, description, and status.  
* Edit the department type if the department has never had a room.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Mã khoa | Disabled text field. Displays the unique code of the selected department. Cannot be modified. |
| Tên khoa  | Editable text field. Displays the current department name and allows Admin to update it. Required, 2–100 characters.  |
| Loại khoa  | Disabled text field if the department has ever had a room; otherwise, an editable dropdown list allowing Admin to select Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng.  |
| Mô tả  | Editable text area. Displays the current department description and allows Admin to update it. Optional, maximum 500 characters.  |
| Trạng thái  | Dropdown list. Displays the current department status and allows Admin to select Đang hoạt động or Ngừng hoạt động.  |
| Lưu thay đổi  | Saves the updated department information after validation.  |
| Hủy  | Cancels the update operation. If there are unsaved changes, the system displays MSG38: “Bạn có các thay đổi chưa được lưu. Bạn có muốn loại bỏ những thay đổi này không? \[Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa\] \[Loại bỏ\]” for confirmation.  |

## **4\. Room Management** {#4.-room-management-1}

### **4.1: Assign Staff to Room** {#4.1:-assign-staff-to-room}

![][image28]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* View the staff currently assigned to the selected room.  
* Add eligible staff to the room, moving them from their current room if they have one.  
* Remove staff from the room.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Mã phòng | Disabled text field. Displays the unique code of the selected room. Cannot be modified. |
| Tên phòng | Disabled text field. Displays the name of the selected room. Cannot be modified. |
| Khoa | Disabled text field. Displays the department of the room. Staff assigned to this room belong to this department (BR-05). Cannot be modified. |
| Loại phòng | Disabled text field. Displays the room type: Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. The type determines the assignable role: Doctor for a clinical room, Technician for a paraclinical room. Cannot be modified. |
| Vị trí | Disabled text field. Displays the room location. Cannot be modified. |
| Trạng thái | Disabled text field. Displays the room status. This screen is available only for an active room (Đang hoạt động). Cannot be modified. |
| Nhân viên đang được phân công (n) | Table of staff currently assigned to the room. n is the number of staff in the table. If the table has no data, the system shows MSG92. |
| Họ tên | Read-only text. Displays the title and full name of the assigned staff member. |
| Số GPHN | Read-only text. Displays the practice licence number of the assigned staff member. |
| Gỡ khỏi phòng | Button on each row. Disabled if the staff member has a shift from today onwards or work in progress (BR-55, BR-113). |
| Tìm kiếm | Optional, maximum 100 characters, case- and accent-insensitive, leading and trailing spaces are trimmed (BR-110). Filters the table by full name or practice licence number as the Admin types. If nothing matches, the system shows MSG01.  |
| Nhân viên có thể phân công (n) | Table of active staff whose role matches the room type. n is the number of staff in the table. If the table has no data, the system shows MSG92. |
| Chọn | Checkbox on each row to select staff. Disabled for staff with a shift from today onwards or work in progress (BR-55, BR-113). |
| Họ tên (Số GPHN) | Read-only text. Displays the title and full name of the staff member, with the practice licence number in brackets. |
| Phòng hiện tại | Read-only text. Displays the current room (code and name) of the staff member, or “Chưa có phòng” if none. |
| Thêm (n) | Button. n is the number of selected staff. Disabled when no staff is selected.  |
| Đóng | Button. Closes the screen and returns to the previous screen. |

### **4.2: View Room List** {#4.2:-view-room-list}

![][image29]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* View the list of rooms with their department, type, location and status.  
* Search and filter the list of rooms.

| Field Name | Description |

| Loại phòng | Dropdown list. Filters the list by room type: “Tất cả loại phòng”, “Lâm sàng”, “Cận lâm sàng”. Default: “Tất cả loại phòng”. |
| Trạng thái | Dropdown list. Filters the list by status: “Tất cả trạng thái”, “Đang hoạt động”, “Ngừng hoạt động”. Default: “Tất cả trạng thái”. |
| Xóa bộ lọc | Button. Clears the keyword and all filters and shows the full list in the default order. |
| Mã phòng | Read-only text. Displays the unique code of the room. |
| Tên phòng | Read-only text. Displays the name of the room. |
| Khoa | Read-only text. Displays the department the room belongs to. |
| Loại phòng | Read-only text. Displays the room type: Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. |
| Vị trí | Read-only text. Displays the location of the room. |
| Trạng thái | Read-only text. Displays the room status: Đang hoạt động or Ngừng hoạt động. |
| Phân công nhân viên | Button on each row. Opens the staff assignment function (UC-15). Enabled only for active rooms. |
| Xem chi tiết (icon mắt) | Icon button in the “Thao tác” column. Opens the room details. |
| Chỉnh sửa (icon bút chì) | Icon button in the “Thao tác” column. Opens the room update function (UC-18). |
| Kích hoạt / Ngừng hoạt động (icon nguồn) | Icon button in the “Thao tác” column. For an active room, the tooltip is “Ngừng hoạt động” and the button deactivates the room; for an inactive room, the tooltip is “Đang hoạt độngt” and the button activates the room (UC-19). |
| Số dòng mỗi trang | Dropdown list. Number of rows per page: 5, 10, 15, 20\. The current search and filters are kept when changed. |

### **4.3: Create Room** {#4.3:-create-room}

![][image30]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* Create a new room by selecting its room type and corresponding department.  
* Enter the room code, name and location.  
* Select a service group for a paraclinical room.  
* Save the room information or cancel the creation process.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Loại phòng | Dropdown list. Required. Selects the room type: “Lâm sàng” or “Cận lâm sàng”. The selected room type determines which departments are displayed in the “Khoa” dropdown list. |
| Khoa | Dropdown list. Required. Displays departments corresponding to the selected room type. If “Lâm sàng” is selected, only active clinical departments are displayed. If “Cận lâm sàng” is selected, only active paraclinical departments are displayed. Disabled until a room type is selected. |
| Mã phòng | Text box. Required, 2-20 characters. Must contain 2–20 characters, using uppercase letters (A–Z), digits (0–9) or hyphens. Must be unique across the system, including inactive rooms. |
| Tên phòng | Text box. Required, 2-100 characters. Enter the room name. |
| Vị trí | Text box. Required, 2-255 characters. Enter the room location, such as building, floor and room number. |
| Nhóm dịch vụ | Dropdown list. Required for paraclinical rooms. Displays the service groups applicable to the selected paraclinical department. Hidden when the room type is “Lâm sàng”. |
| Hủy | Button. Cancels the room creation process.  |
| Lưu | Button. Validates the entered information. If validation passes, the system creates the room and displays MSG04: “Tạo thành công phòng.” |

### **4.4: Update Room** {#4.4:-update-room}

![][image31]

This screen allows Admin to: 

* Update a room’s name and location and status.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Mã phòng | Disabled text field. Displays the unique code of the room. Cannot be modified (BR-71,BR-115). |
| Loại phòng | Disabled text field. Displays the room type: Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. Cannot be modified (BR-115). |
| Khoa | Disabled text field. Displays the department of the room. Cannot be modified (BR-115). |
| Tên phòng\* | Text box. Displays the current room name and allows the Admin to update it. Required, unique, 2–100 characters (BR-72). |
| Vị trí\* | Text box. Displays the current location and allows the Admin to update it. Required, 2–255 characters: building, floor, room number (BR-73). |
| Nhóm dịch vụ\* | Dropdown list. Cannot be modified (BR-115). |
| Lưu thay đổi | Button. Saves the updated room information after validation. |
| Hủy | Button. Cancels the update. If there are unsaved changes, the system displays MSG38: “Bạn có các thay đổi chưa được lưu. Bạn có muốn loại bỏ những thay đổi này không? \[Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa\] \[Loại bỏ\]”. |

![][image33]

This screen allows Admin to:

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |

| Trạng thái | Badge, read-only. Displays “Đang hoạt động” or “Ngừng hoạt động”. |
| Ngừng hoạt động / Kích hoạt | Button. Shows “Ngừng hoạt động” when the service is active and “Kích hoạt” when it is inactive. Opens UC-25. |
| Sửa thông tin | Button. Opens the update service information function (UC-23). |
| Cập nhật giá | Button. Opens the update price function (UC-24). |
| Mã dịch vụ | Read-only. Displays the unique code of the service. |
| Tên dịch vụ | Read-only. Displays the name of the service. |
| Loại dịch vụ | Read-only. Displays the type of the service. |
| Nhóm dịch vụ | Read-only. Displays the service group. Shows “—” for an examination service. |
| Khoa thực hiện | Read-only. Displays the department that performs the service. Shows “—” for an examination service. |
| Trạng thái | Read-only. Displays the current status of the service. |
| Mô tả | Read-only. Displays the description of the service. Shows “—” when empty. |
| Giá viện phí | Read-only. Displays the hospital fee in VND, with thousand separators. |
| Giá BHYT | Read-only. Displays the insurance price in VND. Shows “Không thuộc BHYT” when the service has no insurance price. |
| Phòng thực hiện | Table, read-only. Lists the active rooms of the service group. It is hidden for an examination service. Shows MSG92 when there is no active room. |
| Mã phòng | Table column, read-only. Displays the unique code of the room. |
| Tên phòng | Table column, read-only. Displays the name of the room. |
| Vị trí | Table column, read-only. Displays the location of the room (building, floor, room number). |
| Chỉ số xét nghiệm | Table, read-only. Shown only for a “Xét nghiệm” service and sorted by display order (BR-132). |
| Thứ tự | Table column, read-only. Displays the display order of the indicator in the service. |
| Mã chỉ số | Table column, read-only. Displays the unique code of the indicator (BR-136). |
| Tên chỉ số | Table column, read-only. Displays the name of the indicator. |
| Đơn vị | Table column, read-only. Displays the unit of the indicator. Shows “—” when empty. |
| Trị số tham chiếu | Table column, read-only. Displays every reference range of the indicator, one per line, as “Giới tính, tuổi từ–đến: cận dưới – cận trên” or as a text value such as “Âm tính” (BR-133, BR-136). |

### **5.3: Create Service** {#5.3:-create-service}

![][image34]

This screen allows Admin to:

* Create a new examination or paraclinical service with its prices.  
* Select the test indicators and their display order for a laboratory service.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Mã dịch vụ | Text box. Required, maximum 50 characters. Unique, including inactive services (BR-76). Cannot be changed after the service is created. |
| Tên dịch vụ | Text box. Required, unique, 2–255 characters (BR-77). |
| Loại dịch vụ | Dropdown. Required. One of  Xét nghiệm, Chẩn đoán hình ảnh, Thăm dò chức năng. Changing it clears the service group, performing department and selected indicators. |
| Nhóm dịch vụ | Dropdown. Required, lists only the active groups whose type matches the selected service type. |
| Khoa thực hiện | Read-only. Filled in automatically from the selected service group. |
| Mô tả | Text area. Optional, maximum 500 characters. |
| Giá viện phí (VNĐ) | Number box. Required. Whole number from 1 to 100.000.000 (BR-78). |
| Không thuộc BHYT | Checkbox. Optional. Default: unchecked. When checked, the system clears and disables “Giá BHYT” and the service has no insurance price (BR-08). When unchecked, the system enables “Giá BHYT” again. |
| Giá BHYT (VNĐ) | Number box. Required when “Không thuộc BHYT” is unchecked; disabled and empty when it is checked. Whole number from 1 to 100.000.000 (BR-78). |
| Chỉ số xét nghiệm | Section. Shown and required only for “Xét nghiệm”. At least one indicator must be selected (BR-132, BR-135). Shows MSG92 when no indicator is selected yet. |
| Chọn chỉ số | Searchable dropdown. Searches the indicator catalog by “Mã chỉ số” or “Tên chỉ số”, case- and accent-insensitive (BR-110). Already selected indicators are not listed (BR-135). |
| Thêm chỉ số | Button. Adds the chosen indicator to the end of the selected list. |
| Thứ tự | Number box in the table. Required, positive whole number. Defaults to the order of selection (BR-135). |
| Mã chỉ số | Table column, read-only. Displays the unique code of the indicator (BR-136). |
| Tên chỉ số | Table column, read-only. Displays the name of the indicator. |
| Đơn vị | Table column, read-only. Displays the unit of the indicator, or “—” when empty. |
| Trị số tham chiếu | Table column, read-only. Displays every reference range of the indicator by gender and age, one per line (BR-133, BR-136). |
| Gỡ | Button in the table. Removes the indicator from the selected list before saving and renumbers the remaining indicators. |
| Hủy | Button. Cancels the creation. Shows MSG38 if any field has been entered. |
| Lưu | Button. Validates the form and creates the service. Shows MSG04 on success. |

![][image36]

This screen allows Receptionist to:

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tìm theo  | Drop-down. Values: CCCD (default), Hộ chiếu, Mã bệnh nhân, Số điện thoại, Họ tên, Số thẻ BHYT. Changes the placeholder and the format check of Từ khóa.  |
| Từ khóa  | Required. Format by type (BR-110): CCCD 12 digits; Hộ chiếu at most 15 letters or digits; Số điện thoại 10 digits; Họ tên 2–100 characters; Số thẻ BHYT 15 characters; Mã bệnh nhân not empty. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed. Wrong format: MSG05; empty: MSG02  |
| Tìm kiếm  | Button. Searches with the selected type and keyword. Shows "Đang tìm…" while searching. . |
| Xóa tìm kiếm  | Button. Clears the keyword and the results.  |
| Xem hồ sơ  | Icon button on each row. Opens UC-36.  |
| Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ  | Icon button on each row. Opens UC-38.  |
| Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ  | Button on each row. Opens UC-40, which rejects a patient who already has an active visit (MSG22, BR-17).  |
| Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới  | Button. Opens UC-37 with the keyword pre-filled.  |
| Làm mới  | Button. Reloads the results.  |

This screen allows Receptionist to:

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Thông tin hành chính  | Read-only. Mã bệnh nhân, Họ và tên, Ngày sinh (age), Giới tính, CCCD / Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại, Địa chỉ, Nghề nghiệp, Dân tộc, Quốc tịch (Việt Nam when empty), Thẻ BHYT gần nhất, Người giám hộ.  |
| Dị ứng thuốc  | Read-only red labels recorded by the Doctor (BR-23). The "no known drug allergy" statement is not shown as an allergy.  |
| Lượt khám đang mở  | Shown only when the patient has an active visit: registration code, status, room, examination fee status (Chờ thanh toán, Đã thanh toán, Miễn phí, Đã hủy). Message "Bệnh nhân đang có lượt khám chưa kết thúc".  |
| In lại phiếu khám  | Button in Lượt khám đang mở. Opens UC-41 AF-02.  |
| Lịch tái khám hôm nay  | Shown only when an appointment is today: doctor and suggested room.  |
| Lịch sử khám  | Table, newest first. Columns: Mã lượt khám, Thời gian, Phòng, Bác sĩ, Đối tượng, Trạng thái. No visit: "Chưa có lịch sử khám." Clinical details are never shown (BR-120).  |
| Cập nhật thông tin   | Button. Opens UC-38.  |
| Đăng ký khám  | Button. Opens UC-40. Disabled when the patient has an active visit (BR-17).  |
| Về danh sách bệnh nhân / Tải lại  | Buttons. Return to UC-35, or reload the profile.   |

### **7.3: Create New Patient Profile** {#7.3:-create-new-patient-profile}

This screen allows Receptionist to:

• Enter the administrative information of a first-time patient and create the profile.

• Open an existing profile when the identification number or the name and date of birth already exist.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Họ và tên  | Required; at most 100 characters; trimmed (BR-82).  |
| Ngày sinh  | Required; date not in the future and not more than 120 years ago (BR-84). Changes the required marks of Số điện thoại and Thông tin người thân.  |
| Giới tính  | Required drop-down: Nam (default), Nữ, Chưa xác định (BR-85).  |
| CCCD   | Optional; exactly 12 digits; unique (BR-83). Duplicate: MSG19 with Mở hồ sơ.  |
| Số hộ chiếu  | Optional; 1–15 letters or digits; unique, case-insensitive (BR-83).  |
| Số điện thoại  | Required from 18 years old; exactly 10 digits (BR-91).  |
| Dân tộc / Mã dân tộc   | Required. Drop-down Kinh (default), Tày, Thái, Mường, Khmer, Hoa, Nùng, Khác; code at most 2 characters, default 01 (BR-86).  |
| Nhóm máu / Yếu tố Rh  | Optional. Nhóm máu: Chưa xác định, A, B, AB, O; Rh at most 5 characters.  |
| Nghề nghiệp / Mã nghề nghiệp  | Optional; name at most 100, code at most 5 characters (BR-87).  |
| Nơi làm việc  | Optional; at most 1,024 characters.  |
| Ngoại kiều / Mã ngoại kiều  | Optional; name at most 255, code at most 2 characters; empty means Vietnamese (BR-88).  |
| Xã/phường, Tỉnh/thành phố (và mã)  | Optional; names at most 1,024 characters, ward code at most 5, province code at most 3 characters (BR-89).  |
| Địa chỉ  | Required; at most 1,024 characters (BR-90).  |
| Họ tên người thân / Quan hệ  | Required under 18 years old. Name at most 255 characters; relationship drop-down (Bố, Mẹ, Vợ, Chồng, Anh/chị/em, …), at most 50 characters (BR-92).  |
| Số điện thoại / Địa chỉ người thân  | Optional; phone exactly 10 digits; address at most 1,024 characters (BR-92).  |
| Lưu hồ sơ  | Button. Validates and saves (UC-37 steps 4–9). Shows "Đang lưu…" while saving.  |
| Có thể trùng hồ sơ  | Dialog (MSG102) listing profiles with the same name and date of birth: Chọn hồ sơ này, Quay lại chỉnh sửa, Vẫn tạo hồ sơ mới.  |
| Hủy / Quay lại  | Button. When data was entered, shows MSG38 with Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa and Loại bỏ  |

## **9\. Clinical Examination** {#9.-clinical-examination-1}

### **9.1: View Patient Waiting List** {#9.1:-view-patient-waiting-list}

![][image37]

This screen allows the doctor to:

* View the queue of patients assigned to their current clinic room. The list refreshes automatically every 10 seconds.  
* Call the next patient and start the examination, or mark a patient who does not show up when called as absent.  
* Re-admit a patient who was marked absent.  
* Open the examination record of a patient who is being examined or is away for paraclinical (cận lâm sàng) services.

| Field Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Phòng khám hiện tại | The clinic room the doctor is working in, for example *Phòng khám Nội tiết*. Read-only. |
| Bác sĩ phụ trách | The academic title and full name of the doctor in charge of the room. Read-only. |
| Tổng số bệnh nhân chờ | The number of patients currently waiting in the room. Read-only. |
| Tự động cập nhật | Shows that the list refreshes automatically every 10 seconds, plus the time of the last update. Clicking it refreshes the list immediately. |
| Danh sách bệnh nhân (tab) | Patients who are waiting, being examined, or waiting for paraclinical services. The number in brackets is the count of patients in this tab. Selected by default. |
| Chờ kết luận (tab) | Patients who have finished their paraclinical services and are waiting for the doctor’s conclusion. The number in brackets is the count. |
| Vắng mặt (tab) | Patients who were not present when called. The number in brackets is the count. |
| Tìm kiếm | Free-text search by patient name, patient code (Mã BN) or health insurance card number (số thẻ BHYT). |
| Lọc ưu tiên | Drop-down filter: *Tất cả ưu tiên* (default), *Ưu tiên*, *Thường*. |
| Lọc loại khám | Drop-down filter: *Tất cả loại khám* (default), *BHYT*, *Dịch vụ*. |
| Xóa bộ lọc | Clears the search text and all filters, then goes back to page 1\. |
| STT | The patient’s order number in the queue. |
| Họ tên | The patient’s full name. |
| Mã BN | The patient code. |
| Loại khám | The type of visit: *BHYT* (health insurance) or *Dịch vụ* (paid service). |
| Thời gian đăng ký | The time the visit was registered (dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm). |
| Ghi chú | A note for the visit. It can show the priority reason, for example *Ưu tiên: Người cao tuổi*, or the room the patient was transferred from, for example *Chuyển từ: Phòng khám Nội tổng quát*. Shows “—” when there is no note. |
| Trạng thái | The visit status: *Đang chờ*, *Đang khám*, *Chờ CLS*, *Chờ kết luận*, or *Vắng mặt · Chờ khám* / *Vắng mặt · Chờ kết luận* for an absent patient. |
| Bắt đầu | Shown for patients in *Đang chờ* or *Chờ kết luận*. Confirms that the patient is present and opens the examination screen, or the conclusion screen for a patient in *Chờ kết luận*. The next patient in line has this button highlighted. Disabled outside the doctor’s working shift. |
| Vắng mặt | Shown next to *Bắt đầu*. Marks the patient as absent and moves them to the *Vắng mặt* tab. Disabled outside the doctor’s working shift. |
| Tiếp nhận lại | Shown in the *Vắng mặt* tab for patients who can be re-admitted. Re-admits the patient and opens the examination or conclusion screen. Disabled outside the doctor’s working shift. |
| Dòng bệnh nhân (row click) | Clicking a row for a patient in *Đang khám* or *Chờ CLS* opens their examination record. |

## **14\. Background Job Inventory** {#14.-background-job-inventory}

### **14.1 Unlock Expired Locked Accounts (JOB-01)** {#14.1-unlock-expired-locked-accounts-(job-01)}

***Trigger***: Scheduled — every 15 minutes

***Purpose***: Automatically unlocks accounts that were locked after failed sign-in attempts, once the lockout duration has elapsed

***Processing steps*****:**

1. Find all accounts with status \= Locked where the lockout timestamp is more than 10 minutes ago.  
2. For each account found: reset the failed sign-in count to zero, set status back to Active.  
3. Log the number of accounts unlocked in this run.

***Failure behavior*****:**

| Scenario | System behavior |
| ----- | ----- |
| Database unreachable | Job retries up to 3 times with 30-second intervals. If still failing, logs a critical error. Accounts remain locked until the next successful run. |
| No locked accounts found | Job completes immediately with no action — this is normal and expected. |

### **14.2 Clean Up Old Audit Log Entries (JOB-02)** {#14.2-clean-up-old-audit-log-entries-(job-02)}

***Trigger***: Scheduled — daily at 2:00 AM

***Purpose***: Removes audit log entries older than the configured retention period to prevent unbounded database growth.

***Processing steps:***

1. Determine the configured log retention period (default: 90 days).  
2. Find all audit log entries with a timestamp older than the retention threshold.  
3. Delete the old entries in batches of up to 5,000 records per run — to avoid locking the database for an extended period.  
4. If records remain after one batch, schedule the next batch to run 5 minutes later rather than deleting everything at once.  
5. Log the total number of entries deleted and the number of batches processed.

**Failure behavior:**

| Scenario | System behavior |
| ----- | ----- |
| Database timeout during delete | Current batch rolled back. Job logs a warning. Tries again at the next scheduled time. No data corruption. |
| Retention period not configured | Job uses default of 90 days and logs a warning that the setting was not found. |

# **IV. Non-Functional Requirements** {#iv.-non-functional-requirements}

## **1\. External Interfaces** {#1.-external-interfaces}

### **1.1 User Interfaces** {#1.1-user-interfaces}

| ID | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- |
| UI-01 | The system is a web application. All screens are in Vietnamese; dates use the format dd/MM/yyyy, time uses 24-hour format (HH:mm), and money is shown in VND with thousand separators (e.g. 150.000 ₫). |
| UI-02 | After signing in, each user lands on the dashboard of their role: Admin \=\>Admin Dashboard; Receptionist \=\>Receptionist Dashboard (today's registrations and queues); Doctor \=\>Doctor Dashboard (waiting list of the doctor's department); Technician \=\>Technician Dashboard (paid services waiting in the technician's department); Cashier \=\>Cashier Dashboard (pending payments). |
| UI-03 | Every screen shares the same layout: header (hospital name, current user, role, assigned department, sign-out), left menu containing only the functions allowed for the role (see 4.4 Permission Matrix), and main content area. |
| UI-04 | Waiting lists (clinical departments, paraclinical departments, pending payments) refresh automatically at least every 10 seconds without reloading the page. Priority patients are highlighted and shown first (BR-18). |
| UI-05 | Statuses are shown with the same color code on all screens: registration – WAITING, IN\_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, ABANDONED; payment – PENDING, PAID, CANCELLED; paraclinical service – PENDING\_PAYMENT, PAID, IN\_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, EXPIRED. |
| UI-06 | Required fields are marked with (\*). Validation errors are shown in red directly under the field (MSG02, MSG08); success messages are shown as toast messages. |
| UI-07 | Irreversible actions (Conclude Examination, Cancel Registration, Confirm Payment, Cancel Payment, Lock Account, Reset Password) require a confirmation dialog (MSG06) before being executed. |
| UI-08 | Screens are optimized for desktop resolution 1366×768 and above. Main reception and examination screens must be fully usable with the keyboard (Tab / Enter / shortcut keys) to support fast data entry at peak hours. |

 

### **1.2 Hardware Interfaces** {#1.2-hardware-interfaces}

| ID | Device | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| HW-01 | Ticket printer (thermal, 80 mm) | Used at the reception desk to print examination tickets (registration code, queue number, department and location, doctor, patient name, visit type, patient amount of the exam fee, time). |
| HW-02 | Office printer (A4/A5) | Used to print paraclinical orders, paraclinical results, examination conclusions, prescriptions, follow-up appointments, invoices and medical records. Print layouts follow the forms required by the Ministry of Health where applicable. |
| HW-03 | Barcode / QR scanner (optional) | Used at reception to read the QR code on the chip-based Citizen ID card (CCCD) or health insurance card to fill in patient identification fields automatically. Manual input must always remain possible. |
| HW-04 | Queue display screen (optional) | A TV/monitor in front of each clinical or paraclinical department displays the queue number currently being called and the next numbers. |
| HW-05 | Workstations | Standard PCs with a modern web browser; no software installation is required on client machines. |

 

### **1.3 Software Interfaces** {#1.3-software-interfaces}

| ID | External system | Direction | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| SW-01 | Health Insurance Portal (Vietnam Social Security – BHXH), **simulated** | METP \=\>Portal | During reception (UC-35), the system sends the insurance card number, full name and date of birth and receives the card status, validity period, benefit code and registered primary care facility; the coverage rate is calculated from the benefit code (BR-27; Data rule: Payment calculation, I.3.3). In this project the portal is a mock service returning predefined data; the interface is designed so that it can be replaced by the real portal later. |
| SW-02 | Web browser | — | Latest two versions of Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Mozilla Firefox. |
| SW-03 | Export | METP \=\>File | Statistics reports are exported to Excel (.xlsx) and PDF; medical records, conclusions, prescriptions and invoices are exported to PDF for printing. |
| SW-04 | Paraclinical equipment / existing lab software | — | Direct integration with laboratory and imaging equipment is out of scope (LI-08). Technicians enter the result content and conclusion on the Update Result screen and upload result files (images, PDF), which are stored through the Cloudinary Upload API (5.2, API 1). Integration with the current paraclinical software is an open issue (Q-04). |

 

### **1.4 Communication Interfaces** {#1.4-communication-interfaces}

| ID | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- |
| CI-01 | All communication between browser and server uses HTTPS (TLS 1.2 or higher). |
| CI-02 | Client workstations use the hospital internal network (LAN). The server also needs Internet access for the simulated insurance portal and the file storage service (Cloudinary). Access by staff from outside the hospital is not required in this version. |
| CI-03 | Calls to the (simulated) health insurance portal use HTTPS REST/JSON with a timeout of 10 seconds. If the portal does not respond, the Receptionist is informed (MSG20) and may retry or register the visit as self-paid. |
| CI-04 | Waiting list updates are pushed to clients in near real-time (WebSocket/Server-Sent Events) or by polling at most every 10 seconds. |

 

## **2\. Quality Attributes** {#2.-quality-attributes}

### **2.1 Usability**  {#2.1-usability}

### 

| ID | Requirement | Measure |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| US-01 | Training time | A new Receptionist, Doctor, Technician or Cashier can perform the main tasks of their role on their own after at most 2 hours of training. An Admin needs at most 4 hours. |
| US-02 | Registering a returning patient | Search the patient \+ register the visit \+ assign the department \+ print the ticket in at most 60 seconds and at most 6 clicks/key confirmations (excluding insurance verification time). Needed for the 7:00–9:00 peak hours. |
| US-03 | Registering a new patient | Create the patient profile and register the visit in at most 3 minutes. |
| US-04 | Calling the next patient | The Doctor/Technician calls the next patient with one click from the waiting list. |
| US-05 | Data re-use | Patient administrative data, drug allergy history and previous diagnoses are shown automatically and never need to be re-entered at later steps of the visit or at later visits. |
| US-06 | Search | Patient search accepts partial name, phone number, citizen ID or health insurance number, is accent-insensitive for Vietnamese (e.g. "nguyen" matches "Nguyễn") and shows results while typing. |
| US-07 | Error prevention | Pick lists are used instead of free text wherever possible (departments, services, ICD-10 diagnoses, drugs, units, common reasons for visit). |
| US-08 | Consistency | The same action has the same name, icon and position on every screen. |

### 

### **2.2 Performance** {#2.2-performance}

### 

| Requirement | Target | Condition |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Page load time | Any page loads within 2 seconds | Up to 100 users active simultaneously |
| Form submission response | System acknowledges within 2 seconds | Up to 100 users active simultaneously |
| Patient search | Results returned within 1 second | Database of up to 500,000 patient profiles |
| Waiting list update | A registration whose exam fee is paid, a transferred patient or a newly paid CLS service appears in the target department's list within 5 seconds | Normal operation |
| CLS result availability | A recorded CLS result is visible to the ordering Doctor within 5 seconds | Normal operation |
| Health insurance verification | Result returned within 5 seconds (excluding portal outage) | Simulated portal |
| Printing | Examination ticket is sent to the printer within 3 seconds after the registration is confirmed | Normal operation |
| Throughput at peak hours | Handles at least 300 visit registrations per hour | 7:00–9:00 peak hours |
| Report generation | Statistics for a period of up to 12 months are shown/exported within 10 seconds | Up to 1 year of visit data |
| Maximum simultaneous users | System remains fully functional for up to 100 users | Single server deployment |

### 

### **2.3 Security** {#2.3-security}

| Requirement | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Authentication required | Every page and action other than the sign-in page requires the user to be signed in. There is no self-registration; accounts are created only by the Admin. |
| Role-based access | Each user can only see and perform the functions of their role and within the restricted scope defined in the Permission Matrix (4.4). Access rights are checked by the system on every request, not only by hiding menu items. |
| Password protection | Passwords must never be stored in a form that a person or program can read. Passwords must have 8 to 64 characters and at most 72 bytes (UTF-8). |
| Account lockout | After 5 consecutive failed sign-in or current-password attempts, password sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes. The block ends automatically when the period expires, or earlier when the Admin resets the password (UC-11). This temporary block does not change the account status; manual Lock/Unlock (UC-10) is separate and does not clear it.  |
| Session timeout | A session with no activity for 30 minutes is ended automatically and the user must sign in again. |
| Medical data confidentiality | Patient health data is sensitive personal data. Doctors can view and export the medical records of all patients, including the examination history and paraclinical results of all visits (BR-35), but can only edit the current, uncompleted visit served in their assigned room (BR-19, BR-32). Technicians only see the patients and orders routed to their room; the Cashier only sees billing information; the Receptionist only sees administrative information. Result files are never accessible through a guessable or public link, and every access to a medical record is recorded in the audit log (Data rule: Medical data is access-controlled, I.3.3). |
| Audit trail | The system records who did what and when for: sign-in/sign-out, creating/updating patient profiles, registering and cancelling visits, recording examination data, paraclinical results, diagnoses, prescriptions, concluding examinations, creating/confirming/cancelling payments, price and service changes, and all account, role and department changes. Audit entries cannot be edited or deleted by any user. |
| Closed record protection | A concluded examination (diagnosis, results, prescription) cannot be edited by anyone (BR-32). |
| No data deletion | Accounts, departments, services, patient profiles, registrations, examinations and payments are never permanently deleted; they can only be deactivated, cancelled or abandoned (Data rule: Records are never permanently deleted, I.3.3). |
| Secure transmission | All data is transmitted over HTTPS. |
